author: Ying-Kuan “Rick” Tsai
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish was flavorful and beautifully prepared. You can really tell the care and creativity that goes into the menu. Special thanks to Luciano, who made our experience even better. He explained the dishes in great detail, answered all of our questions with patience, and gave excellent recommendations. His service was attentive, friendly, and genuinely thoughtful. Highly recommend this place for both the food and the outstanding service. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Neal Bakshi
review_text:
There is a reason this place is so highly rated on tens of thousands of reviews.

The food is SO good although service can be a little slow.

The interior is also very well done and vibey.

The menu is somewhat intimidating so take a look ahead of time and ask the server for suggestions.

The ceviche is really good, just drink ample water with it because the food is salty.

author: Maria Fernanda Ghiggeri
review_text: The food is very good and the table service is good as well. The problem was the girl at the entrance. She didn’t want to seat us at a table for four, saying everything was reserved, even though I insisted that wasn’t true. In the end, I was right—the restaurant remained empty the entire time, with comfortable, large tables available, while we had to eat squeezed into a small table, that’s the reason of my 2 stars..

author: Jennifer Cañas
review_text:
Went with my group of 7 friends. We had an amazing time.
I made a reservation just un case but luckily it was no wait time for dinner that day.
Host was really nice with us and we had a good sized table for all of us.
Our server was really nice with us too. He speaks Spanish that was very helpful because some of my friends don’t speak English. Menu was good with different options if you don’t like ceviche.
Food was amazing, good portions and seasoned to perfection. No complaints at all.
I think prices are good for the portions. And it was one of my friends birthday so they sang Happy Bday for him with a delicious chocolate cake.
It was a really good experience for us.

author: Teodor Morava
review_text:
I loved everything about this spot — from the food to the presentation to the overall vibe of the restaurant.

The staff was on point, attentive without being overbearing, and the food was absolutely delicious. Every dish looked just as good as it tasted.

Take a look at these pics and you’ll fall in love.

I’ll definitely be planning a return visit.

author: li橙子
review_text: I had such a great experience here! The restaurant is very clean and has a warm, inviting atmosphere. The food was absolutely delicious — everything was fresh and full of flavor. Our server, Franco, was amazing — very attentive, friendly, and professional. He made sure we had everything we needed and made the whole dining experience even better. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Peruvian food and great service!

author: Tam N
review_text:
If I could give the service here six stars out of five, I absolutely would. We were lucky enough to have a waiter named FRANCO, and he completely elevated the entire experience. From the moment he started sharing stories about the dishes to the way he guided us through the menu, it felt like we were getting a fine dining experience in a casual setting. He made sure we had just the right amount of food—never too much or too little—and every recommendation felt genuinely thoughtful. You could tell he took real pride in his work, and it made a huge difference.

As for the food, it was top-notch. I’d give it a solid five out of five. Honestly, I walked in a bit skeptical because they had so many good reviews, and I thought they might be overhyped. But nope—everything was delicious, fresh, and exactly what we hoped for from a great Peruvian spot.

Finally, the atmosphere had a really nice vibe—no complaints at all. So if you’re in Miami and you want an amazing Peruvian meal with outstanding service, CVI.CHE 105 is absolutely worth it!

author: Jason Sandoval
review_text:
This was by far the best ceviche I’ve ever had in my life. Every single dish was prepared with such intention in flavor and execution. Truly there was not a single bite that I had that did not make me close my eyes to savor the dish. I ordered the Tetras de Ceviche and the Tiradito Apasionado and split it between two people. This was more than enough. I also ordered the SOBE and Cholopolitan and neither were a disappointment. Honestly they were the perfect pairing for the dishes so I highly recommend.

We were waited on by Yuri and he was such a gem and did such a great job caring for us. He makes it that much easier to recommend this place. Not only did he describe the dishes and the drinks and assist with recommendations within the restaurant he also gave us local recommendations around Miami.

All the way from Chicago, thank you CVI.CHE105!

author: Charles Kong
review_text:
We arrived at 5:30PM. Since we didn't make reservation, we were asked to sit outside even though there are plenty of empty seats inside. We didn't like the $50 ceviche dish. It was too sour. If you like flavor of lemon and onion, then you might like it. Here are 3 dishes that I like
1) Parihuela Amelcochada Expotenciada, seafood rice
2) Pulpito a la Herradura (octopus) flavorful small plate.
3) Pescado a lo Macho, Fish filet in rich seafood sauce with rice.

Also, order kid's meals. They are big portion and good value.

author: ken tan
review_text: Totally enjoyed the food here. Carlos made such great recommendations to me.  His service is hospitable and warm.  He is the one to look for.  The ceviches are great starters. The grilled octopus has such a wonderful charred flavour.  And I never know corn can be so sweet. The seafood rice is delicious to round off the meal.  Would come again!

author: yukeong kim
review_text: We really enjoyed our time here at the restaurant. It was our first experience with Peruvian food and it could not have been better. Our server Franco was absolutely amazing and he really took his time to enhance our experience. Definitely recommend this restaurant to everyone, especially when visiting Miami!

author: Unikicon
review_text: If you’re looking for a club vibe and get a delicious meal this is the place to go. My husband took me here for our anniversary. The waiters themselves were respectful and joyful. We had Franco, he was humorous and extremely informative with the menu. I had a churrasco with rice and a mocktail. The rice itself was a bit too salty for my liking but the overall meal tasted natural. I highly recommend when celebrating a birthday (they sang happy birthday to like 7 people 😂).

author: Ruki Dole
review_text: We first ate here when we visited Miami in 2017. It was so good we had to come back! Today Romina was our server and helped us figure out the right mix of dishes to make a late lunch an amazing experience! Highly recommend this place!

author: Rosemary Rodriguez
review_text:
My boyfriend and I stopped by CVI.CHE while visiting Miami and it was absolutely amazing. The food was incredible, the ambiance and music were perfect, and the service was top-notch.

A special thank you to our waitress Dora — she was wonderful and made the experience even better. We couldn’t be happier and will definitely be back!

author: Sylvia
review_text:
This dining experience was absolutely unforgettable! Every single dish was incredibly delicious. I couldn’t go wrong with any choice, and the Parihuela Amelcochada was so amazing that I’m even considering going back to Miami just for it LOL.

The service was top level too. The server was so nice, he even helped peel our lobster and packed up the leftovers for us. Every little detail made the meal feel extra special and welcoming.

I really hope this restaurant opens a location in San Diego someday so more people can enjoy such amazing food and thoughtful service! Truly worth every bite.

author: C Llazari
review_text: The ratings did not lie!  The Peruvian restaurant had amazing ceviche (Ceviche Nikkei Tartare forgot to take pic it was beautiful) and traditional dishes!  Will definitely come back on a future visit to Miami!

author: Scott Zimmerman
review_text: The vibe in this place is off the charts...and the food is just as amazing. They have some dishes that you're not going to be able to get at any other restaurant in Miami. The quality of the oysters was better than i've ever had in my life, and that's saying, a lot, since I work in the seafood industry.

author: Anna Chen
review_text: The best meal experience in Miami, hands down. The food is delicious and affordable at its quality, service is excellent and attentive. We were so blessed to have Franco serve us. He is amazing and truly made our experience wonderful. Shoutout to Franco!

author: B B
review_text: Exquisite food, excellent service. Valet parking right up front. Super fast service. I enjoyed the location’s decor and open kitchen concept. You can see them making your meal. Loved the atmosphere is very chic and the alcoholic beverages were on point.

author: Jason Millahn
review_text:
We saw the amazing reviews for this restaurant and knew we had to give it a try — and we’re so glad we did! As people who aren’t too familiar with Peruvian cuisine, we didn’t quite know where to start, but luckily our waiter, Franco, did.

Franco guided us through the menu with confidence and enthusiasm, offering recommendations that we happily followed — in fact, we let him curate our entire dining experience. It was an incredible decision. The food was absolutely outstanding, and Franco made the evening truly unforgettable.

I travel the world for work and have dined in some of the best restaurants across major cities, and I can honestly say Franco was the best waiter I’ve ever had. The food alone would have made this a fantastic meal, but Franco’s service elevated it to something special.

The restaurant’s décor and overall vibe were also excellent — warm, stylish, and perfectly suited to the experience. Highly recommend!!!

author: G Lachhayya
review_text: Absolutely delightful dessert! The crème brûlée was perfectly caramelized, with a rich, smooth custard underneath. The fresh fruit topping added a lovely balance of sweetness and freshness. Every bite was enjoyable. The presentation was beautiful, and the quality was excellent. It was a perfect way to end the meal. Highly recommended!

author: Eva Aya
review_text: Outstanding experience! The whole fried fish was incredibly fresh and perfectly crispy, with rich flavors in every bite. The dish was beautifully presented and complemented by colorful vegetables, crunchy cashews, and just the right level of spice. A squeeze of lime tied everything together and elevated the taste even more. You can really tell care and quality go into the preparation. Highly recommended for seafood lovers - definitely worth coming back for!

author: faisal alsalem
review_text:
Honestly, I had high expectations after hearing so much about this place from my wife, but it turned out to be pretty underwhelming and overpriced.
• Tempura was fine, nothing special.
• Edamame was plain and forgettable.
• Noodles were bland.
• The mushroom beef bowl with truffle sounded promising but was just okay.

I was really hoping for that wow factor, but it just wasn’t there.

I might give it another shot to see if things improve, but as of now, it’s definitely not my first—or even second—choice.

author: Joanna Schnurman
review_text: Absolutely loved our dinner at Novikov Miami! The sushi was incredibly fresh, creative, and beautifully presented. Every bite was a standout. The rest of the menu was just as delicious, and the service was top-notch from start to finish. A must-visit spot for an elevated dining experience.

author: Gabriela Mascaró
review_text: One of my favorite spots for a casual or business lunch during the week. The ambiance is upbeat with good music, but still quiet enough for easy conversation. Service is relaxed, no one rushes you. The lunch menu delivers great quality, and if you go on a Friday, they offer the best wine deal in town: a bottle of Whispering Angel for $25. Food is solid (4/5), and the chicken truffle dim sum appetizer is a standout. Don’t leave without trying the Peking duck: rich, crispy, and perfectly paired with delicate sides. Valet is available, but Uber is usually easier. Totally worth it.

author: John Wu
review_text:
We went to this restaurant because it has a high google reviews score for Chinese food. However I left quite disappointed.
We didn’t make reservations as it was a Tuesday evening. True enough the restaurant was practically empty with only 3 tables occupied at around 7 PM. The girl at reception didn’t smile or made us felt welcome in any way. No smile when we asked for a table for 4 people. “What’s your name…. Your surname… your mobile number… “ Suddenly the restaurant phone started ringing, she picked it up without saying excuse me or anything to that effect. She started talking over the telephone for at least 5 minutes while I was standing in front of her. Finally she hung up her phone and said followed me. We were then shown to our table and given the menu. We looked at the menu, decided what we wanted to order and then had to wait for a long time before a server finally came. Remember at that time this large restaurant only had 3 tables occupied so the servers could not have been busy. When the server came, again we were not made to feel welcome. No smile, but just someone who was not interested in his job.

The food did came pretty quickly and it tasted ok. No complaints from me about the food. We ordered two signature cocktails but both of them were not good. Waste of money in our opinion.
During our meal the server did top up our water or being extra ordinary. However when we paid, the invoice as usual already included the 20% tips. That’s ok, but what upset me was that he wanted more tips before we paid with our credit cards. If we got good service I might consider tipping more but certainly not in this case. When the server saw that we didn’t tip more, his face turned black and stormed off.

I think the manager of this restaurant needs to be changed. He or she must be rubbish at managing the staff. Come and eat here if you want to leave feeling angry.

author: Firstname
review_text:
Me and my parents had one of the best dining experiences at Novikov thanks to our incredible server, Alain!! We told him to surprise us with whatever he thought was best, and he curated an unforgettable meal. Every dish Alain brought out was not only delicious, but perfectly complemented the next. He described each plate with such passion and enthusiasm that it made the whole experience even more special.
What impressed me most was that Alain didn’t overwhelm us with huge portions or try to push the most expensive items, he genuinely wanted us to enjoy the very best of what Novikov has to offer. After visiting a few times before, I can confidently say this was by far the best experience, all thanks to Alain. From now on, I only want to come back if he’s our server!!

author: Elok Martin
review_text: The presentation of this dish is absolutely impressive and instantly catches the eye. The mini chicken rolls are beautifully arranged on a wooden board, with the dark buns giving a unique and premium look. Each bite feels thoughtfully prepared, from the soft bun to the flavorful chicken filling. The portion size is perfect for tasting without feeling heavy, making it an excellent appetizer option. Overall, it reflects great attention to detail, quality ingredients, and a creative approach that elevates the entire dining experience.

author: Claudia Pedraza
review_text: Our waiter Jude was really rude, he was fine at the beginning. Then he asked us what are we gonna order and he was 'surprised' we didn't order one thing of each part of the menu, when he told us that everything was to share....Then he got mad and threw the bottle of water. He got a really bad attitude. We order a beer he never brought it. They already charge you 20% of service  and he asked us if we need change 🤣 when he already reacted like a loco. Of course we didn't leave more money  because of him and he went to our table and throw us the 5 dollars 🤣🤣 vete a tratar la ira hermano but the food was good!

author: Noam Kaniel
review_text: Excellent Asian Restaurant in Brickell. Very good food. Trendy and noisy atmosphere with DJ but the music is not too loud.  Big menu, so I’ll come back to try some other things. I recommend!!

author: Zoe chin loy
review_text:
Unforgettable Dining Experience!

From the moment we walked in, the ambience set the tone for an incredible night—elegant, inviting, and effortlessly cool. The food? Absolutely next level. We don’t even eat raw fish, and yet we found ourselves savoring every last bite of each dish. The duck wraps were a standout—easily some of the best in Miami.

What truly made the experience exceptional was the service. The manager, Daniel, personally checked in to ensure everything was perfect, and our server, Nick, was the real star of the night. Knowledgeable, friendly, and genuinely passionate about the menu, he made sure we had an unforgettable experience.

If you’re looking for fresh, flavorful food and top-tier hospitality, this spot is a must-visit. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Anna
review_text:
This was my third visit to Novikov and, unfortunately, the first truly disappointing one. My friend was celebrating her birthday, and I insisted we go to Novikov because it had always been a top-tier experience.

When we arrived, no one acknowledged the birthday, even though we mentioned it when making the reservation. Our waiter seemed distracted and rushed, barely looked at us, kept asking us to repeat our orders, and didn’t offer any recommendations on what dishes were best.

The food this time was quite mediocre. My truffle rice was extremely salty, I could barely eat it. No one offered to refill our wine glasses when they were empty; we had to flag down the waiter each time.

When we ordered dessert, we asked for a candle to be placed in one of them. The response was a dry “okay” (still no friendliness or birthday greeting, unlike in other restaurants where they make an effort).

I don’t know what happened to Novikov, but I have no desire to return. The service was poor, the food was average, and it left a bitter aftertaste on what was supposed to be a special celebration.

author: Jose Mendieta
review_text:
From the moment we arrived, Novikov Miami impressed with its seamless valet service and prime location, making the experience effortless from the start. The ambiance is nothing short of spectacular—an artful blend of chic decor, perfectly curated lighting, and a lively yet sophisticated soundtrack that elevates the dining experience.

Our server, Jean, provided impeccable service with an attentive yet unobtrusive approach, enhancing the evening with expert recommendations and warm hospitality. Without a doubt, we will be requesting his section on our next visit.

As for the cuisine—every dish was a masterpiece. Flawlessly balanced flavors, exquisite presentation, and an unmistakable attention to detail made each bite a delight. For those seeking an elevated culinary journey, Novikov delivers in every aspect. Check out the review photos for a glimpse into this unforgettable feast.

A true gem in Miami’s fine dining scene—highly recommended, and we will undoubtedly return.

author: Andrea Kylle
review_text: The grilled corn is fantastic, balancing smoky grill marks with a savory cream sauce, and served on skewers for easy eating.

author: Nidhi Verma
review_text: This entrée is special the moment I first see it. Beautifully presented in a sleek, heated buffet server, this vibrant entrée pops with color and flavor in each perfectly cooked, tender piece tossed with crisp, fresh bell peppers and a mouthwatering sauce that’s rich yet satisfying in every bite. Careful attention to detail-from sizzling aroma to stunning plating-really elevates dining experience. What a standout dish this was, combining bold taste with elegance!

author: Kevin Caro
review_text: I can only say good and great things about the food. The kitchen team really knows what they are doing. The food was delicious, and the presentation was great without trying to do too much. It just worked. I have to thank the wait staff as well as they were very courteous! This is a must go place for Asian cuisine in Brickell and Miami in general.

author: Pierfrancesco Martilotti
review_text:
Definitely the best brunch in Miami
Huge buffet with some options a la carte. Delicious cocktail, amazing music and Lovely staff
Thank  you all for  everything

author: Paul Vetrano
review_text:
Sat at the bar on two separate occasions.  Sean and Steve were awesome and so was the entire staff.

Delicious Sashimi and Oysters Rockefeller! Very cool vibe - and wonder sake selection!

I would definitely return!

author: Kacie Williams
review_text: I booked Novikov for my honey’s 45th bday dinner, with just the two of us. Our reservation was for 8:30, we arrived at 8:45 and waited 10-15 mins for our table. We were seated in the middle of the restaurant in Alain’s section and here’s where the magic happened. He took such great care of us, giving recommendations and great details of the menu items considered. To start, we requested our usual, two spicy mezcalitas. Next, we ordered the delicious hamachi, and the king crab maki - both 10/10. Then were the short rib bao buns and the undefeated Brussel Sprouts w/ crispy pork belly - so genius another 10/10. For the main we went with the wagyu ribeye and prawn fried rice - these were good, especially steak but the prawn fried rice was not a star of the night and that’s okay. Alain; such great personality and service. We will definitely be back to see you “Jersey”. Thanks for making an unforgettable birthday experience.

author: John Papazoglou
review_text: My girlfriend and I went for an early Valentine’s Day date. Our sever was Michael L he was amazing created a wonderful experience and went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time. I asked Michael if you could cater our experience and he did deliver. The food was amazing and the experience was better. Thank you for the great time!

author: Lewis Ramster
review_text: We came to Hell's Kitchen for my partner's birthday. It's in a great location in Downtown Miami and has a fantastic atmosphere. We came on a Friday evening and they had a DJ on. We arrived early but were still seated promptly. We opted for the prix fixe menu, which was incredible. The food was cooked perfectly and I would recommend this restaurant and experience to anyone. We would definitely return!

author: Kaylah Carruthers
review_text:
Dining at Hell’s Kitchen Miami delivers exactly what you expect from the Gordon Ramsay name: drama, polish, and a highly curated experience. The space is sleek and theatrical, with an open kitchen that leans into the show’s intensity without feeling overwhelming. Service is professional and efficient, though at times a bit rehearsed, more performance than warmth.

The food is strong overall. Signature dishes like the Beef Wellington live up to their reputation, executed with precision and rich flavor. Starters and sides are thoughtfully composed, though a few felt safe rather than inventive. Desserts are visually impressive and satisfying, even if they don’t fully surprise.

Where the restaurant falls just short of five stars is in its predictability. Everything is very good, but little feels unexpected. You are paying for consistency, brand, and atmosphere rather than culinary risk.

That said, Hell’s Kitchen Miami is a polished, memorable dining experience and well worth a visit, especially if you appreciate refined comfort food with a touch of spectacle.

author: Noel Travel Log
review_text:
Amazing experience at Gordon Ramsay’s Hell’s Kitchen.
We ordered the pan-seared scallops and the Beef Wellington, and everything was outstanding. The service was quick, professional, and attentive — the staff even took the time to recommend what to order, which we really appreciated.
The food was incredible. The Beef Wellington was absolutely the star of the show — perfectly cooked and full of flavor. To top it all off, the sticky toffee pudding was amazing, easily one of the best desserts I’ve had.
Highly recommend starting with the scallops or other appetizers, choosing the Beef Wellington as your entrée, and finishing with the sticky toffee pudding. Overall, an amazing experience — loved the place and would definitely return.

author: Polina Antipova
review_text:
Ok, first to the atmosphere. It’s cool at the lobby with that screen showing Gordon Ramsay, pretty basic inside the dining room on the second floor.

Second, the service, it was good and I loved that the chef came out to our kid to greet him with a souvenir. (it was actually my 11 y.o. idea to come here)

Now, to the food. There are 2 dishes I really liked: Beef Wellington and Sticky Toffee Pudding dessert. We also tried sea scallops (they were too salty) and steak tartar (lacking of taste) but didn’t like it. My kid liked his filet mignon steak and wagyu meatballs. My husband really liked roasted brussels sprouts

Anyway, I would visit it again for brunch experience.

author: Nyisha Haynes
review_text:
I was supposed to have a HK built in my neck of the woods but heard it got canceled. I was excited when my friend told me of the one near him and the pictures he sent her mouth watering. Tonight was indeed an experience I'll remember and don't think I can duplicate. I came to this restaurant only knowing who Gordon Ramsey is. I've only watched clips of his various shows he created over the years so I came in with no expectations. Though we were 15 min late the staff was very kind to us and we didn't wait long to sit. As a first time guest, the atmosphere was peaceful. Both  my friend, who is a fan, and our server educated me about the decor of the place which I enjoyed. Phase 1 was the lobster risotto. Taste buds danced! Texture was smooth and creamy, the flavor was subtle without the lobster, but when put together a combination I wouldn't expect. Phase 2, I chose the salmon with a bed of rice and green bean curry.  My compliments to the chef because to pan sear the skin of salmon where is not too burnt but that perfect amount of crisp and crunch from the skin was what I was going for as I cook my salmon like that at home so I was not disappointed. My friend let me try his braised short rib: Juicy, tender and the just all mouth watering and smooth like butter. Phase 3 got to try the sticky toffe which was nice,
but what brought me to literal tears as I sank my teeth into my dessert was the apple butterscotch cheesecake. It wasn't the cheesecake so much as the apple, pecan, butterscotch combo punch that brought me back to my childhood when I discovered Apple crumble for the first time. It was indeed a ratatouille moment even if I wasn't a food critic. To this day, I haven't found a dessert that tasted like that until tonight. So I again I thank the chefs, the many staff members that checked on us, giving us the warm welcoming experience down to the friendly valet.  I look forward to coming back again to try the other dishes.

author: Mythical Dreams
review_text: A dream come true! I have been a fan of the show and Gordon Ramsay for many years now, and to say this experience was amazing is not enough. I am on my honeymoon with my husband, and I was thrilled to see there was a Hell's Kitchen right by our hotel! We made a reservation but it was not needed. The inside is clean and elegant, the staff is friendly and accommodating, and the food was out of this world. I FINALLY got to try the beef wellington, and it did not disappoint! The meat is rich and flavorful, especially in that beautiful wine sauce. The wagyu meatballs and braised short rib were also incredible to say the least. The chocolate sin cake came with a little candle to celebrate, and it was the best dessert I had ever eaten at a restaurant before. Expensive place, but totally worth it. Thank you Hell's Kitchen for making our first night in Miami so special!

author: Neil
review_text: I ordered their fixed menu specialty, scallops (or salad),beef wellington, and sticky toffee pudding, $115. Everything was very good,  they used to give you 5 scallops,  now they give you 3.  But the Beef Wellington is amazing, as is their Sticky Toffee Pudding.  I'd recommend the Coco Old Fashioned too.

author: Jen Legere
review_text: Lots of great flavor in every dish.  No salt on the table, which was fine for most dishes except the Caesar salad, which was surprisingly bland and unremarkable given the very high quality of the other dishes.  The beef Wellington was incredible.  Let’s talk about gluten allergies: yes there are menu options.  The lobster risotto can be made GF without the crispy onions, salad with no croutons, etc.  I was disappointed that there was not a GF dessert option.  There are so many incredible GF dessert options to include on a menu, I was really shocked that Gordon Ramsey lacked the innovation and forethought to approach dessert with intention.  The coco old fashioned was delicious and became dessert instead.  Expensive for the size of the drink, but the ice cube was fancy.

author: LaTrice Davis
review_text: Listen!! I watch alllll of his tv competition shows so I had very high standards and when I say they did NOT disappoint!! My GOD!!! The food melting in your mouth is no exaggeration!! I had the lobster risotto, bone-in ribeye, and roasted brussel sprouts. My wife has the pan seared scallops and the beef short rib. And off the drink menu we both had the Notes from Gordon. 10 out of 10!! We also had an awesome table right at the front of the kitchen.

author: Azaria Primo
review_text: I’ve been wanting to eat these meals ever since I was kid watching master chef and they did NOT disappoint!!!! Every single dish was a 10/10. I had the caeser salad, lobster risotto, petite beef Wellington and sticky toffee pudding. They have a very affordable lunch option where you can get two courses for $25 and 3 for $34 I think which has the dessert in it. That sticky toffee pudding was AMAZING. This place is really good !! And my waiter Alex Morel was so attentive and very knowledgeable about the menu. Alex gets a 10/10 as well. Great service and great food!

author: Jeffrey Robinson
review_text: The overall experience was 5-star. Food was cooked to perfection. It definitely awakened our palates. Atmosphere was wonderful and inviting. The service provided by Alex Morel was amazing. He was extremely knowledgeable about the menu and accommodating in every way. The experience was heightened by his service. Definitely a must dine for all. Gordon’s signature drink with notes made for a great addition to the meal. All other restaurants have a high standard to live up to.

author: Natalie Jean (Nala)
review_text: I had the absolute best birthday dinner at Hell’s Kitchen! Our server Alex Morel was attentive, kind, and incredibly knowledgeable he made the whole experience even better. I’ve always loved the Hell’s Kitchen brand and used to watch the show, so finally dining here felt special. The food met every expectation everything was cooked perfectly, full of flavor, and even the leftovers were delicious the next day. Truly an unforgettable experience. Can’t wait to go back❤️🔥

author: THE SOD FARM
review_text:
Had reservations and had a 30 minute wait.
The lobster Risotto was very good, Pan-Seared Scallops were very good, BUT we did not appreciate the fact that they were cut in half horizontally (making 2-1/2 scallops 5), Grilled Octopus was very nice, 8 oz Filet Mignon was done ok, Beef Wellington was ok, not bad but not great,  Baked Mac & Cheese was good and finally the Roasted Brussels Sprouts were very good.
Overall it was a good-very good (not great) the biggest issue was the cutting of the scallops, we expected better from Hells Kitchen.

author: Paul-Elie Nauleau
review_text:
Pretty darn good I must say!

Lobster truffle risotto was excellent, although a small tail.

House burger was good, slightly smashed

Petite Wellington with whipped truffle butter was the best part

The eggs Benedict were very mid…

author: Helen King-Searfoss
review_text: I was so excited to go to dinner at Hells Kitchen in Miami. However, for as popular as the tv show is, we were surprised how difficult it was to actually find the restaurant downtown. Once there, the food was good, but very expensive. I expected my scallops to mimic what I’ve seen on tv, but rec’d 3, not 5 (they were good though!) and the lobster risotto didn’t come with a chuck of lobster on top like what I’ve seen on tv either (again still very good!) It will most likely be a one and done on price alone, but the atmosphere was nice.

author: Jack Rosenberg
review_text:
I think we all get big expectations for Hells Kitchen because of the TV show and we expect something.  I had heard in the past it's not great but.... I loved it!

The service was spectacular, the food was amazing, and the experience as a whole was top notch.  The prices I felt were very reasonable.  We tried all the classics... the Wellington etc... everything was on point.

I can't stress enough though while everything was great... the service was the best part.  Just a great time!

author: Elena Volkova
review_text:
We visited this restaurant as a family and were very pleased. Our daughter had the pumpkin soup — delicate, aromatic, and perfectly balanced in flavor. My husband chose a meat dish, I had fish, and both were cooked to perfection: juicy meat and fresh fish with well-matched sides. For dessert, we tried several sweets, and each one was a perfect way to finish the meal.

The service was attentive, the atmosphere cozy, and the cuisine truly top-notch. We will definitely come back again!

author: D H
review_text:
If I could give negative stars I would but 1 star is as low as you can go. This was a disappointment to say the least. After the stellar service and excellent food we got at Hell’s Kitchen in Las Vegas, me and my BF thought this would be nothing less than the best, but boy were we wrong.
My BF and I went here for my birthday (few days before my actual bday), because we went on a trip to Orlando and had planned to go here and were really excited and had planned to have dinner at Lucky Cat that same night after we had our lunch here. Not only was the service appalling, the food was unappetizing and not the best at all by what we believed to be Gordon Ramsey’s standards based on Las Vegas location. The prices for lunch were also a rip off and there was a service fee added to our bill, what did we have to pay a service fee for? We barely got service. They seated us and gave us nasty tap water and after our food arrived there was no checking in or anything.
We received way better service from the valet parking attendant out front. Regardless, we were not pleased and the cheesecake for dessert that we ordered was not very tasty and although they were nice to have added a chocolate Happy Birthday onto it as a surprise, it was still just overall a really bad experience. We were so unpleased that we wanted to get out of Miami as soon as possible and canceled our reservation for Lucky Cat because we were not wanting to have anything more to do with Miami or their service.

author: Racheal Jm
review_text: This was my teenager daughter's dream to eat here. They did not disappoint. Parking is quite interesting in Miami but they do have valet parking right next to restaurant. We parked in a parking garage not to far for $10/hr not associated with Hells Kitchen. So plan on parking. The food was amazing! We ordered the 3 part meal for $125/person. This came with options from each category. Never had anything like it! Plan on a 20% gratuity / this is added on automatically. We had Alex ( I will have to get last name added) as waiter. He made the experience extra special. He kept our water full. Very attentive to anything we needed. I've never seen so much silverware changed. Fun experience we will treasure.

author: Joe Ruiz
review_text: This was  my first time going to a Hell's Kitchen. I asked who the head chef was but it wasn't anyone from the show. During our visit we didn't see him anywhere in the kitchen. Maybe he was in the back.. The beef wellington was amazing, but the portion size was a little small for a $75 plate. We also ordered two lobster risottos.. about $28 each.. unfortunately we received two different portion sizes.. where are the STANDARDS !! like Gordan Ramsey would say.. the corn puree was very bland.. but the steak I ate was very good! but the overall experience was nice.. 3 people, with tip included was around $700

author: Mary Curry
review_text: I came here January 2025 and came back 2026 because the food was so amazing. Our waitress Christina was absolutely wonderful. If you are in Miami stop an eat at Fiore Brunch & Cafe. You will not be disappointed. The coffee was nice and strong also. The manager even came and spoke to us!

author: Julie Carter
review_text: My daughter & I stopped in for breakfast while on vacation. Food was delicious. We had the pesto chicken sandwich and an açaí bowl. Everything was fresh. The coffee and latte were perfectly crafted. And the service and atmosphere were both wonderful.

author: Ms Flo
review_text:
My husband and I visited Fiore Café; a humble, small scale cafè, last week while we were in town. From beginning to end, we were greeted with smiles and treated favorably.

Our waitress was very polite, and checked in on us quite frequently. Our order arrived swiftly, fresh and hot. Our waitress continued to check in on us throughout our meal. We would definitely return to Fiore Cafe again.

author: Victoria Howard
review_text: The food was absolutely amazing! We got the strawberry cheesecake pancakes (not on the menu but just ask!), the fried chicken sandwich, the french toast, and the steak eggs. Mafe was our server, a sweetheart! The area is so cute, and there’s a little parking garage right next to it, and parking is validated! I have no complaints, I can’t wait to come back again!

author: Omer Aswad
review_text: This place is so cute and aesthetic .. small, but full of good vibes! The atmosphere feels cozy and stylish at the same time. The service is amazing — everyone is super friendly and welcoming, with great customer service. The drinks are honestly to die for, and the food is really good too. Definitely one of those hidden gems in Miami you’ll want to keep coming back to.

author: Emily Lojewski
review_text: Didn’t think I’d be hearing club music at a breakfast cafe but it is Miami after all! Loved the overall vibe of the cafe. The lattes are delicious. Got the Tiramisu French toast and it was so good! The portions are huge! A little on the pricier side for breakfast food but I don’t have much else to compare to for Miami dining so it’s probably average pricing. Definitely a cute little spot for a yummy breakfast or lunch! Our waitress Maria was very attentive and sweet.

author: Megan Varela
review_text: I came here with some friends and family visiting from out of state. They loved it. The ambiance was just what we were looking for. The food and coffee were amazing. We got the chicken and waffles, avocado toast, Oreo pancakes, and the pancake tacos with fruit. Every meal was delicious. The Nutella latte was also so good. Our waitress Christina was so kind and helped us with any questions we had. The manager was also very nice and validated our parking. There is a parking garage right next to the cafe so I recommend parking right there.

author: Trevol Chapman
review_text: First time here and the food was amazing! Patrica was so nice and welcoming making my experience phenomenal. I ordered the 2–2-2 for breakfast and the scrambled eggs was amazing while my GF ordered the B.E.L.T looked amazing! Thank you Fiore Caffe Miami!

author: Sean Renner
review_text: I stopped by Fiore Caffe Miami for brunch and really liked the cozy, cheerful vibe. The avocado toast and pistachio pancakes were delicious and fresh, though the sweet dishes were a bit too sugary for my taste. The place has a nice open layout with a chill, welcoming atmosphere that makes it easy to relax and enjoy your meal. Overall, it’s a great spot for a casual breakfast or brunch in the city.

author: Dr. Jada Santos
review_text: Fiore is a wonderful brunch spot! The space is so pretty and welcoming, the service is quick, and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. Perfect place for a relaxing weekend brunch — I’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Ana Maria Carrillo
review_text: Fiore had great food, service and vibes! Our server Cristina took great care of us and was very sweet and attentive. The food was soo good and the cocktails were original and savory. I got the crispy chicken tacos and my partner the chicken waffles and they were both delicious. Would definitely come back whenever I am back in Miami!!

author: Yvette Caamano
review_text: Had the Pistachio Pancakes, they were so fluffy and delicious. Server Patricia was so nice everyone that was in close proximity was very friendly, and the music was good and the whole place was a good vibe.

author: micah Gillette
review_text: Cristina is absolutely amazing!!! She was so helpful with helping us find the best thing on the menu. The coffee is amazing!!! Will definitely be back here next time i’m back in miami.

author: A Jewell
review_text: Traveled for a weekend trip to Miami with a friend and stopped in for brunch on a Sunday morning.  Staff super friendly, service great.  Tiramisu french toast was amazing!  Applewood bacon also incredible.  Coffee surved with warmed froth for a gourmet touch.  Parking ticket for the garage next door was punched as an unexpected but very appreciated surprise.  We definitely recommend.  Definitely will include on the itinerary for the next trip to Miami!

author: Olena Yolkina
review_text: Cozy spot for breakfast or brunch with a stylish vibe and indoor/outdoor seating. Delicious food pancakes, chicken & waffles, avocado toast and excellent coffee. Friendly staff makes it even better.

author: Austin Hollopeter
review_text: Wonderful service! The waitresses were very sweet and accommodating. My wife loved the crispy chicken sandwich and the  pistachio latte was excellent.

author: Stephanie Troncoso
review_text: The restaurant was beautiful. Great food, clean space, and Christine was so kind and helpful. We would definitely return and recommend the space.

author: Dion Harris
review_text: We were visiting Miami for a cruise and this was our first stop from the hotel. Wasn’t anyone in there so we were skeptical but it was a very good experience. The food was amazing and so was the service.

author: Jouni Tiitola
review_text:
Nice little cafe with friendly service.
Thank You Maria for taking care of me!
I had waffles and chicken, perfect combination and chicken was tasty & crispy.

author: Rebecca Thurston
review_text: I love the retro/modern girly vibe - light pinks and florals with an old diner style! Breakfast was delicious, so if you like Nutella, I suggest those pancakes. The warm syrup combined very well with the Nutella for flavor and a non sticky texture. I also observed the servers working together to maintain the cleanliness of the restaurant.

author: Kalle Granada Starholt
review_text: Five stars! The Tuna Toast was incredibly fresh and delicious. Crema Gourmet has such a great vibe and the service was excellent. Perfect spot for a quick bite or a chill hangout. Highly recommend!

author: סברינה בלהסן-נימצוביץ
review_text:
Créma should have been the best place for coffee. It was not. Not for coffee nor for food.
The coffee was awful, the Greek salad was a shame to the Greek cuisine and the tuna sandwich was served in a baguette which has seen better days.(maybe it was tasty yesterday)
However the stuff tried its best to improve the feeling,
but if the foundation isn’t good, no service in the world will help.

author: Lexxi
review_text: From the UK came to Miami on holiday and stopped off here for lunch. Lovely place very cosy vibe and lots on the menu. I had pancakes scrambled eggs and bacon it was very delicious! Tried some of the pastas too and they were also great. The strawberry oat matcha was the best matcha I think I’ve ever had.

author: Camila S
review_text:
I was really excited to try Crema Gourmet because the bowls look great, but I left disappointed. For the price ($24), the portion of chicken was shockingly small. The bowl itself had a decent amount of quinoa and veggies, but the protein — which should be the main part of the meal — was barely a few thin slices.
It felt unbalanced and not worth what they charge. If Crema wants to keep customers coming back, they really need to increase the chicken portion to match the price ($24) and the rest of the bowl. Unfortunately, I wouldn’t order this again.

author: Reyvis Soto
review_text: This place is great overall . I would and will come back hopefully the pistachio croissant will be warm this time. I had a latte with the croissant and has a nice presentation and taste good also , atmosphere is very welcoming relaxed feel. Staff seems to be also very good.

author: Linda Nador
review_text: We had Americanos, which were perfect, perfectly brewed and delicious.  We also had a cinnamon stone and a blueberry scone. The scones are softer than typical scones, but I enjoyed them that way, it was different l.

author: Jet Vargas
review_text: Crema Downtown Miami is a great spot with a clean and cozy environment that feels very inviting. The music creates a relaxing vibe, and the food was absolutely on point—everything I tried was fresh and delicious. However, parking in the area is definitely a challenge, which is something to keep in mind if you're driving. Overall, it’s a wonderful place to unwind or grab a bite if you’re in the area. Highly recommended for the atmosphere and quality!

author: Max Reid.
review_text: It’s more about the name and pretty photos than real flavor or good customer service. The service leaves a lot to be desired—it feels cold, unprofessional, and indifferent. The coffee is basically watered down; my friend ordered a cappuccino and what he got was more like cappuccino tea, completely diluted. Bottom line: it’s not worth coming to a place that’s just a pretty front for reviews but fails at the basics.

author: janice bush
review_text: Beautiful atmosphere it’s always clean and neat. The staff and s very friendly and professional. The food is prepared hot and fresh

author: Jennifer Shannon
review_text:
I loved this place! Will come back and go again if ever in town!
Breakfast food was really good! Can tell it’s homemade and high quality ingredients. They have a nice selection. And good coffee options as well!
It is on the pricier side but anything near the ports are expensive.

author: Jess Wills
review_text: A must stop place for breakfast and/or coffee!! The food was fresh and had amazing flavor! If you like feta cheese, the Greek Omelette is amazing! Clean and nice vibe! Employees are polite and kind!

author: Maria Vasquez
review_text: I went today with my coworkers for the first time to this place and I'm sure will be the last one. The costumer service was awful, the 15% of gratitude is included and they do not deserved it, besides that the food is nothing special and too expensive, I ordered a croissant breakfast sandwich and It was so small that it looks like a free sample. I definitely do not recommend this place.

author: Camila Luque
review_text: All was excellent! Perfect spot for Sunday’s breakfast. The service was amazing, ice latte and orange juice on point! We ordered the salmon bagel and the classic breakfast with two eggs. The chocolate croissant was delicious. I love that they are pet friendly 🩵 very familiar ambiance. We will be back!

author: Meg
review_text: Fantastic atmosphere and service. They have indoor and outdoor seating. The chai latte was divine.

author: David Herrera
review_text:
Awesome place, great coffee and great food.
A relaxing atmosphere and the A/C is 💯.

author: Amanda Herro (Mandy)
review_text:
Great spot for quick, delicious brunch! There’s plenty of seating with an L-shaped bar, couches, tons of tables and outdoor seating. Your walk up to order then the  food is brought to the table quickly.

I ordered the Croissant Breakfast Sandwich with egg. It was delicious and far more than I could possibly eat in one sitting.

My fiancé ordered the Open faced Breakfast Sandwich and he loved everything, but said the bacon was especially good!

It’s a little pricey, but on par for the area and well worth the money!

author: Evelyn Sanchez
review_text: Good food and friendly service. Polite manager, Juan checked in on us and made sure everything was going well. Nice experience in general, little pricey though.

author: Brian B
review_text: Overall it was not a bad spot for a coffee.  I had the cortado, which was actually presented very well.  The prices were not horrible on the coffee.  I had the turkey omelette, and was not particularly impressed.  It was bland.

author: Inna Fedorchuk
review_text:
It's late at night and I NEED to go back here. Specifically the iced matcha was delicious. They had the perfect ratio. It was a sweetened matcha (3 scoops which was perfect!).
The coffee was also so so good. The vibes amazing. Very clean. I want to come back and I'll be dreaming about till morning.

author: Ian Hartley
review_text: Maybe not the fastest. But probably the best    The atmosphere is beyond 5 stars.   Definitely worth trying out if you are in the downtown area   The food here is amazing as well.  Great breakfast stop

author: Regina Gray
review_text: Good food and service. Our waiter was really helpful with describing the food options on the menu. The portions were suitable and the food was good! I was with a group and we shared get a an idea of how the menu items tasted. One notable dish was the Lobster Mac-N-Cheese.  Judging the crowd and atmosphere, I think it’s a great place to go out on a date. The restaurant also has a DJ which brings a great vibe to the restaurant.

author: Sabrina C. (Bri)
review_text:
We were a party of four with no reservation on a Saturday night and waited about 20 minutes at the bar for a table to open up. The restaurant is small and every table was taken, but they still managed to accommodate us.

Service was good, though a bit on the slow side. The food, however, was excellent! We ordered jerk wings, jerk skewers, fries, plantains, and curry oxtails. The jerk was perfectly spicy and did not disappoint.

A live DJ played a great mix of Caribbean music, Afrobeats, and R&B. The dim lighting created an intimate atmosphere, while the music added a fun, lively vibe. It’s definitely a great spot for date night or an evening out with friends. Highly recommend and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Cindy Ronald
review_text: What a great find! Our group of four walked in without a reservation to this intimate Jamaican restaurant, and were accommodated. Our server, Jimmy was great explaining the dishes and offering advice. Food was delicious! This is definitely a repeat spot when we return.

author: Nick Shaw
review_text:
Mangrove was HANDS DOWN one of the BEST places I’ve ever been to eat. The food was outstanding, portions were generous, and the atmosphere was great.

We received excellent service from Wensley who served us two days in a row, he was polite, patient, and took great care of our whole team.

The Chef himself also came out to greet us and shake ALL our hands which is a level of service you rarely receive from restaurants.

Any time I visit Miami I’ll be coming to Mangrove! 🇯🇲

author: aspen inouye
review_text: Everything about this restaurant is perfect!! We celebrated a birthday and it couldn’t have been a better night. The service was impeccable! Jamie was a star and took time to converse, get to know us, ask us if we needed anything, and was always there to create a wonderful experience - he even asked the DJ to play a very nice birthday song!! The food was incredible and to die for!! The jerk chicken and shrimp salad were fantastic options. The chicken was so flavorful and juicy and paired perfectly with the sweet rice and peas. The shrimp salad was refreshing and had a tasty dressing. The vibes inside are very cool. Will definitely be coming back here again.

author: Cynthia Streater
review_text: I really enjoyed everything here. Atmosphere, food, drinks, service, and music everything was spot on. I attended solo during a spontaneous trip to Miami and fortunately got Marybelle as my bartender. Her inviting demeanor, great conversation, service and DRINKSSS  really stamped my visit. Service was phenomenal, kudos to Marybelle and the chef truly made my night. Highly recommend this spot ladies 💕

author: A.K. Everyday
review_text: Visiting Miami, I was celebrating my 50th bday and wanted a lowkey, speakeasy vibe. I wanted good food, music, and good vibes. Vicky made this experience top notch! She was pleasant, kind, knowledgeable about flavor profiles. The cocktails and food were top tier. Shoutout to the chef too!  Much love -A.K.

author: Andre Denman
review_text: BABY/BRAH! When I say we loved this place. I’m not exaggerating. The music, the food, the decor, and service was top notch. We had traditional plate with lobster Mac. OMG it was all good. Ordered desert just because. My wife was humming, bobbing her head, and eatting it all up and so was I. Just go here!!! (I took the pictures of food after we had piled up our plates.

author: Dr. Egheosa Igbinoba
review_text: The food was delicious. The DJ was spinning throwback R&B. Great atmosphere. We had to wait for about 15 mins since we didn't have a reservation but that wasn't bad at all. There were outdoor seats so we didn't have to stand while waiting.

author: Mia Settles
review_text: My server Wensley was knowledgeable of the menu and most importantly, personable. I ordered the crispy cauliflower, Rasta Pasta with Jerk Chicken and Pineapple Plaintains. EVERYTHING was fresh, cooked to order and most importantly, tasted AMAZING!!! If you’re on the fence on whether to visit or not, my suggestion is do.  I wish I lived in Miami so I can visit again!

author: Aneisha Huggins
review_text: The ambiance was fantastic, and the food portions and taste were truly impressive. The drinks were decent, although they could offer more options.The frozen drink was a bit disappointing, but anything on the rocks seemed to be quite good. The staff was friendly, and the music was amazing. Overall, this place is a great choice for a great dining experience.

author: Chanel G
review_text: This hands-down has been one of my favorite dining experiences in Miami. I was blown away by the service, the food, the ambience, the music, a 10 out of 10 experience  I was just so happy to be there. It is the perfect place to go especially for date nights. It’s also really cute to take pictures. The prices are amazing. The quality of food is superb. I cannot wait to go back to this place. It was truly amazing and I’m vegan. They had so many vegan options for me and that also meant a lot. I had the vegan Rasta pasta. With pineapple plantain's. My friend had the rice with salmon and jerk fries.

author: Raneesha Jackson
review_text: I love the atmosphere & aesthetic. I love how dark & moody the vibes were. I enjoyed the music and live DJ. Jimmy was very pleasant, he went above and beyond with exceptional customer service. I would highly recommend this restaurant to everyone. Also most importantly the food was finger licking good. Don’t forget to try the rum cake! You won’t regret it.

author: Nisha Upadya
review_text: Food was good, but service was so awful it didn’t make up for it. First, the server disappeared for an extended period of time and another server had to go and find him. Once we had ordered, the dish I got was not what I was expecting. I had ordered the Rasta pasta vegan which I assumed had vegan protein with it. My pasta that came only had vegetables. I’m sorry but what vegetable is worth an extra $8????? Then, my friend ordered the chicken and was charged for the vegan which is more expensive. When we pointed it out to the waiter, he fought with us until I just paid for the food anyways to get out of there fast. Once I left, I realized that the vegan provably did entail vegan protein and they had just left it off when they gave me my meal. It’s extremely frustrating paying extra for something that you don’t receive and having a server who doesn’t take the time to explain the menu or clarify what you are hoping for… or at least that the food actually comes. I would probably not come back again. Disappointing and overpriced restaurant. What a rip off.

author: Roche Whittle
review_text:
Went to Mangrove to celebrate a birthday and it definitely hit the mark for an intimate dining spot with a nice vibe. They had a live dj with good music bumping; loud for low volume table conversation. Our server, Jimmy, was super attentive and made sure we enjoyed everything. We were first seated at a middle table for two but asked to move to a booth; they were very accommodating about it.

For apps, we ordered the wings, lobster mac, and patty. Then came the mains: curry oxtail, jerk fried rice, rice and peas, and pineapple plantains. Loved how most of the food came out hot. Everything was flavorful, and sooo good. To finish it off, we had the ice cream and rum cake—light, fluffy, not too sweet, and just the right amount of rum to keep it moist at the bottom.

Overall, a great Jamaican cuisine spot for great food, good service, and an elevated vibe.

author: Nicole Heyliger
review_text: What can I say about Mangrove but AMAZING!!! From the time we walked into the speak easy vibe where the warm intimate atmosphere made us feel welcomed, the host and servers made the dinning experience even better.  When I say this place is a must it definitely is.  Shareable plates we tried were lobsta Mac and cheese and lamb chops 👍🏽 flavors very good.  Entrees Rasta pasta and oxtails and drinks red red wine delicious, bel  kreati and the hot stepper I’d recommend.

author: christine solomon
review_text: We had such a great experience at Mangrove while celebrating a birthday! From the moment we walked in, Wesley and Aaliyah were phenomenal—welcoming, attentive, and super helpful with menu recommendations. I tried the lobster mac (10/10!) and the citrus champagne salmon, which was absolutely amazing. The drinks were delicious too, giving off that perfect Caribbean, island vibe. To top it all off, we had the butter rum cake for dessert—it was to die for! Great food, great people, and such a vibe overall. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Suzet Lora
review_text: Jimmy was our server. He was wonderful!! The ambience is quaint. The food…OMG…I have no words to describe. You must experience yourself. It’s the most delicious food you have ever had,

author: Ashleigh Walker
review_text: Visited on Christmas Eve and had a great experience. We ordered the Rasta Pasta (both the vegetarian version and the one with jerk chicken) along with the snapper, and everything was absolutely delicious. Authentic Jamaican flavor and large portions.  The atmosphere was warm and inviting. The manager was so nice and friendly and gave great recommendations, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend!

author: KC
review_text: We didn't have reservations, but the host still seated us anyway.  I had the most delicious birthday dinner. Thank you Mangrove!🫶🏾🙏🏽🎂💖🎉🎊💯

author: K
review_text:
I discovered this spot by accident. I was in the elevator at my hotel and saw a couple holding takeout bags from the restaurant. The food smelled so good that I Googled the name on the bag right there. It ended up being just a block or two away, so I walked over.

I’m so glad I did. The food was fresh, well-seasoned, and full of flavor. Hospitality was A1. There isn’t a lot of seating, but I was still able to sit and enjoy my meal.

The playlist was on point too — good tunes, good vibes.  It’s a small but cozy comfort spot with real Jamaican soul-food energy ( vegetarian options as well)

I ordered jerk fried rice ( bussin!)  with oxtail (so tender fell right off the bone) , shrimp, cabbage, sweet plantains, jerk mac and cheese, a beef patty, and a drink. My total was around $60, and it was worth it. The portions were big, and I even had leftovers the next day, which still tasted amazing.

Definitely a spot I’d recommend — flavor and vibes A1. I usually dint write reviews but I had to give this place its flowers - I’ll def visit again !

author: AZ Dad2day
review_text:
Wonderful  Jamaican. restaurant in Miami.
Great location
Very clean establishment with plenty of seating in back!
The interior is fun and has an exciting Jamaican vibe!
The service from Willie was outstanding and he is an example of hard work for the whole staff!
The food was excellent. Everything is made fresh!
The Jerk Mac n Cheese was absolutely delicious!
Definitely a must try for all!

author: Johnnie Gold
review_text: Ordered food from here via Uber Eats. They had a Buy1 get 1 free on Jerk Chicken. I am Jamaican. This place did not disappoint. The food was fresh and flavourful. I was surprised at how fast it was delivered to my hotel. From the pictures online, they restaurant seems new and clean.

author: Nikki Williams
review_text: Food is always good they give love portions. Only downfall about my last visit is that the manager was yelling at the lady fixing my bowl. Saying her friendship with the cashier will cost her her job and continued to yell at her and chastise her in front of everyone. That was a conversation that should have been had in private not in front of a full restaurant.

author: Melody Timothee
review_text: Today was my 2nd visit at Jrk and man was it great I had to leave a honest review. I got a curry chicken and my partner got the oxtail. We both loved our meals. Greg at behind the register was extremely kind and greeted me once I walked in. The portion I received was crazy, closing my lid was difficult. Just a 10/10 experience. Thanks to this team for amazing food, service and overall experience!

author: Hands Off
review_text:
When I walked in, there was no visible menu, and the woman at the counter was on the phone talking extremely loud. I stood there confused until I grabbed a paper menu—only for her to tell me it was a catering menu and then direct me to the food area. She said it was “like Chipotle,” where you choose your items as you go, but the problem is you can’t even see the prices until you’re at the end of the line.

I picked my rice, protein, and veggies. I asked for plantains first and then broccoli—all in one bowl. After the server put the broccoli on (only two small pieces, by the way), he told me afterward that it was extra. When I said something, he suggested taking it off — after it was already on my food. At that point, I was just over it and said, “No worries,” but he started acting annoyed, as if it was my fault.

Then we moved on to the sauces — no utensils, no napkins, nothing offered. I just grabbed my food and left laughing in disbelief. I was honestly so upset. I paid $12 for parking just to eat here was $18, and after a long overnight shift, this was supposed to be my one good meal of the day. Instead, I left frustrated, hungry, and disappointed.

The food wasn’t even good — mostly bones, barely any meat, and the rice had no flavor, just oxtail sauce poured over it. This didn’t feel like a real Jamaican restaurant at all it’s just for simps who leave the corporate world and Go down for lunch - you’re better off packing your own. Even the woman up front said, “It’s like Chipotle.” Honestly, that says it all because I thought I was at JRK! =/ P.S Sloppy work putting my food in the bag btw smh There was another woman who experiencing the same as me and we talked in the parking lot it’s ridiculous.

author: Yemani Mason
review_text:
We had such an amazing experience at Jrk Restaurant! From the moment we walked in, Samantha, the host, went above and beyond to accommodate our large party of a dozen people. She was warm, organized, and made sure everything flowed smoothly, which made our lunch stress-free and enjoyable.

The food was fantastic with so much variety, there truly was something for everyone at the table. As a vegan, I was especially impressed with the delicious options available for me, and my non vegan family were just as happy with their meals. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.

Between the incredible hospitality from Samantha and the diverse, flavorful menu, Jrk! has definitely become one of my favorite spots in Miami. Highly recommend!

author: Charmaine Rosado
review_text: I visited here back in the end of August with my 3 cousins. We are from NY and was there in Miami visiting before our cruise. All of the food was exceptional!! So flavorful and fresh!! Some of the best Caribbean food I've ever had including my time in Jamaica. We fell in love at every bite!! That jerk chicken Mac n cheese is a thing of beauty!!! The staff was super friendly and really treated us so nice. We talked about it during our whole cruise and wanted to go back after the cruise but was scared we wouldn't make our flight in time. Highly recommend trying everything like we did!! Lol You won't regret it!! Lots of food and reasonably priced. 💯💯💯💯

author: Belkys Diaz
review_text: Downtown spot across from courthouse as food is limited in this area if u her for jury duty. Place is cool has seating in back I ate here 2 days in row and picked up to go home so it was pretty good. My only issue is the rice was not hot or warm just room temperature. Taste was good and service n all was great.

author: Aaliyah Reese
review_text: My friend and I had just hopped off our cruise looking for some Miami food to eat and stumbled across JRK. We got the Jerk Patties and coffee and EVERYTHING WAS DELICIOUS!!! Probably one of the best jerk patties I've ever had!! And the guy in the front is extremely nice and welcoming!!  I will definitely be back at the establishment 🤩

author: Zari St Jean
review_text: The place you hope to find when you think of getting Caribbean food in the middle of a major metropolitan city like Miami. Hopes that the food isn't gentrified and over priced. Coming from someone who traveled on the brightline on a budget being able to walk from the station 3 blocks and get a plentiful meal, while enjoying the music and atmosphere of Jrk. It has set the bar high for Caribbean food. From a Caribbean born woman. The spice level is amazing.

author: Maria Pellini
review_text:
I had Jury duty today and had no idea of where to go for lunch and saw this place across the street and decided to give it a try. The place appears small when you walk in to place your order but there is a good amount of seating in the back.

This place was a pleasant surprise. It was the first time to try Jamaican food and wow what incredible flavors. The staff was very friendly and welcoming and quick to serve. I had the jerk fried rice with jerk chicken, topped with curry sauce, cabbage slaw, mango pineapple salsa with the jerk ranch. You can make your own combo of protein, toppings and sauces. There are helpful signs right where you have your choices to let you know what is available and how many items come with a purchase and what the extra cost are if you should order more.

The portions are incredibly, and the prices are more than reasonable. After you order you can take your food to go in a sturdy bag or choose to eat it in a room in the back. I chose to eat my food there because I had time and I found it to be very comfortable and a very enjoyable atmosphere with interesting surroundings to look at. So happy to have made the time to eat here.

author: Charles Lowman
review_text: This place is phenomenal! The best lunch I have had in a really long time!  The spices on the jerk chicken blew my mind.  It was pure heaven. The plantains were perfect in every way…. Slightly caramelized on the outside, a bit sweet, with warm spices to complement.  The environment was also exceptional. The well trained staff and the beautiful decor made me feel so welcome. It was a pleasure to dine here.  I hope you will go check them out very soon!

author: Monifa
review_text:
Let me start by saying… I love Jamaican food!!
Every time I come to Miami from Trinidad, I make sure to get some. ( this was my first time trying here - JRK)

Today, the food was great no complaints there. HOWEVER… the customer service experience was horrible.

The lady working at the front was screaming at the staff the entire time. OMG!!!
The workers were actually moving fast and doing their best packing Uber Eats, handling in-store customers, everything! But her attitude? Terrible. She absolutely needs an attitude check ASAP.

I don’t know what was happening behind the scenes, but there is NO REASON to speak to employees like that, especially in front of customers. It was uncomfortable and unprofessional.

Honestly, because of her, I may never return. The food was great, but customer service matters too.

author: Mark Roberts
review_text: So not your typical style of serving Jamaican food.  However, it was still good  The jerk chicken had good flavor and the complimentary sauces give it a modern twist. I am big on customer service. However the last two times I was there it seems like I was begging them for a favor to serve me. They were more interested in talking to each other undecided amongst themselves who will serve the next customer

author: Marika de Nie
review_text:
The Jamaican Jerk wrap aka Roti. Was absolutely delicious! I’m a big foodie and I love West Indian/Caribbean food. The flavors were amazing. I had it with the cabbage mango salsa. And the plantain that had cinnamon spice.
The flavors were absolute magic in my mouth . The only downfall, but I didn’t give it a lower rating. Because everything was so good everything was so clean and great service. Was I wished it was a real authentic roti wrap versus a tortilla wrap. With the flavors made up for it. I will order from there again.

author: Katy Rodríguez
review_text: This was my first time here and from the moment I walked in I felt welcomed!  They helped me understand the menu, let me take my time and were extremely helpful.  Well, when I got to the dining area it was absolutely gorgeous!!  I felt relaxed and at home even… then came the food!!!  I have eaten jerk chicken in Jamaica and I think all over the Caribbean and the jerk chicken here has to be one of the best jerk chicken I’ve ever had in my life!!  I was also lucky enough to have gotten the shrimp (at an extra cost, but completely worth it!!). This restaurant has got by far the best Jamaican food I have ever had in my life!!!!  The service from everyone including the bartenders is superb I recommend this restaurant to anyone who is in Downtown Miami looking for a good time and AMAZING JAMAICAN FOOD!!!!!!!

author: Diamond Taylor
review_text: Visited JRK! with colleagues from county government and had a fantastic experience. The staff kindly let us in early so we didn’t have to wait in the hot sun—super hospitable. They plated each order with care, accommodating everyone’s dietary needs. I had the jerk shrimp with jasmine rice—absolutely delicious. The sweet virgin margaritas were a hit too. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Honest Reviewer From DC
review_text:
Hands down the most amazing Jamaican food I've had that wowed me. I wish they had a bigger seating area to go out for dates.

Definitely recommend 5/5 I love the jerk mac N Chz. The pineapple plantains were to die for. My favorite thing about this place was that they had glass bottled water.

author: Breanna Wade
review_text: Very good Jamaican food! Love the ay you can customize your meal

author: Christabella
review_text: This was such a pleasant surprise! We were going to the HistoryMiami museum and stumbled upon it and decided to stop in. I think they have their usual crowd and we were unexpected so their initial reaction to us was sort of caustic but that changed quickly and we were seated and served with no issues. Service was great and so was the food. It was more home cooked meals vibes than “restaurant-grade”. Very generous portions and fairly priced as well.

author: SJ Hosin
review_text: The description of "straightforward menu" is very accurate. Cuban bread was crispy and fresh with lots of butter. Guarapo is my go-to drink here (yes I know). I was seated quickly, everyone was friendly and I ate well.

author: Astrida McFarland
review_text:
Yesterday I met up with a friend for lunch and she suggested Cacique. I had never been there and wanted to check it out. Cacique has been around for many years in downtown Miami and has kept its Cuban vibe.   It is very popular with the county employees  because of its close location, good food, and reasonable prices. It is casual and the staff are friendly. It is always busy there. They do have  table service.

I ordered the Vaca Frita with black beans and rice. It was good but not the best that I have had.  My friend ordered a Tuna Sandwich with fries. Hers was good also. Our server was super nice. Service was prompt and friendly by Nina.

Parking is not the easiest because it is in the business district, but there are parking garages nearby.

author: Nuhn ya Biz
review_text:
I recently visited Cacique Restaurant with my coworkers, and we had a delightful experience. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it an ideal spot for both casual and fine dining.

We started our meal with the Philly sandwich, accompanied by fresh French fries. The sandwich was flavorful, with tender meat and melted cheese, while the fries were crispy and well-seasoned. Additionally, we tried the protein shake, which was both refreshing and satisfying.

The highlight of our visit was the exceptional service. The servers were incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring that our dining experience was enjoyable from start to finish.

Overall, Cacique Restaurant offers delicious food, a pleasant ambiance, and top-notch service. I highly recommend it for anyone looking to enjoy a memorable meal

author: Ryan Hulme
review_text: We found this place accidentally but were glad to do so. It was a nice atmosphere and friendly service, with very tasty Cuban sandwiches and smoothies. They also do daily special menus, which was cool.

author: Deana McDonald
review_text: The food is always amazing with great service. Never disappointed.

author: Noesha
review_text:
Would give this place zero stars if I could my first impression was a huge cockroach when I was going into the restroom. Rude waitresses and the “owner” scolded me and my fiancé when I told him I did not enjoy the food.

Update: This was my second time of me giving the restaurant another try and still horrible quality food and horrible customer service. At least have some new cutlery that hadn’t been used the whole “40 years” you’ve been in business.

author: Ash Kash
review_text: I love their food I been going to this restaurant since 2019 best customer service ever & best Cuban food in town

author: Jim Uren
review_text:
Terrific local place near the Courthouse and Main Library.
I had a Cuban sandwich in Cuban bread with a cafe con leche. Tasty, fairly priced and service was friendly and efficient.

author: Jose Cegarra
review_text: I love it the food of here, great flavors y very fresh and low price!

author: John Nott
review_text:
Excellent latin fare in downtown miami, near the courts. Affordable good quality and prompt service.
Been eating there for 20 years. No complaints. I recommend the rabo encendido.

author: Corey Collins
review_text: Wow, Cacique Restaurant is such a gem! The vibe is super chill, perfect for grabbing a quick bite. The staff is friendly and always up for a chat. I loved their fresh juices—totally refreshing! Can’t wait to go back! 112 W Flagler St, Miami, FL 33130. 🌟

author: En Alvarez
review_text: I had an amazing experience here it was my first time and I felt right at home they are very catering to the lunch crowd that has to be done by a certain time to get back to work. The food was very reasonably priced especially for the area and I was treated with the utmost love and respect. There is a reason why they have been around for over 15 years I will be coming back it was an amazing experience

author: Sabrina Freeman
review_text: Just popped into Cacique Restaurant on Flagler St, and wow! The vibe is super chill, perfect for grabbing a coffee or a quick bite. Staff was super friendly and totally made my day. Gonna be a regular here for sure! ☕🍴

author: Michelle Siggers
review_text: Went there on the word of a co-worker but also from a taste test before seeing type of thing. I experienced the food many weeks earlier from a delivery situation it was very delicious. So, I had to visit and experience the food firsthand. They did not disappoint, from the fast service of the bar/waitresses, the cashier/owner working the register so his employees can focus on the tasks at hand, and to the friendly customers waiting to be served. It was all really nice and a welcoming sight to see at 6 in the morning.

author: K
review_text:
Food, service, and staff are all great. They have delicious daily specials and a great selection of food to choose from on the menu. Prices are fair in regards to its location. Every person who works here is extremely attentive and makes sure that they satisfy any of your meal needs.

I would say price wise, it's ok for being pretty deep in downtown Miami. You can't expect the lowest prices for the area, but for what you get with your meal it's pretty good.

The only con, I'd say, is the overuse of fans and AC indoors. On some seats, your food will get a bit colder quicker than others.

author: claudia sandoval
review_text: Thank you for making my mother soooo happy on her 76 birthday. The food was delicious and Hilda, our waitress was very kind and helpful with all the needs of our group.

author: Carolyn Bradford
review_text: Took my 18 year old son to eat breakfast where I used to eat breakfast when I was pregnant with him when I worked downtown however the food wasn't as good anymore neither was the atmosphere. However our waitress was very sweet. I probably will not go back

author: abe valdez
review_text: The prices are all different. When you go to their website its a price, when you call for delivery, its a different price, when you walk in and actually sit down, its a different price. I informed a worker that the prices are ALL different and she told me that "Everything has gone up".. please be consistent.

author: Cary Rich
review_text:
I was early for a business meeting nearby and had not had breakfast yet.  I was told that Cacique was THE place that all of the nearby construction crews dine at.  So I tried it.

Great, friendly service and wonderful food.

I highly recommend it!

author: Alena Neuimina
review_text:
We had an amazing experience at Casa Nova, and a huge part of it was thanks to our waiter Marco.
