Everything was absolutely delicious, but Marco truly made the night special. Attentive, friendly, professional, with perfect timing and great recommendations — you can tell he genuinely cares about guests and loves what he does.

Hands down, the best waiter we’ve had in a long time. If you’re coming here, ask for Marco — he’s the best. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Krtvi Nambiar
review_text:
We had an excellent experience at Casa Neos! Dubi was an incredible server with the kindest, humorous personality! She gave us all the good recommendations and kept our family entertained throughout our special Christmas dinner.

For food - highly recommend the branzino fish! A total masterpiece that everyone should experience. The baklava dessert was also a must!

author: Sofie Bri
review_text: I had such a great experience at Casa Neos! The customer service was top-notch—friendly, helpful, and truly cared about making sure everything went smoothly. Marcelle was AMAZING; he was professional, kind, and made the best recommendations. The quality of the food exceeded my expectations, and everything was made fresh and beautifully presented. I highly suggest the delicious and tender lobster pasta and also the grilled branzino. We sat outside and watched the boats go by. I’ll definitely be returning and recommending them to others. Keep up the amazing work!

author: Nunu Wastape
review_text:
I finally visited Casa Neos and I can totally see why this spot never disappoints—it's quickly become my new favorite restaurant. The moment you step in, the atmosphere is a complete vibe, making you feel like you've been transported to Mykonos. Sitting down to dinner with a beautiful view of the boats and the water made the entire evening feel extra special. I would definitely advise making a reservation, especially if you’re planning on going for their popular Saturday brunch.

The service is genuinely top-notch. Our server, like all the staff, was incredibly attentive and went the extra mile to make the experience perfect, offering great suggestions throughout the meal. The cocktails are amazing, and the food is nothing short of phenomenal. We ordered a selection of items like the rigatoni pasta and grilled asparagus, sharing plates as they were prepared, which is a great way to dine here.

But you absolutely cannot skip dessert. The Baklava here is truly one of the best I’ve had in a very long time—a spectacular way to complete the meal. With its delicious food, strong drinks, and incredible ambiance, Casa Neos is the perfect choice for a beautiful night out or a celebration. I’ll definitely be back soon, and often!

author: Carolina Tamara
review_text: Sammy was the best!! We had a party of 5 and he was on top of everything we needed. Our glasses were never empty and his recommendations were top notch. The food is delicious! Family style. The cocktails are exceptional. Lastly the baklava was so yum! Will definitely be back for their brunch and other special occasions.

author: Marie Bréguet
review_text:
I had an amazing experience at Casa Neos! The ambiance was beautiful and welcoming, and the staff went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. Having dinner with a beautiful view of the boats and the water made the entire evening feel extra special. Every dish was full of flavor and so thoughtfully prepared. The truffle pasta was my favorite !
For dessert, the lava cake was to die for!
It’s rare to find a place where the atmosphere, service, and food all shine equally.
I would definitely advise making a reservation, especially if you’re planning on going on Sunday.
Casa Neos truly delivers. I can’t wait to come back!

author: Joan Dor
review_text: Aniel was absolutely amazing from start to finish. He was incredibly attentive, knowledgeable, and made me feel welcomed the moment I arrived. As it was my first time here, he took the time to explain everything thoroughly, answered all of my questions with patience, and made sure I felt comfortable and taken care of throughout the entire experience. His professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care truly stood out and made my visit unforgettable. Because of Aniel, my first experience here was nothing short of amazing, and I will definitely be returning.

author: L YT
review_text:
Exquisite, they are NOT playing.

We made reservations a few days ahead for a Friday dinner, we got seated right away. Our server Jade is really professional and demonstrates what true hospitality means.

AMBIENCE
This place is upscale and clean, very beautiful and faces the water, where you could come in with yachts.

DRINKS
We ordered a cocktail while waiting for the food, this is delicious. I love coconut and hates champagne, but this IS SO GOOD. It's unique, special and tasty.

Sailing Day  (11/10!!!)
Low ABV | Effervescent | Crisp
Belvedere Vodka, Coconut, Grapefruit, Fig Leaf Tea, Sustainable Champagne, CO2

FOOD
Seabass Carpaccio Del Mare (9.3/10):
/Lemon, Basil Oil, Espelette Pepper/
Seabass im here is so bouncy and super fresh. Love it!

Bluefin Tune Crudo (10/10):
/Lemon Gel, Orange Zest, Espelette Pepper/
Olive oil quality in here is so good, the toro is so fatty + fresh, everything is so well balanced!

[The maki rolls in here are well-played, we picked the top two popular rolls to try out]

Truffle Hamachi (9.7/10)
/Celery Remoulade, Granny Smith, Black Truffle Aioli/
The truffle in here is nice, it adds fragrant and richness to the roll. The hamachi is light and balances perfectly with the truffle, it's fragrant and crunchy and nice. Has depth and layers of taste, a special roll that's not lame at all.

A5 Wagyu 'Aburi' Maki (11/10*)
/Toro, Foie Gras, Unagi Sauce, Orange/
Melts in your mouth. Insane, so nice!

MUST ORDER, I don't know what you're doing if you don't get this. The other rolls are good but this is on a different level!!
The smokiness/ charred flavour in the foie gras just dances perfectly to the fattiness of the savoury Wagyu. It balances out perfectly, the A5 wagyu in here is so soft and fresh. Pure perfection.
-- The beef and the fois gras here are like Adam and Eve!!!

Lobster Pasta (lobster 8.3/10; pasta 7.5/10):
/Maine Grilled Lobster, Spaghetti, San Marzano Tomato, Bisque Emulsion, Basil/

Good but not fantastic great. The lobster is fresh and presentation is nice, the pasta itself didn't quite scratch the itch, the taste is quite straight forward lacking depth/ surprise? I think it could be benefited by adding touch of bread crumbs as garnish to add some texture. Maybe should've tried the truffle pasta instead? Out of all the things we ordered other than than the salad this is my least favourite one, still quite good just not insane

Mediterranean Grilled Artichoke  (9/10):
/Mint-Basil Gremolata, Koroneiki EVOO, Lemon Gel/
Made in the right way, a veggie dish that tastes like meat. Seasoned nicely, grilled the right way. It's my first time to try artichoke, but I'd recommend if you like it. We got this to pair with the lobster pasta.

Golden Summer Salad (7.5/10):
/Bibb Lettuce, Castelfranco Radicchio, Fennel, Avocado, Sumac-Orange Vinaigrette/
Nice presentation. It's just a salad tho, nothing is crazy about it. No thick sauce so it's quite refreshing and crisp. You can probably get other salad of your choice and preference.

Chocolate Lava Cake 10.5/10): (GET IT!!)
/Calisson Ice Cream/
This tastes literally like it won't make you fat, love the richness of the dark chocolate in the lava cake, it's melty in the inside. Perfect texture. The ice cream that comes with it is a work of art!!

THOUGHTS
I think Casa Neos is definitely not overrated it depends what you order, I came across some reviews on social media where they say it's underwhelming for the high-end dining experience. Everything we ordered, we are still mesmerised with the taste.

SERVICE
Our server Jade is super professional with her culinary expertise and knowledge of the menu to drinks. She curated our menu for the night and nothing misses. She shows what true hospitality is, service is top notch. Attentive and professional with food knowledge.

Not sure about party in here (would love to come back to experience that), but the dining experience is 200% recommended.

author: Kelly Rodriguez
review_text: Derek at Casa Neos delivered truly exceptional service from start to finish. He was attentive without being intrusive, incredibly knowledgeable about the menu, and made thoughtful recommendations that elevated our entire dining experience. His timing was perfect, his energy was warm and professional, and he made us feel genuinely welcomed rather than just “served.” It’s rare to find a server who balances efficiency with such a personal touch, but Derek did it effortlessly. He played a huge role in making our night memorable, and Casa Neos is lucky to have him. We will absolutely be requesting Derek on our next visit.

author: Eric M
review_text:
The place looks great, right by the river, with a lively vibe and a very hip crowd. On the surface, it feels like it should be a fun spot.

That said, the experience really didn’t match the hype. We had a reservation, but still waited about 20 minutes in line to get in, while staff were letting their own people in like a gang-style setup, cutting the line and walking straight through. It honestly felt more like a smugglers’ had priority ticket to get in. Watching friends and insiders get waved in while paying guests stood outside was extremely disrespectful.

Once inside, we waited another 30 minutes just to be seated and face the extremely unreasonablly priced menue.  A very basic pizza for $65, plus tax and a mandatory 20% tip, is just wild for what you’rey getting.

This place feels more about hype and showing up because everyone else does, not about value or good service. Nice view and energy, but definitely not worth the price. Won’t be coming back.

author: Tasheena S
review_text: We came by for Saturday brunch. I HIGHLY recommend making a reservation. We loved the ambiance here. The service was also amazing. We were seated inside, which was fine. We enjoyed the water views. It’s important to note that dishes are served as they are prepared. So it’s good to order sharable. We had the truffle fries, Salmon, grilled asparagus and the Rigatoni Pasta. Then to complete the meal we had the Baklava for dessert!!! One of the best desserts I’ve had in a long time! Everything was absolutely AMAZING! I would most certainly return.

author: Ivonne Orozco
review_text:
I went to Casa Neos today for my birthday and had such a great time. Our waitress, Mae, was truly the best — super kind, attentive, and made the whole experience feel special. I ordered the pasta and the pizza, and both were delicious. Mae also suggested a drink, and it ended up being amazing — honestly one of the highlights of the meal.
The atmosphere was beautiful, the service was fantastic, and the food was so worth it. I left really happy and celebrated my birthday in the best way. Definitely recommend Casa Neos, especially if you’re lucky enough to get Mae as your server!

author: Adam Eliav
review_text:
This is honestly the most phenomenal restaurant I have ever been to by a mile. The quality of the food, the presentation, the service and the professionalism of the waiters was unbeatable. Every plate we tried encouraged us to eat more.

Namely, Alexander the waiter was friendly and incredibly professional with amazing recommendations.

author: Vamped Aesthetics
review_text: 10/10 recommend Casa Neo! The atmosphere is a vibe, feels like Mykonos! The food is phenomenal and drinks were amazing. Danilo, our server was very attentive, made great recommendations and even comped a glass of prosecco for my birthday. Thank you so much. We’ll be back!

author: Samantha
review_text: This is our new favorite spot! We had such a fantastic dinner experience. We came here to celebrate my wife’s birthday and she was thrilled. We had cocktails, appetizers and even a little sorbet for dessert. I highly recommend this restaurant for a beautiful night out watching boats while enjoying dinner. Mae and Marcell made our experience beyond lovely. They were attentive and suggested great items. We will most definitely be coming back! Ambience, decor, hostess staff, food runners all 5 stars!

author: Engerbert Jordán Gutiérrez
review_text: Everything was delicious and the expectations were exceeded! Umit took care of us and he was amazing. Always making sure we were enjoying our drinks and food. I will definitely recommend everyone to visit Casa Neos for a unique Mediterranean experience.

author: Grekys Ferrer
review_text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The food was extremely delicious, full of flavor, and perfectly prepared. The service was excellent—very attentive, friendly, and professional. Everything was well organized, and we felt truly welcome from start to finish. I would definitely come back and highly recommend this place.

author: Maria Stan
review_text: Excelent restaurant in downtown Miami with great selection of food and amazing service! Ciprian,our somelier made fantastic wine recommendations and  the servers Nikol ,Adi and Chip were fantastic serving and entertaining our table! We will definitely come back with more friends and family! Highly recommended,you will never forget the dinning experience! ❤️

author: vic perez
review_text:
Derek was absolutely amazing! His service was attentive, friendly, and genuinely made our experience unforgettable at Casa Neos. He was very knowledgeable about the menu and helped us choose the perfect dishes and drinks. Everything arrived quickly, and he checked on us just the right amount—not too much, not too little. His energy and professionalism really stood out.

Thank you, Derek, for making our night special! We will definitely be coming back and asking for you again! 🙌✨

author: Konstantin Kuznetsov
review_text:
If you want to be taken advantage of in a cheap way, come as a large group.

I celebrated my birthday at CASA NEOS and overall the food was genuinely good. There were 7 of us, and we ordered the tasting menu. The waiter informed us that the dishes would be served “shared table” style, which was fine.

However, by the 4th course we realized that from the very beginning we had consistently been served 1–2 portions less than we should have received. The most obvious example was the steak course: the tasting menu clearly stated 7 oz per person, yet for a table of 7 we were served only 4 portions instead of 7. After that, it became clear that the same issue applied to other courses as well.

When we raised the question, one of the servers responded with “Don’t worry, you’ll be full” instead of actually addressing how the portions were calculated. About five minutes later, the manager came over, acknowledged that a mistake had indeed been made, and brought out only 2 additional portions, still not matching what was originally included in the menu.

The total bill was around $3,000.

Final impression: great location, excellent food, but very weak service for a restaurant at this level. This is not about money — it’s about the unacceptable attempt to quietly short guests in order to increase margins. That approach is simply not acceptable for a place positioning itself as high-end.

author: Lumar Guittard
review_text:
I had an absolutely unforgettable experience at Sexy Fish. From the moment we arrived, the service was simply outstanding. The level of attention, warmth, and professionalism made us feel genuinely welcomed and taken care of from start to finish.

The food was next level, truly extraordinary. The sushi, especially their specialty selections, was incredibly fresh and full of flavor. The tuna tataki deserves a special mention: the sauces prepared for it were exquisite and elevated the dish to something unforgettable. Every bite was perfectly balanced and beautifully presented.

I would like to give a special and heartfelt thank you to Aysun, who provided what I can honestly say is one of the best dining services I’ve experienced in Miami. Her attention to detail went far beyond the table, from making sure we were enjoying every dish, to thoughtfully guiding us through the space, helping us safely navigate the stairs, and even taking the time to show us the stunning aquarium. Her dedication, kindness, and professionalism were truly exceptional.

I’m leaving with an incredible experience and immense gratitude for the entire team.

The ambiance deserves its own applause. Sexy Fish feels more like an art gallery than a restaurant — every corner is thoughtfully designed, full of detail and beauty. While the venue is well known for its iconic restrooms, the spectacular aquarium completely captivated me and left a lasting impression.

author: Jonilda Seitllari
review_text: Sexy Fish is an experience like no other. The interior design is absolutely insane—every detail is bold, luxurious, and visually stunning. It feels more like stepping into an art installation than a restaurant. The food was just as impressive as the décor—beautifully presented and truly amazing in flavor. From the atmosphere to the cuisine, everything comes together for an unforgettable dining experience. A must-visit spot! ✨🍣

author: Roberts .J06
review_text: The sexy fish! I walked by here quite a few times before I actually went. At night what a vibe! Definitely Miami ! For someone who loves sushi, this place is great! Obviously the decor & atmosphere was something so unique and different! Never been seen before. You def pay for the vibe ! The bathrooms themselves were crazy millions of people taking pictures everywhere. Was a lounge after dark.

author: J Probherbs
review_text:
A lively jaunt with unique decor. Music was not overbearing, I had a reservation and found parking fairly easily. Restrooms are an experience and the staff is attentive and well coordinated.

An interesting manner of ordering food that I can appreciate, their drinks were well made and innovative (my party had 2+ each). One of our sides were delayed but is forgivable as we thoroughly enjoyed our meals, they were well portioned. Visited to celebrate a birthday while in town and would definitely dine here again.

author: carol lebold
review_text:
Definitely an experience both for unbelievably creative food and also art including magnificence everywhere including bano!!! We were told pictures in bathroom and thought that was a joke. Oh no! Definitely incredible art EVERYWHERE!

Be prepared for $$$$ but worth it. Drinks also creative and strong. Food was amazing. Every. Single. Thing.

author: Octav Popescu
review_text:
Sexy Fish is by far the most impressive restaurant I visited in Miami. Reservations are essential and a bit of luck helps too. The food is outstanding, and they offer set menus with multiple dishes, allowing you to choose based on your appetite (and trust me, you’ll definitely get hungry 😅).
The architecture and interior design are stunning, even the restrooms are spectacular.
Overall, this was the best dining experience I had in Miami.

author: callista
review_text: Pleasantly surprised by this restaurant! Went for my birthday during Basel week; very entertaining experience and we were pleasantly surprised by the food quality. Interior of restaurant and bar is very beautiful; they had a DJ and dancers for Art Basel so that was a nice touch. Drinks were nice, I had one cocktail from the menu and a Bees Knees, partner had a Moscow Mule. More of a tapas style, small plates cuisine with some larger dishes. For a sashimi dish, server recommended the Tiradito with Chu Toro and Salmon (?), very delicious with truffle. Thumbs up on the oysters, sushi rolls, Cod Spicy Miso(?), steak, and dessert. Thank you again to our busy server for taking care of us through all the crazy. Overall good experience and I recommend for special occasions or for a nice dinner before a night out.

author: Al Martinez
review_text: Finally went here after 1 year on my todo list. Had the yellowtail nigiri 🍣, tuna sashimi 🍥, spicy beef 🥩 tenderloin, cinnamon donuts 🍩. Golden Riviera for drinks 🍹. The beef tenderloin was phenomenal! Highly recommended! The service was prompt and attentive. Very friendly bartenders especially during busy night. Vibe was great es after the DJ started 🕺. Place is really nicely decorated and fun to hang out at.

author: Katia Bogomolova
review_text:
Carlos CC and Antony M were the two best hospitality personnel I’ve had the pleasure of being served by in Miami by a mile.

Made the whole experience a 12/10.

I will definitely ask for Antony or Carlos next time we come! All their recommendations were delicious

author: Bella Ray
review_text: I have had the pleasure of visiting on a few occasions, and I must say, the atmosphere is truly delightful. The marine design is breathtaking, and enjoy taking pictures in the restrooms because they are like no other. The sweetcorn fried rice and baby chicken are really good, as are the guacamole and Nori chips. The staff is exceptionally pleasant, and it is worth noting that the dress code requirements are somewhat more relaxed during brunch and lunch hours. Self-parking is available during the day, with valet service provided in the evenings. For those visiting Miami, please exercise caution and be mindful of pedestrians when driving in this area.

author: Fatima Masud
review_text: Lovely art deco ish ambience. Great service and good food. The chocolate dessert and cinnamon donuts are delicious. The prawn gyoza was great. The salmon ceviche was good but the celery was too strong and marred the delicate taste.

author: Sandra Broche
review_text:
The service at Sexy Fish was honestly one of the best parts of the experience. From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel genuinely welcomed and comfortable. Everyone was friendly and attentive.

A very special thank you to Aysun, who truly made our night even more memorable. Her kindness, professionalism, and genuine care stood out so much. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, and her positive energy made the entire experience feel warm and personal. ♥️

author: Alita Spence
review_text: Sexy Fish is a very beautiful restaurant with an amazing atmosphere. The menu is pretty limited and on the pricey side, especially for the small portions. That said, the gyoza and truffle rice were really good, and the drinks were great as well. The space itself is stunning, but if you’re going just to take pictures in the bathroom—good luck 😂. It was crowded all night with girls trying to get photos, so someone will definitely end up in the background. Overall, it’s a great spot for the vibe and drinks, but expect higher prices for smaller servings

author: Sara Bailey
review_text:
Our table opted for the premium tasting menu, and it was a lot of food,in the best way. Everything was beautifully timed and served at a perfect pace, so nothing felt rushed or overwhelming. Each course flowed nicely into the next, and every bite was delicious.

The atmosphere was incredible!vibrant, stylish, and full of energy! Service was smooth and attentive, making the whole experience feel effortless.

Overall, a really fun and memorable night. Definitely worth it if you’re looking for a great dining experience in Miami.

author: Oksana S
review_text: Outstanding experience! Always love to come to Sexy Fish when I’m in Miami! Worth the money. The service is top notch. Super nice server Daniel, the drinks are amazing! The food is so delicious you feel light afterwards. Music was nice even on Monday night. Definitely will be back soon!

author: Ricardo Albino
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had visited other Sexy Fish locations before, so expectations were high — and they were not disappointed! We chose the Sunday Brunch and the experience was simply incredible. The atmosphere is very pleasant, and the food, prepared with fresh, top-quality ingredients, was excellent from starters to dessert.

A standout point is the service: we were attended by Sabrina, who greeted us with a smile, answered all our questions, and paid attention to every little detail, ensuring our experience was perfect, even with the place fully packed.

I highly recommend it to anyone looking to enjoy great ambiance and delicious food — a truly memorable experience!

author: Patrick Bruno
review_text: Phenomenal ambiance, staff, food and drinks. Everything about this place was perfect. Love how attentive the staff was in all aspects. Cleaning the table and maintaining clean silverware after every dish. From front check in staff to back staff, everything was great. I highly recommend dining here. I will be dining here again on my next visit back to Miami.

author: Margaret
review_text:
I had Sexy Fish Miami saved on my list of must-visit places for a long time, and finally visited it today. Sushi is my favorite food, and of course I tried it here it was excellent, definitely a five out of five.

I also found out that this place turns into a nightclub where people can dance, but since we came on a Sunday, the club wasn’t open. The atmosphere was pleasant, the interior is beautiful, and even the bathrooms are stunning all the girls love taking photos there.

We spent about $200 for two cocktails and four sushi rolls, not including tips.

author: Britney Bambace
review_text: The dinner started off really good then turned into terrible. The bathroom is obviously stunning. we had great service from the begging but our server must’ve not put in a few things we ordered & didn’t check on us and was purposely avoiding us. she went to every table around us and didn’t check on us. we waited an hour an 15 minutes to finally be checked on. by that time, we didn’t even want to order dessert or any more drinks. Eventually the waitress noticed then we got dessert. in the middle of eaton dessert, someone came over to ask us if we were almost done because the next reservation was there and needed to be seated & we were rushed out. if there wasn’t an hour & 15 minutes of being completely ignored by ur server, my experience would have been way better.

author: Rafael Novruzlu
review_text: We had the Sekushi 10-course tasting at Sexy Fish Miami and it was amazing! Every dish was delicious and beautifully done — from the sushi and sashimi to the grilled seafood and dessert. The atmosphere was perfect, with a great DJ playlist that set the vibe just right. Our server Antony was super friendly and took great care of us all night. Definitely one of the best dining experiences we’ve had in Miami!

author: Aisha Damian
review_text: The location is a bit inconspicuous. Honestly I had higher expectations for the atmosphere as we went for NYE but it was just ok. The music was okay and they had some videos playing on a projector. The food was good but nothing to rave about. I enjoyed the nigiri the most. The himachi jalapeño roll was a disappointment. Drinks were good and decently priced. I really liked the passionfruit drink on their specialty cocktails.

author: Natalie Mendez
review_text: Paperfish Sushi is an absolute gem if you love fresh, beautifully made sushi with amazing flavors. The vibe is modern, cozy, and super aesthetic perfect for a date night or a cute dinner with friends. The presentation is gorgeous, and every dish tastes as good as it looks. The fish is incredibly fresh, the rolls are creative, and the menu has so many unique options that it’s hard to pick a favorite. The cocktails are just as impressive, and everything comes out with great attention to detail. The staff is friendly and attentive without being overwhelming, which makes the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. Overall, Paperfish Sushi is a must-try for sushi lovers. The quality, atmosphere, and flavors make it worth every visit.

author: Y Sun
review_text:
Had high expectations for their New Year’s special menu at $120 per person, but unfortunately it wasn’t a pleasant experience. Courses were not paced properly: before we finished one dish, the next arrived, and by the second course we had both the second and main course on the table at the same time. It felt very rushed and overcrowded.

When the main course was served, utensils were missing and only arrived after a delay of about 10 minutes so we had our food there and waiting for knives to arrive. Definitely need more training to their staff.

The food overall was quite ordinary. The tuna tartare in particular lacked flavor and tasted very bland. There were also no vegetables included in the courses, other than two small garnish leaves, which ended up being the only greens I had.

author: Joanna Vasquez
review_text: My friends suggested this place for a happy hour on a Friday evening. I got there a little earlier than they did and sat at the bar and was handed the menu for the Miami Spice month. It looked good, but I really wanted to try  the happy hour menu my friends spoke of. So I had to ask for it. My friend arrived shortly after and we ordered drinks from it. The drinks not only were delicious, but also very appealing to the eye. The bartender was a little inattentive. She was on her phone for a long time, and genuinely I really don’t care, but I clocked it because we were one of the only group sitting there, and there was two of us, and then there was another person sitting by themselves, and we constantly were trying to have to get her attention. However, a second bartender arrived within 15-20 minutes and really turned the night around. We ordered a lot of sushi off the happy hour menu and all of it was amazing. So overall, this is a solid place for sushi and an adequate place for happy hour.

author: Miriah Cruz
review_text: I absolutely love this place! The food is so good. I would personally recommend the black cod bites and the chocolate cake (to die for). The manager Danny is very friendly and does a great job checking on the tables to make sure everyone is happy. We usually have Diego as our server and he is amazing. But even the entire staff as a whole is attentive and happy to help, seems like they work as a team really well together. Would definitely recommend this spot if you enjoy sushi and a good atmosphere!

author: Fair reviews Based on my Experiences
review_text:
Update 10/9. Paperfish replied
"Paperfish applies a standard service charge that is fully disclosed on our menus and receipts, and it’s distributed among our entire service and support staff to ensure fair and consistent compensation across the team."

To this I respond.  It is not the Publics responsibility to pay your staff. Compensation-That's your responsibility. And if audited I'm sure more than half of these restaurants would not pass the sniff test.

Food was great — but the forced service charge was shady.

The food at Paperfish was excellent and the server did a great job. But I left feeling frustrated and misled. A mandatory service charge was added to the bill without any clear explanation or signage. When I asked, the server said it gets split among staff and she only sees a small portion — but if I tipped extra, that part goes to her. Which I felt obligated to do.

This feels like a manipulative tactic targeting tourists. I’ve eaten at several restaurants in Miami this week, and this was the only one to quietly add a charge like this. If you’re going to force guests to pay extra, be upfront about it — don’t make your staff explain it awkwardly after the fact.

Tips should go to the server providing the service, not get pooled by ownership. Be transparent — no one likes surprise fees on their bill.  Legislation should be written to force restaurant owners to pay staff properly and not tack it onto their patrons.

author: Tasheena S
review_text:
We stopped by here for happy hour and go enjoy some sushi.
Please note the location is pretty interesting. It's before the train station, behind a restaurant..it's as if you're going into a parking lot and it's tucked away. Yeah u know that's a lot but it really gives the feel of hidden gem. The service was great we had a lovely waitress who was very knowledgeable of the menu. It was a Wednesday evening so it wasn't crowded or so busy. The decor and ambiance was really lovely. Now on to the food. We were not blown away by the options on the happy hour menu. We only ordered cocktails and the edamame from the happy hour menu. The cocktail was a big size for the price BUT it tastes more like juice. We decided to order rolls from their regular menu. We had the ACEVICHADO and SALMON FURAI rolls.
I can't say we would go back because we are not in that area often. However, we would recommend it to our friends in that area of Miami.

author: Terence Kyaw
review_text: Interesting Peruvian/Japanese restaurant. Interesting menu and excellent service. Some of the menu items are never heard of before. Good Japanese food with Peruvian twist.

author: Renee Salcido
review_text: We sat outside & had Juliana has our server. We loved all of our dishes & the service was great!

author: Michael Jacobs
review_text: Fantastic food in a beautiful room .  Highly recommend . In my top 5 for Rock shrimp tempura

author: M Bon
review_text: What a find! We were casually strolling around Brickell and saw the cute entrance to Paperfish. Intrigued by it we decided to have lunch there and my I’m so glad we did. Service is top notch. Food is delicious. Everything we ordered was fantastic. My Bento box was full of flavor and plentiful. The zucchini spiral salad was fenomenal as were the sushi and truffle infused fry rice. Dessert was also decadent to close a fabulous meal. We are coming back with our friends for sure.

author: Camila Isabel
review_text: Ordered the rainbow roll and hot truffle nigiri and it was sooo good! More than anything our server, Ana was so sweet and attentive. She knew the menu like the back of her hand and made sure we had everything we needed. Hope to be back to be served by her.

author: Y
review_text:
Probably the most fresh sushi I’ve had in a very very long time!! I had the salmon with avocado and sesame seeds and it was divine!!! My friend had the jalapeño sushi roll; also delicious. Wish I had taken a picture but I ate it so quickly that there was no time haha
Also the service was spectacular and the food came out quickly. The restaurant is also very nice and decorated beautifully.
10 out of 10!

author: Logan Jackson
review_text:
I would rate it 6/6 stars if I could.

Jason, our waiter, was absolutely incredible.

This place is an absolute gem in Miami. Low key vibes and impeccable service. Paperfish is, without a doubt, my favorite sushi restaurant in Miami. The food is absolutely incredible - the fish is always fresh and flavorful, and the chefs are incredibly creative with their rolls. I've never had a bad dish here. The service is also top-notch - the staff is always friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is also great - the restaurant is stylish and modern, but it still feels warm and inviting. I highly recommend Paperfish to anyone looking for a great sushi experience in Miami.

This place feels like a speakeasy. Hidden right next to the metro rail. Stop reading this and go!

author: Kavya Sebastian
review_text: The omakase at Paperfish was absolutely incredible and well worth the money. It was the perfect amount to split with someone else and still be full! The lychee martini was also divine, one of the best I’ve ever had. Even though we were one of the last customers left at the restaurant, the staff didn’t rush us or kick us out. Incredible food and very professional team!

author: Rafael Sa
review_text:
Average japanese food; nothing outstanding in particular
Service is ok; fast but not offering a lot of assistance or suggestions. Basic mistakes as forgetting drink orders, and offering shoyu and wasabi.
Beware of pricing scheme: the menu prices does not include taxes, 20% service charge and 7% tip charge; so whatever you see in the menu, add 36%
Atmosphere feels crowded and lowed; not what you would expect in a traditional Japanese restaurant
There are definitely better options to dine in Lincoln street

author: Sofia Elizabeth Schumo Chwe
review_text: Lovely ambience with a cozy and modern vibe. The sushi is fresh and nicely presented. The staff were attentive and polite, making the whole experience enjoyable. A pleasant place to visit in Miami.

author: Margalit M
review_text: I'm happy that I found this spot near my hotel for a lovely sushi dinner. The tuna roll was good, and the nigiri tuna with Truffle and something else was divine! Edemame was too salty--like we are obsessed with salt, and sometimes I think restaurants go a little too heavy, which I don't need when there's lots of soy sauce on the table. Service was excellent and food came out very fast... like maybe too fast because I got my cocktail after the sushi was on the table. But overall, great spot with lots of space for large groups.

author: Sadiel Serrano
review_text: Its the forth time now, and still really good sushi, not that expensive and have a natural ambient and decoration that brings you at least to me peace, nice decoration and service its nice also

author: Nicole Freed
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
First-Class Experience at Paperfish Sushi on Española Way!

Allison and Joy truly went above and beyond to deliver first-class service — prompt, friendly, and incredibly attentive from start to finish. The atmosphere on Española Way is such a vibe — lively, colorful, and full of energy — and Paperfish fits right in perfectly.

The food was phenomenal — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. I’m not even usually into sushi, but they offer such a variety of dishes to suit every palate that I was genuinely impressed. Everything tasted so good and was prepared with care.

If you’re in Miami Beach, do yourself a favor and stop by Paperfish — and if you’re lucky enough to have Allison and Joy take care of you, you’re in for a treat! 🌸🍣✨

author: Jessica Diett
review_text:
I was here back in November 2025. This is a nice and cozy restaurant. Although the vibe is more “romantic couple dinner”, I felt super comfortable going there alone (solo traveler) and my server was so nice!
First, I got a rack to hang my purse and every table has a box to put your phone in, so you can have actual conversations with the one you’re with and enjoy the atmosphere. It’s not mandatory, and it felt weird at first given I was alone, but I enjoyed not being on my phone (except taking pictures), enjoying my food & drink, watching other people and taking in the precious view of the bay.
Food, drink, and service was fantastic! I’ll definitely be back.
Special shoutout to my server Keyla who constantly checked on me made sure everything was good.

author: Marielle J
review_text:
Laura was our server and was exceptional! She was precise in taking our orders and refilling our waters. Very attentive and courteous, and she was patient in giving my sister updates for gluten free and dairy free
options.

The ambience of this place is divine! Colorful, classy and cute!

The food was AMAZING! The cornbread is a must — you have to try! The ham croquetas were tasty! Everyone loved their dishes. The grilled salmon salad was delicious and the salmon was moist. I had the wagyu skirt steak wedge salad and it is by far, the BEST wagyu steak I’ve ever had!

We also tried the “world’s best chocolate cake” and it was very unique!

We LOVED it here and will recommend! Thank you for a lovely experience and a great time!

author: Alexandra On earth
review_text: Eclectic ambiance Waterfront dining! great service great quality food and fair priced!!! my guy and I had a great meal right next to the water for $160. We ordered 4 appetizers (2 for $25 and we each got a free app with our entree), 4 drinks and two entrees. The kale Caesar salad- freshly shaken at the table, potatoes bravas -  on point even better than some I’ve had in Spain, perfect golden crust with a side of tangy red sauce. Chihuahua cheese - my guy had the pleasure of eating the whole thing and when he ran out of toast proceeded to eat the rest with a spoon 😆  For our entrees he chose the Kobe beef burger ($30) and I got the Wagyu churrassico ($47) both served with shoestring fries and a free appetizer. The flavor was DECADENT. meat melted in your mouth so tender and juicy not to mention cooked to perfection. This was a really great dining experience and worth every penny (picture of receipt in photos! Jorge was our server and he was excellent!

author: yth _
review_text: I love Andres! Excellent service. He explained the menu items clearly to us and even gave recommendations. He was very attentive to our needs, constantly checking in on us. The food was delicious and priced reasonably (They have free appetisers for each entree). The atmosphere of the restaurant was excellent too. I love the warm lighting. It was very comfortable to the eyes and provide a great candlelight experience :) Would definitely come back again

author: Donna Arnold
review_text: Great start to our cruise vacation,  we're  in Miami for only 1 night and Crazy About You was our choice for dinner, I think we chose well! Food was very tasty, service wonderful and of course the view was amazing. We got the 2 to Tango shrimp and steak dinner and sangria. An absolutely amazing night dining on the patio. Atmosphere and view is stunning and the food rocks!

author: Elizabeth M
review_text:
We had a fantastic dining experience at Crazy About You! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the food was absolutely delicious;  every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented.
A special shoutout to our waitress, LAURA, who went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. She was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu. Her service truly made our visit even more enjoyable.
Highly recommend this place for both the amazing food and top-notch service. Can’t wait to come back!

author: Sofi Koltun
review_text: We had an amazing experience! Our server, Yusnavy, was absolutely incredible — so attentive, kind, and professional. The food was excellent, everything tasted amazing, and the service made the night even better. We will definitely be coming back. We also loved that the place is pet-friendly, which made the experience even more special for us. Highly recommended!

author: Ava
review_text: I loved the cocktails here!🍹and my favorite dish was the baby back ribs.  The place feels tight when it starts to get busy, but has great service. If I come back I’ll probably do it for dinner, I think the view and atmosphere are better at night.

author: Chimene H. James
review_text:
First time having dinner at Crazy About You. We had an amazing server Andrea, who explained the menu to us and gave his recommendations. The food was rich and well prepared. The service was top notch and Andrea made sure we were okay while we were there. Would definitely visit again next time I’m in Miami! We had the tortellini served with shrimp and the branzino with potatoes.

FYI- Photos are done for you at an extra charge.

author: Felton Brown
review_text:
I recently had dinner at Crazy About You in Brickell, and this place absolutely lives up to its name — I’m crazy about it! From the moment I walked in, I was taken by the stunning view of Biscayne Bay. Sitting on the terrace with the soft breeze, city lights reflecting off the water, and that vibrant yet peaceful Brickell energy — it felt like Miami magic at its finest.

For dinner, I ordered the Zucchini Carbonara, and wow — this dish was on another level. The creamy texture, savory depth, and the way it balanced flavor and freshness was simply perfect. You can taste the chef’s creativity and attention to detail in every bite.

And then came dessert — the restaurant’s famous “The Best Chocolate Cake in the World.” That name sounds bold until you try it… and then you get it. Moist, rich, melt-in-your-mouth chocolate perfection. Easily one of the best desserts I’ve had in Miami.

The service was top-tier — warm, professional, and attentive without being overbearing. You can tell the staff genuinely care about creating a great experience for every guest.

Whether you’re a local looking for a relaxing night out or a visitor wanting to soak in Miami’s waterfront charm, I highly recommend Crazy About You. Between the view, the food, and the vibe, this spot captures everything that makes Brickell such a special place to dine.

author: Robert Knott
review_text: An excellent location for dinner! The staff were friendly and attentive, the food was delicious, and the prices were an absolute deal considering the location and quality of food. I would absolutely recommend coming here for dinner. All the entrees are reasonably priced and include a free appetizer with the order, and there are great happy hour drink deals. They also get very creative with the presentation of the dishes which makes the meal even more fun.

author: Sara
review_text: Yusnavy was PHENOMENAL with providing us superb service. The food was FANTASTIC my burger was good perfectly. The atmosphere is very romantic with the low lighting and candle lights.

author: Durley Carrasco
review_text:
This terrace is a hidden gem! With breathtaking views of the city bay skyline, it’s the perfect spot to unwind. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it ideal for family gatherings. The service is exceptional, with friendly staff that make you feel right at home.

Overall, the combination of great food, stunning views, and warm hospitality makes this terrace a must-visit. Highly recommended!

author: Randa Gozum
review_text: We've been here a few times and always have had wonderful experiences. Our server, Francisco was excellent! Fun vibes by the water,  great food,  lots of photo ops. Definitely need to check it out!

author: Brittney M
review_text: The inside of this place is definitely aesthetically pleasing and nice to look at. I went here with my family for lunch and the experience was pleasant. Our server was super friendly and attentive. The cornbread and Croquettes were very good. However I got the chicken parm and it was just ok, very Mid. If I am ever in Miami I’d give this place another try, just a different dish. Haha.

author: Aiste Ber
review_text:
Absolutely amazing service and food!

We had a wonderful experience, and a huge part of it was thanks to our waitress Yusnavy. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring from the moment we arrived. Her positive energy and warm smile made us feel truly welcome.

She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, always checking in on us without being intrusive. It’s rare to meet such a lovely and professional waitress who clearly loves what she does.

Thank you for making our visit so special — we will definitely remember this experience!

author: XZ Xu
review_text: It’s a hidden gem in Brickell. As a Bostonian, I have been to this place for five years. Our waiter Francisco is very friendly, cute and nice! Love the view, food and everything!

author: Lara
review_text: this place was pretty dang solid! the decor for both inside and outside was very cool, loved the atmosphere. the outside has a direct view of the water and was nicely shaded at night. for our appetizers, i got the asian spring rolls and my boyfriend got some type of cheese dip and both were very good! i always love a spring roll. for our entrees, i got the truffle pasta and my boyfriend got the waygu burger. my bf absolutely loved his burger and my pasta was pretty okay, it was just a bit much with it being all the same flavor. i liked the kale pieces in it, but i wish there was a side to break up the flavor or some type of protein in the pasta itself. i got very full lol. our server was nice, just a bit odd.. a lady took our picture and then later came back trying to sell us over priced glass photo frames?! i thought it was for social media or something but i guess not 😊but yeah, besides that, very solid experience!

author: Ismael Valverde Kardouchi
review_text: This place is awesome for hanging out with friends, especially in the evening. I came for lunch, and the food was delicious. The vibe is super chill, and it's also a great place to have drinks while enjoying some stunning views.

author: Yolanda Alvarez
review_text: Food was great! And our server Nancy was even better! We love to come to this place all the time, definitely recommended 👍

author: May P
review_text: Totally unexpected happy surprise of a Restaurant sharing the lot with a Gas Station. At first glance stepping in it looks like a shop, but then you walk inside it becomes this adorable Restaurant reminiscent to places in the Spanish countryside. The selection of wines was impressive and the foods we had ordered were delicious. No Happy Hour menu but of course provided you have a quiet well mannered dog it was also dog friendly with great service personnel.

author: Nicole M
review_text: We’ve lived in the neighborhood for years and finally decided to check this place out. We are so disappointed we waited so long! The wine, the food, the ambiance is amazing. The bacon wrapped dates were to die for. The only reason I gave is a 4 was because the staff was so off putting trying to turn the table that they were rushing us to leave when we were finishing our bottle of wine, even when all the tables around us had gotten there before us. Other than that, it was amazing. We will definitely be returning.

author: Katy Hernández
review_text:
The place is located in a spot I never would’ve imagined — literally at a gas station — but to me, it’s a true hidden gem. You can choose your favorite wine and they’ll open it for you. The paella is delicious, the octopus is very good, and the people who work there are warm and welcoming. I also noticed that the owner is truly attentive to making sure everything runs smoothly.

I’ve been there about three times, every time I visit Miami, and I always leave happy. If you’re someone who appreciates complete silence, this isn’t the place, but you can still have a perfectly good conversation and enjoy a delicious meal.

If you live in Miami or are visiting, I highly recommend stopping by — it’s an interesting and unique spot!

author: Noa
review_text: A Miami staple! I love this place cause it’s so unpretentious, unlike most places in Miami, the food is always so good here. They are consistent with their delicious food and with great customer service. The atmosphere is also really nice; lively, but not loud enough that you cannot hear each other (great place to catch up with friends or go on a date) I also love that they have a fabulous  extensive selection of wines. I always get the octopus here cause they cook it perfectly. Must try!

author: Abhilash M. Prasad
review_text: This place is the perfect example of why you should never judge a book by its cover. I walked in casually, not expecting anything special, and the inside completely surprised me. The vibe was great, the cafe was much better than it looked from outside, and their latte was genuinely amazing. I was extremely satisfied and would definitely recommend this spot.

author: Arem Assuan
review_text:
El Carajo is a truly unique and exceptional spot in Miami that seamlessly blends the charm of a top tier wine store with the delights of a bakery and a fantastic Spanish restaurant.

From the moment you step in, you're greeted by an impressive selection of wines from around the world . The knowledgeable staff are always on hand to offer recommendations, making it easy to find the perfect bottle, my favorite muga prado enea. But El Carajo isn't just about the wine. Their pastry counter is a delightful temptation. El Carajo is a must visit for anyone seeking a true taste of Spain and a truly unique Miami experience.

author: Joanne Kong
review_text:
Ther service: friendly and attentive. Our server did a grest job in putting in our order wo our food came out appropiately knowing that the Paella took 35-40 min.

The food: We ordered 4 tapas dished. Cod Croquttes were great. The Tortilla Slice Espanola was delicious. Patatas a la Brava also very good. The Chorizo al Vino, i usually love. But I found that that the chorizo in this tapas dish (in red wine) to be mealy and the casing tough. The alcohol itself in this dish was not burned off enough giving the entire dish a sour taste. Will not order again. The paella was delicious but the pricing is deceiving. The price on their menu is a per person price with 2 people being the minimum. The pricing doesn't make any sense cause you can't order a single serving. So, the cheapest paella dish is priced at $25, but its actually $50, whether u go there by yourself or with five people. Additionally, you can only order 2, 4, 6, etc. The paella comes in servings of 2. Which makes the pricing deceiving. On a side note, the chorizo in the paella is very tasty, and different from the tapas. Although its the same chorizo, the cook is better.
Wine: Their selection of wine is resonably priced for a restaurant. There are two prices with each bottle. One for take home and one to drink at the restaurant. Still very reasonably priced and a very nice selction.
Overall, it was a very nice experience. Overall, the food was very good.

The atmosphere: once you step into the back restaurant area you forget thats its the bck side of a gas station. The wall of wine and murals make it a plesent dining experience. Its noting fancy with wooden tables and metal chairs, but the food is good. What more do you need.
We will definately go back.

author: Cristina Da Costa
review_text: Impressive doesn't even begin to describe this hidden gem. I've heard of it so I wanted to try it and from the outside you'd want to turn away but once you go in and go into the restaurant you're transported somewhere else. Amazing wines and sangria and we had 2 different paellas and they were amazing! We'll be back!

author: Hana Karina Arraya
review_text: Nestled in the back of a gas station is a restaurant with an extensive wine selection and your classic Spanish tapas. Honestly, your Spanish friends might not be impressed by the food, but anyone else will be satisfied and entertained by the unique location of this local hidden gem. The bacon wrapped dates and gambas al ajillo are my favorite!

author: Aurora
review_text: Warm inviting atmosphere. Attentive, friendly staff. The food is delectable. We tried the Paella and it was divine.  They carry a large selection of quality wine. Will definitely return again.

author: Madison Ramirez
review_text: A little hidden gem. Ordered tapas and wine and everything was delicious. We had croquetas, garbanzos with spinach, tortilla and the dates for tapas and ordered the dulce de leche crepes. Star of the show was the crepes. Wow wow wow. All the tapas were hot and fresh. We walked around after dinner and the selection of wine AND prices - you cannot beat it. I’ll be back to buy some wine and order more tapas.

author: vicki buchwald
review_text: Wonderful service with Paolo and very delicious food! We shared a traditional Seafood Paella  and had Pulpo a la Gallega and  Boquerones  as appetizers. We finished this lovely meal with a shared Crema Catalana. The amazing  lunch here was a highlight on our visit to Miami.

author: William Dawson
review_text: We had several starters and everything was delicious. Enjoyed Dates with bacon, stuffed mushrooms, patatas bravas, tortilla and Croquetas de Chorizo.

author: Julio Figueroa
review_text: We tried their expresso and it was very good. Guava pastries were fresh and good. The only negative was the small dinning area. They do have a large wine area but we stopped for the Café.

author: Mike Milner
review_text:
Was not expecting this.
Attached to a gas station i was thinking like a spanish WaWa.
Couldn't have been more wrong.
This little gem serves some of the best tapas I've tasted. Octopus and spanish sausage were amazing, as was the exceptional paella.
Great service and a notable HUGE wine selection.
Highly recommend.

author: Arman Barbuco
review_text: The place has good food. The service is good and they have a lot of good wines you can choose from. We ended up buying a couple of bottles after dinner. Their foods are good. The downside of this place is parking in case the area gets busy. But it is worth a visit and a must-try.

author: Bernhard VDM
review_text:
I had an absolutely amazing time here. I felt so at home that I want to learn to speak Spanish😊

I got seated at the counter (I called last minute for reservation and was on my own) which seemed at 1st a bit impersonal, but since I was on my own, this is the best place to be part of the action.

Everyone was super attentive and even though I don't speak Spanish, the manager and staff all stuck up a conversation to make me feel welcome.

I liked the atmosphere created by El Carajo because it seems it used to be the convenience store at the gas station, but is now a wine shop and Restaurant. In fact, you feel as though you actually dine inside the wine shop (or shopping inside a restaurant 😁)

They have a good wine selection that is part of the restaurant and you can just browse for something that takes your fancy.

A good variety of tapas. I had the ham croquettes, boquerones, meat starter plate and later the pulpo de gallega. All food was very good and well presented. For wine I had the Vina Ardanza Reserva which was superb.

What I liked most was the friendly atmosphere created by everyone. I felt like a regular on my 1st visit, which is a special quality not many restaurants can manage, and I want to thank all the staff for making my evening special.

author: Dana Rodriguez
review_text:
I’ve been a customer for about 4 years, and I feel I need to be honest with my review. Since I come here often, I’ve noticed the changes, and honestly, I preferred the atmosphere when the previous manager was in charge. She was young, but her charisma, work ethic, and the way she supported her team were what I admired most about this place: everything was always organized and up to date.

In my recent visits, I bought some empanadas that were so unpleasant they couldn’t be eaten — they seemed like they had been sitting there for hours. The same thing happened with the croquettes. Other times, there’s no bread or other basic items, showing a lack of consistency in this bakery.

I’ve also had to wait over 30 minutes in line because there was only one person working. When I asked who the manager was, I was told she was at the gas station on the phone. I’m the kind of person who really values a team’s effort because it says a lot about the business, and it’s truly a shame that everything has changed.

Nowadays, I feel like I waste my money here because the products are not fresh, and on top of that, I have to wait too long to be served. Really disappointing, especially since a year ago my experience was completely different.

author: Rose Mar
review_text: Food was good but the service wasn’t so great. Waitress took her break and we were left unattended for quite some time. My husband had to find another waitress to take care of us. Not sure if we will be back. Really didn’t meet our expectation.

author: Maria Murljacic
review_text: What a cute spot! The wine is very reasonably priced, and the food is quality. I highly recommend, as the food, wine, ambiance, and service were great. Between 4 people, we split 4-5 tapas and the meat platter.

author: Aft_and_About
review_text:
I stopped by this restaurant last night (a Thursday) for a solo happy hour, and I’m so glad I did. Happy hour runs from 4–7 PM, which is perfect for easing into the evening. The atmosphere was perfectly chill with a DJ playing good music, and the marina views made the whole experience even better.

I sat at the back bar where Monika and Mario were providing top-tier service. They were friendly, attentive, and had great menu recommendations. I really enjoyed chatting with both of them—they helped make the night feel relaxed and welcoming.

For food, I ordered the mahi and wahoo fish dip as an appetizer, which was delicious. My first drink was the Pain Remover made with rum, and wow… that drink was sooo good. I ordered a #2, which comes with two shots, and it was perfectly balanced.

During happy hour, there’s also a boat serving oysters, shrimp, and a few other items. I tried the oysters from Chesapeake, VA at $2 each and loved the self-serve condiment setup.

I also tried a piña colada, mai tai, and a watermelon mojito. All were great, but the piña colada is an absolute must-try.

Overall, I had a fantastic time and will definitely be going back. Highly recommend this spot for solo outings, happy hour, or just a chill evening by the marina! 🌅🍹🦪

author: Ella Spence
review_text: I had the mahi fish tacos and my husband had the grouper platter. We had coconut shrimp and a bowl of she crab soup. Everything we ate was delicious and full of flavor. The service was extremely slow and there was a $13 service charge that came on our ticket for using the dining room. This was a 19% charge that was hidden before we came in and is the only reason that we won't be back.

author: Vic C
review_text: Food was ok. Fish dip was more like canned tuna.  Rockefeller oysters were ok, but were just above room temp.  I thought they would be nice and toasty from baking.  Mahi Mahi was nice and warm and still juicy.

author: Kathryn Johnson
review_text: Great food, service and view! Only complaint was the nearby smokers. The fish tacos were awesome! Park in lot 72 and get your parking validated by the restaurant.

author: Cathy Dang
review_text: Delightful laid-back atmosphere. Definitely a good spot for locals and families to enjoy a breeze by the water or a nice sunset. Portions were relatively generous. Food was nothing special, but it definitely served its purpose. Lots of families and people just coming to have a chill time. Would definitely recommend for a casual get together with friends. Wouldn’t necessarily come here for a special occasion or looking for anything spectacular.

author: Revel Ramjewan
review_text: We recently visited Monty’s in Coconut Grove, and it was a wonderful experience! The food was absolutely delicious, and the drinks were incredible. I especially enjoyed the fish and chips, which were perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The atmosphere relaxing, making it an ideal spot for a family dinner or casual evening out. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and a laid-back dining experience in Coconut Grove!

author: Cami Tussie
review_text: Great vibe, casual outdoor atmosphere with music playing by the boats. Lots of delicious seafood at a good price. Fried fish isn’t oily at all. Recommend the grouper. Coconut shrimp good but not amazing, same with seafood salad, probably wouldn’t get again. Great service, don’t forget to get your parking validated in lot 72 across the street!

author: Mariana M
review_text: Very tropical restaurant or sport bar with a DJ playing mostly tropical and Latino music very good by the way. Service was great and food too, delicious. It’s big and very popular, in front of a Marina, we loved it. They validate your parking for 3 hours told us.

author: Robert Rodriguez
review_text: Went specifically for the stone crabs. Ordered Lg platter. Received 4 medium claws for $64.95. But that's Lg to them.  Terrible. Terrible. Terrible. Tasted old. Quality was not anywhere where it should have been. See the picture I took of one of the claws. Speaks for itself. The lobster bisque was delicious as was the chicken, bacon, avocado sandwich with fries. The fries were phenomenal. Service was good. It's the last 3 that saved it from a 1 star review.  Told the mgr. He replaced the 1 claw for a much better one but still not worth the money. At any price because yes it was that bad.

author: Marilyn Sanchez-Osorio
review_text: I grew up in Miami where Monty’s has been a huge part of the vibe, a go to place to grab a bite or have a drink, meet up with friends after a movie, and just hang out in front of the water and the boats docked in the marina. Never known for excellence in food quality, but at least fair enough for the quick bite. By gosh, it had been years that I had not been at Monty’s and I was sadly disappointed. The simple mozzarella sticks I ordered were nothing short of horrific! The Margarita was 90% ice, and the rest was a mystery, but the worst was the “service”! This woman must do us all a favor and quit. ASAP! She literally dragged herself to my table and her facial expression was so unpleasant, it made me want to just get up and leave. She really was the cherry 🍒 on top of the whole disappointment, not to mention that the chair I sat on was falling apart and I almost fell to the ground..! Just horrible. 😣 OH! Super expensive too… run 🏃🏻‍♀️

author: Samuel Kaplan Art com
review_text: Best view of key Biscayne a land yacht club. Descent food nothing above average but okay. White table cloths denote price point for upscale service and lots of eye candy.

author: Ariana Taveras
review_text:
OMG, the food at Monty’s Coconut Grove was absolutely delicious! We started with the gator bites—they tasted just like chicken and were a fun and tasty appetizer. Our meal included fresh oysters, flavorful Cajun shrimp Alfredo, and a perfectly cooked NY sirloin steak. Although we didn’t try any of the specialty drinks, they looked amazing and are definitely on our list for next time.

The atmosphere was lively and enjoyable. The DJ played great music that was clean and appropriate for children, making it a fantastic spot for families. The waterfront setting added to the charm, providing beautiful views and a relaxing ambiance.

If you’re in the area and looking for a place with great food, a welcoming environment, and family-friendly entertainment, Monty’s Coconut Grove is the place to go!

author: Indrasis Chakraborty
review_text:
Me and my wife went there for a Sunday brunch during our visit to Miami. The place is exceptional , both in terms of food and ambience. Our host was nice and kind and brought every single dish with a smiling face.

We got their calamari , which was crunchy and fresh, well seasoned and came with a homemade marinara sauce. I got their grouper for main dish, which tasted fresh and flaky, came with a house potato and a salad. My wife got the impossible taco, which she said is really good and fresh.

For desert, our host recommended us their brownie, which came hot and served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Altogether, excellent choice for a brunch with your loved ones and family.

P.S. they are also dog friendly, and if you like birds, you can see tons of them sitting next to your table.

author: Edward Scott
review_text: The atmosphere was full of great vibes the food was Great. Ordered chilled shrimp cocktail and gator bites. Was fresh the gator was fresh well seasoned fried to perfection

author: Aussie Abroad
review_text: Love this spot, really casual, laid back vibe with easy eats and screens for anyone who wants to watch sports… personally I prefer to watch the comings and going’s from the water from here 🛥️!

author: Christopher F
review_text: They have a variety of foods to offer and, personally, the fish tacos were good.  The place was a little busy when we got there but not crazy.  Most of the seating was outside but covered.  There is an automatic 19% service charge on all food and drink which was stated on the menu.  The issues I had were that it took a while to initially get a drink.  Beers normally come in a bottle or a 16oz draft.  Their draft was priced for a normal size but you got a 12oz plastic cup.  Kids menu had a semi decent selection but if you dont want a corn cob on the side, you can switch it for normal items like fries for $1.  One child wanted a corn and the other wanted fries.  We should have switch amongst ourselves when the food arrived because they charged a $1 for each kid because each asked for what the other was getting on the side.  (One wanted fries but was supposed to get corn and the other wanted corn but not fries.)  The topper was that the service charge is added onto the bill and tax is done after.  I asked for clarification since this is a tip and I should have to pay for tax on the 19% service charge.  Tax the entire bill and add 19%.  The waitress went to ask and came back with an explanation of what the service charge was.  I said that I wanted to know why it was added like a meal and I was being taxed on top of that. (Maybe $5 difference overall but it is the fact I shouldn't have to even pay that)  The waitress before listening fully just left because she wasn't able to understand my question.  We paid the bill and left. I don't need to return there because there was nothing special about that location.  Also, if you don't park in a certain lot, then parking is at your cost.  Make sure to validate your ticket like we did.  We just needed to wait for everyone else stuck at the gate that did not validate.

author: Kaustubh M
review_text: One of our all time favorite spots. Everything j the menu is perfect and well seasoned. Good cocktails and very hospitable staff. We always get the raw oysters and the loaded seafood roll. Can’t ask for much more than this.

author: Megan L
review_text:
Amazing service and food! 10/10
Super Dog-friendly as well! One of the servers even brought water for my furbaby!  Vibe was on point and everyone was super friendly!

author: Ashlyn Williams (Ash)
review_text:
It's really hard for me to do 5 stars but my experience at Monty's has usually usually always been top notch. Today was definitely another good day. We arrived for lunch not thinking about it being Brunch (thought it's Saturday).
Our server, Petrona, was on the ball. She got to my table with my family quickly and made good suggestions on things. We ordered drinks and an appetizer that came at a great speed and she made sure to bring a water when the last one of our party arrived. The food came out hot delicious. It was a great experience and I know next time I'm in town I will be back.

author: J S
review_text: Casual vibe on the water with great food and good service.  The seafood is on point.  Our server Jonathon recommended the stone crab and minuta ssndwich and it didn't miss!

author: C Perry
review_text:
We had such a great time here, again! We tried it last December and were pleasantly surprised. We love the Mahi tacos and the Wahoo Fish Dip was fantastic.  The service was super friendly and made the whole experience easy and enjoyable.  Alex, our server, was very accommodating which makes the experience so much better. The tables were comfy, and we love the view.   Definitely one of the highlights that brings us back.

The food was delicious, and the atmosphere made it even better. Everything just came together for a really fun afternoon out. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Justin Stein
review_text: Great outdoor but covered spot, delicious food and cool vibe. Our Arepitas and shrimp cocktail were a great start, and the Mahi Tacos were incredible, coupled with my wife’s Smash Burger that was perfect. Only knock was long wait to see our server, but she was great afterwards.

author: Tasheena S
review_text: We came here for brunch and we LOVED IT! We will definitely be back. From the moment we arrived until we left the service was amazing. The views of the water really add to the ambiance. Let’s, add the food. The food was amazing. We started with the fish dip and conch fritters; followed by shrimp & grits and French toast. We loved every single bite. We can’t to return.

author: Helen Chen
review_text: We had a great time at the Bayshore! Our server Peter was excellent. The dishes we tried conch fritters, calamari and frutti de mart were great. The smash burger though was killer good. It was our favorite! The live music was unrivaled. Can’t wait to drop by again

author: Nina Brooks
review_text: Scott and Andres were absolutely amazing my husband brought me here for my birthday and the food was delicious! We ordered the whole fried snapper it was very impressive in presentation! The spicy margarita was perfection! We had white chocolate raspberry cheesecake for dessert. The ambience a music and history of the restaurant is wonderful. We will definitely be back!

author: Andrea Novoa
review_text:
Bayshore Club Miami A Perfect Waterfront Escape

Located right by the marina in Coconut Grove, Bayshore Club is one of those Miami spots that instantly makes you feel like you’re on vacation. The open-air design, ocean breeze, and tropical aesthetic create the perfect setting for a laid-back lunch or sunset dinner with friends and family.

Their food selection is absolutely delicious from the fresh ceviche packed with flavor to the perfectly cooked mahi-mahi and crispy fried fish. Every plate feels fresh and made for coastal dining. Pair that with one of their signature cocktails and you’ll understand why this spot is always buzzing with good vibes.

The ambiance is everything you’d want for a Miami night out relaxed yet vibrant, with music, palm trees, and beautiful views that make you want to stay long after you finish your meal. It’s the kind of place where you can eat, laugh, and enjoy the evening without feeling rushed.

Whether you’re celebrating with friends, having a casual date night, or just want to unwind by the water, Bayshore Club is a must-visit. Definitely recommend staying for drinks after dinner the atmosphere gets even better as the sun goes down.

author: Alisa Kremer
review_text: Wow! What an unexpected surprise. My husband & I walked around from our hotel, and found the Bayshore Club restaurant. The service, the food, the staff were so accommodating, friendly and caring. Our entrees were delicious (I ordered the Snapper special and my husband had the Spice menu special). We will definitely return! Our waitress, Viviana was absolutely lovely, Javier, the manager & Chris were a pleasure to talk to. Apparently, there is a very good brunch here on the weekends which we will have to investigate! Thank you for an amazing dinner experience while visiting our daughter during Family Weekend at the "U". Go Canes!

author: KAT OLARTE
review_text:
Our entire visit was stellar! The staff was so hospitable and accommodating.  The view is prefect.  The food was amazing and creative.  I highly recommend requesting Tyrone! He's kind, on point, genuine, and passionate about being present with you.  He's been with them since they opened and loves to answer questions with enthusiasm.
It's right next to the shipyard and if you're there early enough, you'll see them lifting vessels out of the water to
Dry-dock them.  We took a walk after and it was so peaceful!  Enjoy!

author: Al Martinez
review_text: This is now one of my favorite places. Went here on a perfect night with cool weather and clear skys. This place is absolutely amazing for an evening eating oysters and steak 🥩 and smoking cigar by the water. Glorious views of the marina. Amazing service and food. Will definitely return for brunch and weekends to check out the live music.

author: Mia Tucker
review_text:
I can’t say enough good things about the Bayshore Club in Miami! The atmosphere is stunning—right on the water with the perfect mix of laid-back and upscale. The food and drinks were amazing, but what truly made our experience unforgettable was our server, Alex.

From the second we sat down, Alex was warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly. She knew the menu inside and out, gave us excellent recommendations (the calamari and the asparagus were both incredible!), and somehow managed to anticipate what we needed before we even had to ask. Even though she was clearly busy, she made us feel like we were her only table. That level of service is rare, and it truly elevated the whole evening.

If you’re coming to Bayshore Club, you’re already guaranteed a beautiful view and delicious food—but if you’re lucky enough to have Alex as your server, your night will be next-level. Can’t wait to come back!!

author: Cristy Anne Bustillos
review_text:
1st time eating here!

My husband and I came here for my birthday!
And it was so amazing the atmosphere was so beautiful!
Very friendly servers especially Scott.
You guys must try their very new Ckg moroccan salmon, very delicious!!
I want a 2nd plate but, I was full already 🤣.

Best place to eat!

author: Jeanine Stark
review_text: Viviana was our meal-curator. EVERY item she suggested was excellent and well within what we were looking for: whole fried red snapper, broccoli, skin-on mashed potato, duck surf n turf....and very timely! Thank you for a great meal, and time well spent!

author: Cesar Ruiz
review_text: We went for brunch on Sunday with the family what a great place! It was completely packed, lucky we had a reservation. We got seated quickly and our server was on point. We pretty much ordered everything he suggested, everything was delicious!! The seafood tower was a great way to try a little bit of everything! Location gets 100 points really beautiful place with relax atmosphere and great service! We will be back for sure!!

author: Vaughn-Rian St. James
review_text: This was a dinner treat from the president of my company Nexus 123 who flew out from California just to take us to Brunch and meet my team personally it was just perfect. He is still raving about the food the service and the experience. Everyone from the hostess to our server as well as the Manager greeted us. He checked in with me as we left. Having a back ground in Food service excellence I highly recommend this spot for formal and casual. Great 👍 Job and Thank you Bayshore Grill we will be back!!!

author: Dunia Cala Bértolo
review_text: We celebrate Christmas Eve at Bayshore Club with our family. Dana was an excellent server. He was very attentive. We love it there and will definitely return!

author: Chelsea Hallford
review_text: Amazing experience!!! Loved the food, the atmosphere and most of all the service. Nia was so kind, knowledgeable and a joy to have as my server. 10 out of 10 recommend. When you come get the local catch ceviche, delish!! Thank you Nia!

author: ingrid robles
review_text: the hostess in the front was so kind!! she greeted us with the warmest smile and made incredible conversation. vivana was the cutest server ever, created a great atmosphere. I had the 3 amigos smash burger and it was genuinely delicious. i had an issue with my drink and she immediately took it off our bill and got me a new drink. she was genuinely so sweet and had a ton of recommendations it seemed like she was very familiar with the menu and definitely contributed to my experience, very attentive and kind. lots of seating available and the view from any table in the restaurant is beautiful.

author: nate smith
review_text: Katrina was the best server we’ve ever had. Super personable. Told us the history of seaplanes in the area. Recommended dishes and drinks. 10 stars! Offered to sing happy birthday to me haha!!

author: Tammi Calarco
review_text: The service was absolutely fabulous.  The hostess Junise was the mostess with her upbeat attitude and her willingness to accommodate my needs. Our waitress Sheyla C. was super with making sure we had cold drinks and our food at the right times.  She also was accommodating when it rained.  Between Junise and Sheyla, they made sure the big umbrella was positioned to avoid us getting wet from the rain. The food tasted excellent and was very delicious. The scenic views while eating outdoors were delightful. Overall, I highly recommend Bayshore Club and look forward to returning.
