author: V A (Tom)
review_text:
Pros: love the vibe. Very comfortable, very relaxed while also having a refined edge. The whole fish snapper was cooked to perfection. The chimichuri steak was 10/10 , tender and flavorful. Calamari is one of the best in town. Nice and crispy. The cesar salad was fresh, and the dressing was perfect. Our waiter Tyrone was absolutely fantastic , friendly,  warm, and polite.

Cons: what in gods name are we doing with the key lime pie? That radioactive green "kiwi lime syrup" that was drizzled on it was an abomination. The pie was 6/10 to begin with but that syrup added a nice little nursing home food touch to it. In fact, don't put that gross syrup on any of the other desserts please. Also, it's supposed to come with vanilla ice cream, but our came with melted caramel instead. What a flavor nightmare.

author: Dannielle Cole
review_text: I don’t come to the grove often as other places but stopped by for a healthy lunch and I was so surprised at how high quality the food was! We both got the salmon and it was delicious with the sauce it came with. Portions were huge and servers nice! The outside seating area is a lovely place to sit and enjoy when the weather is nice. Will certainly come again!

author: Z G
review_text: Avo Miami was absolutely amazing! My food was perfect and so healthy. I sat and ate and enjoyed every bite and took lots of food to go. They use high quality ingredients and it shows. I will definitely be back soon.

author: H P
review_text: The best healthy food I’ve ever experienced! The staff is incredibly kind and attentive, with the owner personally greeting guests. More than just great food, it’s an unforgettable experience. I wholeheartedly recommend Avo Miami to everyone!

author: Judy Heany
review_text: Delicious way to spend your time when your flight gets cancelled and you’re stuck in FL. Happy belly. Worth every penny. ✅Protein Breakfast Bowl✅Classic Shakshuka ✅Japanaese Matcha ✅ Avo Antioxidant

author: Peter Bittar
review_text:
I had a great experience at avo! Danielle was very nice, and since it was my first time, steered me towards the filet mignon sandwich on a ciabatta, which was fantastic. Very juicy, flavorful, and still felt healthy at the same time.

The service was likewise, very professional, the space rather upscale.

Will definitely be back

author: Ashley Chen
review_text: Burrata toast and cappuccino were 10/10. So good and fresh, great portion. Service was excellent - Bryan was friendly and attentive. Need to go back for the juices and matchas.

author: Nicholas
review_text:
The fear of all restaurant owners has arrived: world-famous Google reviewer, international food snob… aka me. First-time stop at Avo Miami, so here’s the lowdown.
Location's a win—right in the middle of Coconut Grove, easy to find and stylish enough. Staff? Friendly, helpful, no complaints there. So far, so good.
But then Friday night rolls in, and the place is practically empty. Not ideal. Makes you wonder if I missed the memo or if locals just know something I don’t. Food came out mostly fresh and portions were mostly fair but chicken was too dry and overcooked and the taste didn’t pack a punch. Spice levels were shy. A few dishes felt like they’d been resting a bit too long before leaving the kitchen. For a spot that leans into health-conscious vibes, I’d expect things like lentils to be pressure-cooked properly—those lectins aren’t just buzzwords.
Concept-wise, I’m all for it. Miami’s crowded with spots like Carrot Express, Pura Vida, etc., so the competition's real. I hope Avo sticks around, tightens up the flavors, and keeps improving. Would love to revisit and be pleasantly surprised next time.

author: Paola Martinez
review_text:
**Delicious and Welcoming!**

We had a great experience at **Avo in the Grove**! The atmosphere is warm and full of positive energy, perfect for families. The menu offers a nice variety of **healthy, organic options** with a tasty **Mediterranean twist**. I had the most delicious carrot-orange drink and avocado toast both were fresh and flavorful. We'll definitely be back!

author: Raechel Kowalik
review_text: First time going, I ordered a branzino bowl, and I’m definitely going to make this my new “pura vida.” Food actually cooked and seasoned well unlike the other place though. Lots of protein options, nutrition is well balanced and portions are big. Decor is nice, loads of places to sit, and not crowded.

author: Jen D
review_text: Tried this place while on vacation ! Loved all the healthy options . Tried the matcha pancakes , hot matcha and turmeric shot .

author: Anya Perez
review_text: I live this place! Food, ambiance & staff are all a 10/10. Our server Luca was sooo attentive & accommodated all our needs to ensure we had an amazing breakfast ❤️

author: Laura Zambrano
review_text:
I tried AVO in Coconut Grove today and was really impressed. I ordered the chicken pesto sandwich and a matcha latte—both were delicious. The matcha tasted super organic and clean, and the flavors in the sandwich were on point. The only thing is that the chicken pesto sandwich could’ve used a little more pesto, but nothing major.

A gentleman came to our table to ask how everything was and how we discovered the place. He was incredibly friendly—turns out he’s the owner. That gesture of checking in with guests, talking about the food, and explaining where the ingredients come from is truly top-notch hospitality.

Highly recommend this spot. Quality food, great service, and fair prices. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Ps: I was too hungry to take a picture 😣

author: Edward Jaffe
review_text: Avo=delicious clean fresh healthy food. Every item. Every time. We live out of town but come to Miami a lot. Healthy eating is important to us and it’s comforting to know we can always get a great meal here.

author: Carlos Cequea
review_text: The food at Avo Miami was absolutely delicious, and the service was excellent. Luca was incredibly attentive and friendly, making the whole experience even better. Highly recommended!

author: Alan Roger
review_text: We absolutely loved Avo! Such a cozy and beautiful place , the vibe is super nice and relaxing. The food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. Everything we tried was amazing! The service was great too, Lucas was so kind and attentive, he even came to our table to make sure everything was perfect. Definitely one of those spots you want to come back to. Highly recommended!

author: owned7000
review_text: Our server Lucas was absolutely wonderful! He was very attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. He checked in on us often, refilled our drinks quickly, and always had a friendly smile. The food came out just the way we ordered it, and Lucas made the whole experience very enjoyable. We couldn’t have asked for better service. Thank you, Lucas!

author: Trevion
review_text: Avo Miami is more than just a restaurant — it’s an experience filled with warmth, incredible food, and genuine connection. Lucas went above and beyond, not only providing exceptional service but also sharing words of wisdom that helped my wife and me find strength during a rough patch in our relationship. His kindness and insight turned what could’ve been just another lunch into something truly meaningful. The food was phenomenal — my pulled chicken sandwich on pita bread was perfectly seasoned and tender, while my wife’s lentil, rice, and grilled salmon bowl was bursting with flavor and freshness. The atmosphere was calming and welcoming, making it the perfect place to reconnect and recharge. Five stars aren’t enough — Avo Miami and Lucas helped remind us what love and good food are all about.

author: Marketing Miami LLC
review_text:
I had such a wonderful experience at AVO — everything from the food to the service was top-notch. I ordered the omelet and a coffee, and I have to say, both were absolutely incredible. The omelet was perfectly cooked, fluffy yet rich, and filled with fresh, flavorful ingredients that you could really taste with every bite. It felt light yet satisfying — a great balance that’s hard to find.

And the coffee? Easily one of the best I’ve had in Miami. It was smooth, bold, and clearly made with care. You can tell AVO prioritizes quality and doesn’t cut corners, even with the little things. What stood out even more was the attention to detail and the genuine hospitality from the staff. The environment is calm, beautiful, and welcoming — the kind of place where you can truly relax and enjoy your meal.

I’m already looking forward to coming back for another breakfast — and of course, for the famous pancakes next time!

author: Adriana Jaramillo
review_text: I had such a great experience at Avo! The food was absolutely delicious the food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming!! Lucas was incredibly friendly and helpful from start to finish. He made sure we had everything we needed and gave great recommendations. Definitely a place I’d come back to — highly recommend!

author: Lucus Arredondo
review_text: Food was absolutely amazing. Daniela was excellent. She was very helpful and walked me through every question I asked. Will be coming back again just cause of Daniela!

author: Justin Stein
review_text: Situated on the borders of Coconut Grove, this was one of our favorite places when we lived in Miami. Coming back, we remembered why we loved it, and enjoyed it again. The eggs scrambled were excellent, with mine coming with a generous helping of onions and nova. The potatoes were excellent, and our server’s attentiveness was perfect. Can’t wait to come back.

author: Nicoly Miyuki
review_text:
We has great time at Greenstreet cafe!
The ambience is absolutely beautiful,and lovely. Food is good, big portion but the French toast pistachio fell short, I barely tasted the pistachio cream.
Eggs Benedict was pretty good and tasty,  the sangria was the best.
I recommend for a big party family and couple.

author: SarElIG71
review_text:
Amazing our waiter Spencer made our afternoon so delightful for being our first time visiting you.
Food suggestions, even pictures with us
Your wings for sure, delicious.
My party and I got different stuff to try a lil bit of everything.  Salad, pasta and me your lamb chops. Everything was good.
If I can point something only, your sweet potato fries those were soft not crunchy as I ate them before. But if it that recipe, I understand.
Thank you,  you may see us again.

author: T O
review_text: was there this past Saturday for brunch. very popular place, and I understand why. Delicious food. I had the nova benedict.  It was very good. I think it would be better with kippered salmon, but of course that's a matter of taste. the pistachio cream stuffed french toast was the star  just delicious. will definitely be back.

author: Carlos Vivas
review_text:
A Must-Visit for Breakfast Lovers in Coconut Grove! 🌴☕🍳

Greenstreet Café is a true gem located in the heart of Coconut Grove, Florida. I came here for breakfast with my family and we were all thoroughly impressed. The atmosphere is vibrant and welcoming, with both indoor and outdoor seating that lets you soak in the Grove's charm.

The food was absolutely delicious — fresh ingredients, generous portions, and beautifully presented. We tried a mix of dishes: fluffy omelets packed with flavor, perfectly toasted breakfast sandwiches, and one of their signature plates that left us wanting more. They also offer crisp, fresh salads, and a variety of healthy options that make it easy to start your day right.

One of the highlights for me was the fresh-squeezed juices — vibrant, refreshing, and clearly made with care. Their coffee was rich and satisfying, a perfect pairing with our meal.

Service was friendly and attentive, and the overall vibe was laid-back yet classy — ideal for a relaxing morning out.

If you're in the Coconut Grove area and looking for a delicious breakfast spot with great service and a cozy atmosphere, I highly recommend Greenstreet Café. It’s the kind of place you’ll want to return to again and again.

author: Veronica P
review_text: way too much dressing mixed into my salad. the salmon that came in the salad was cooked well, and great flavor, but it was ~3.7 ounces in size. i also ordered the cinnamon bun pancakes, which came highly recommended by the waiter and others nearby, but it they were pretty underwhelming. they tasted like regular pancakes with a light glaze drizzled on top. considering they had a nice variety of coffee-based items on their menu, i expected the coffee to be good quality, but the black drip coffee tasted slightly burnt. overall, it was a meh experience for me.

author: Brayan Ramirez San Juan
review_text: Simply an amazing place, beautiful with excellent customer service, and very good food. Nothing bad to say, from the mac and cheese, to the truffle fries, to the pasta. Everything was delicious. The place was clean and quiet. Average parking.

author: PammyxPamela
review_text: It was my first time coming to green street cafe and I brought my family along as they are here on vacation. I had the pleasure of having Zoe as our server she was amazing and told us her favorite entrees and appetizers as we were unsure what to order. She was very attentive, super friendly, and welcoming. Thank you to Zoe we will be back here again. Very enjoyable experience. We will be asking for Zoe next time we come back. Thank you green street cafe.

author: Giselle T
review_text:
We had a wonderful dinner at GreenStreet Café on Sunday. My husband and I really enjoyed the cozy atmosphere, the delicious food, and overall great vibe of the place.

Our server, Zoe, was amazing — very kind, attentive, and professional. She made sure we felt comfortable and well taken care of throughout the entire evening.

It was a lovely experience and we’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

author: maryjayne elizabeth
review_text: the service here is outstanding! and the food? even better! the caesar salad is my favorite in miami, and the chicken alfredo is made to perfection. raciel is an amazing server!

author: Kristen Kirkwood
review_text:
Really couldn’t have had a worse experience here. Called in an order with a completely rude woman. Then we go to pickup food and it wasn’t there/ready. We waited over 1.5 hours for the food. Then when we got the “veggie burger” and side of asparagus it was awful. No bun. Four soggy strips of asparagus. Their food is so blah here. The staff was not nice or apologetic for this either. They were also talking rudely and complaining and guests could clearly hear.

Have been here at least 4 times and the only positive thing this place has is their location and outdoor seating other than that it’s a complete waste of time and money. Will never come back.

author: Mary B
review_text: Green street is a great staple on a strip full of other restaurants you can pick from. My favorite dish for breakfast is the Grove Benedict with grilled tomatoes as my side instead of potatoes, for lunch I love the Salmon salad, The salmon dip appetizer and the Salmon Penne pasta. The meat lasagna is delicious and so is the Lamburger. This place has been around for over a decade. Thanks green st for amazing food , service and atmosphere .

author: Sergio Aleman
review_text: Great chill place for breakfast. Service was great and food was delish

author: Wavy Bandz
review_text: My actual new #1 breakfast place first time here and me and my lady loved it food came out pretty quick our server was top notch excellent wish I could remember his name but he was amazing if you ever have a waitress Lightskin with no beard kinda looks like Ryan Garcia he’s the man lol he’ll make sure to get you right

author: Francelia Maurell
review_text: We had such a great experience at Green Street thanks to our server Desire. I came in with my mom my husband and my children, and she was absolutely amazing super attentive, kind, and patient. She went out of her way to make my children feel special, which meant so much to me as a mom. Our drinks and food were always taken care of, and she made the whole experience feel relaxed and enjoyable. Excellent service like hers truly makes a difference. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Diana Luft
review_text:
The place has really gone down the drain. The quality of the dishes was terrible. The service before was this place’s redeemable quality - not anymore!

They continued sitting people outside in areas they know flooded as it rained. We watched as a couple was basically rained on since the canopy had small tears and water pooled around them. It stopped raining for a few minutes, the couple paid and left, they cleaned the table. One of the waiters warned the hostess “it’s going to rain again.” And was shrugged off and a new party was seated again…..

author: Carlos Gonzalez M.
review_text:
Greenstreet Café is one of those places you don’t just visit once; you adopt it as a ritual. 🌿✨ From the first coffee to the last cocktail, the vibe carries that European charm seamlessly blended with Miami’s tropical spirit.

The menu is generous, designed to cover every craving: from breakfasts that feel like a weekend indulgence even on a Tuesday, to main dishes that strike the right balance between comfort food and subtle sophistication. The coffee is solid, the brunch is a classic, and the mimosas… well, let’s just say they’ve rescued more than a few Sundays. 🥂

Service is usually quick, always with a genuine smile, which makes a difference in a spot that’s popular and buzzing yet never loses its personal touch. The terrace is the crown jewel: dining under the trees with the hum of Coconut Grove around you is almost therapeutic.

In short, Greenstreet Café is the kind of place where time slows down, food tastes better than expected, and you end up promising yourself you’ll come back…. and you do.

author: unitedravers
review_text: This is my favorite after work spot. If you find yourself here during the weekend do yourself a favor and sit in the inside bar with Julissa if there are seats available. The sweetest bartender ever and she makes the best old fashions and cosmos. On top of that she is extremely quick juggling orders from the whole restaurant, coffee and the bar top. It’s truly inspiring to be served with someone with such good work ethic and that cares about their guest. I have a great experience every time.

author: Jania Consuegra
review_text: I love this place. No wonder why it’s busy all the time. Amazing prices, amazing food, amazing service. Definitely one of the restaurants to always go to in Coconut Grove. Pastas are a go to! Great drinks! Everything is good about this spot. Will always come back here

author: Rachel Butler
review_text: Loved this place overall - incredible food and $5 cocktails at happy hour. Great location on a corner in Coconut Grove too

author: Liza Chernov
review_text:
The reviews tell the truth!
I was skeptical at first for such a high review rate but it is true to reality!!

The food is phenomenal, we had the panini and Benedict, also the crepe for dessert and it was AMAZING!!  Texture spices presentation.. 10/10!

My recommendation if you plan to visit during the weekend— BOOK YOUR TABLE ONLINE , it gets VERY BUSY 11-2 pm ! We got it online and waited 5-10 minutes for our outside table.
Service was attentive, friendly, thank you Alfonso- I see why many write reviews for him! Friendly guy.

Overall 10/10 , recommend 100% , do get your printed coffee! Not only it’s aesthetic but also very tasty! (Especially the vanilla one)

author: Rupert A.
review_text:
The restaurant/Cafe is around the corner from the Marriott Cadillac.
It has a small indoor dining room and a large patio with umbrellas.
The menu is relatively e tensive for a cafe.
Service is exceptional and very accommodating.
Their specialty coffees are tasty.
The various mains that we had were very fresh and tasty and special requests for modifications were accepted with a smile.
The freshly made beignets were hot and delicious.
Very relaxed lunch in a laid back environment.

author: Roberts .J06
review_text: I came across this place while staying in the area. I actually could see this place from my hotel balcony. I looked it up and saw the amazing menu they had and wanted to go and try it. I really enjoyed the food and the staff was great! The coffee I had was amazing, first coffee of the day so my whole life depended on this coffee! Healthy delicious brunch! They have a seating outside that the water is across the street as well. Very great location and vibes .

author: Melanie Pliskin
review_text: Bon Bouquet was an absolute treat! The food was incredible. My son had the pancakes and my husband and I split the avocado toast and French toast. Everything was delicious but the French toast was really special. Our waitress, Calista, did a superb job as well! I would highly recommend this restaurant.

author: Lisa Weber
review_text:
Had breakfast here for the first time and it was a very good experience overall. The service really stood out – the waitress was incredibly kind, attentive, and fast, gave great advice, and genuinely thought ahead. She made us feel very well taken care of.
The only small downside was that it was quite loud, which made it a bit less relaxing. Looking back, I might have been a little unfriendly that day myself – which makes the professionalism and warmth of the service even more impressive.
I’d definitely come back.

author: Sai Kaushik Duvvur
review_text:
Dorian was an amazing host and took real great care of us, we really loved the food and the ambience is great!
My wife loved the custom  print on her and hot chocolate which they do. Would definitely come back!

author: Ilana Ash
review_text: This place is awesome!! Our server Calista was so sweet, very prompt, and made excellent recommendations! This was our first visit and certainly not our last. The cafe itself was so cute, very clean, and offered a lovely outdoor dining patio as well. My only negative, was it seemed like the AC wasn’t working, in which it was very uncomfortably warm, and the tables were very very close together (which is understandable as they made the most of the beautiful space they have). Overall, would absolutely recommend this spot, and will be back!

author: Lior Singer
review_text: This place deserves a Michelin star. Whoever created the dishes was extremely accurate and creative with the flavor combinations. I gave five stars before, but this place truly deserves it. The food deserves to win awards. Thank you so much for having us!

author: Donna Robinson
review_text: Came for the experience and succeeded. The food that I ordered I did not like at all. Others did enjoy their croissant sandwiches and said the potatoes were very good. I had the sourdough avocado toast it did not even come to average, but I will say the experience was great to be in. Customer service was attentive . I definitely recommend making reservations it is extremely busy place to go. You will have to pay for parking . The picture on the coffee have easy instructions to follow and that was my favorite part. The coffee taste was just subpar not really good at all, but I’m glad I was able to go and I would go again just order something different.

author: Annie Van Peter
review_text: We had a GREAT experience at Bon Bouquet!  The weather was so nice in Miami, we decided to sit outside.  Alfonso was our server.  He gave wonderful recommendations, and he was so attentive and was helpful with some dietary issues I have.  I enjoyed the Royale Benedict (subbing spinach for the muffin).  WOW!  It was fantastic!! I can’t recommend this restaurant enough!  If you’re fortunate enough to have Alfonso as your server, you’ll be treated Royale-ly!

author: Andrea Montgomery
review_text: Vanessa from Argentina was our server and she was so attentive and provided great service. Our party was a bigger party and some girls came late however she still handled everything in order and precisely. I had the turkey croissant which came with potatoes. I also tried the beignets and the caramel latte with my photo on it was amazing! Mica came and suggested that we take a photo in front of the flower Arc and she even accommodated Us by closing the doors and taking a photo of the entire group because there were 10 of us or more. I would recommend it and thank you ladies for your service.

author: Kevin Hubbard
review_text: The food and smoothie were both excellent but this place shines because of their service. Calista was one of the best servers I've ever seen. Not only did she handle my table with care, there was a difficult person at the table next to me who had some pretty odd requests. Not only did she not question them, the chef came out to confirm exactly how the person wanted his food, showing that this attitude is part of the culture of the cafe. Kudos to the management who are fostering such a great environment. If my business was in Miami I definitely would have tried to offer Calista a job working for me.

author: Amber Caracol Noguchi
review_text: Alfonso was such a great server. He gave us really good recommendations (we got the Turkey and Brie Crepe and the Pepperoni sandwich on a croissant with provolone 🤤) , was super attentive to our needs, read my mind when I needed a coffee refill, and also helped us order more for carry out. The coffee hit the spot, food was really tasty, and service was exceptional! Mahalo nui (thank you) Alfonso!

author: Tatsiana Tsiushkevich
review_text: I think the rating is overstated. The place is very busy, so be ready to wait. The coffee was just average, and the avocado toast had a very modest amount of avocado. There are definitely much better breakfast spots in this area.

author: Daniela Duenas
review_text: BEST BREAKFAST EVER!!! Alfonso was our server, he is from colombia like us and was soo nice!!!! He made accurate and diet specific recommendations. He recommended the french toast as one of the most popular items, and it was SOOO GOOD! Overall a great experience, the food is amazing and the atmosphere is gorgeous. But our waiter Alfonso truly tied it all together to a perfect experience

author: Allison Doody
review_text: Food was absolutely incredible, we had Calista as our waitress and she was wonderful. Her service felt like fine dining! She was so bright and kind. It added to the whole experience! If you’re visiting Miami definitely stop by here for any brunch and breakfast needs!!!

author: Alvi Rahman
review_text: Excellent food, amazing service. The latte art stuff is incredible, we printed a photo of our son on a caramel macchiato put a huge smile on our faces and was delicious. Very accommodating with high chairs and friendly service.

author: Maria Valenzuela
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had a wonderful experience at Bon Bouquet Coffee Shop, thanks to Calista! From the moment I walked in, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Her customer service was exceptional—friendly, professional, and thoughtful. She made great recommendations and ensured everything was perfect from start to finish. Calista’s positive energy truly elevated my visit and made it feel special. Outstanding service like hers is the reason I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! ☕🌸

author: Faith Rhodes
review_text:
A Must-Visit Gem! 🌸
We had an amazing time at Bon Bouquet Café! Even though the place was fully booked, our food came out incredibly fast and everything was delicious. Our server was attentive, efficient, and made us feel so welcome throughout the meal. The atmosphere was lively but cozy, and you could tell the staff really had their rhythm down. We’re already planning to come back to try more of the menu—it all looked so good! If you're thinking of visiting, I highly recommend booking your reservation in advance—they fill up quickly, and it’s easy to see why.
Can’t wait for round two!

author: Lisa Eckel
review_text: Do not miss this spot!  Our waiter Alfonso was awesome!!  Get the latte with your own photo!  Coffee delish. Crepe amazing.   So glad we came!

author: Eduardo Marrero
review_text: We drove through the area to try these restaurants we noticed, which are popular among Italian food fans. They recommended specific pastas and their pizza. It was quite a drive for me since I was in Doral and it was pouring rain, but it was definitely worth the trip. If you’re nearby, try the thin-crust pizza—it's worth it even if you’re not close by. You won't be disappointed, and you can also take a walk along the marina and enjoy a bit of North Bay Village.

author: George P
review_text: Petralunga is one of those places that stays on your mind after you leave. The standout is the thin, crispy pizza, which you order first and then compare all other pizzas to. Their simple yet really good fresh lemonade is perfect, especially when enjoyed outdoors overlooking the marina and bay. It’s on the pricier side for casual dining, making it more suitable for “date night” or special outings with friends rather than a regular weeknight dinner. However, with the scenic water views, the Italian pizza-and-cocktail atmosphere, and that fantastic crust, it definitely deserves a solid 4 stars.

author: Julieta Williams
review_text: After moving to North Beach on 2022, we are finally checking Petralunga! On a beautiful and perfect sky early evening, we had our lovely table under the stars. Sofia was our server and she was absolutely great! Our salad, pizza and Tiramesu were great. Our cocktails were also on point. We will certainly be returning. Bravo!🙌🏼🇮🇹

author: Sergio Murgas
review_text:
We visited Petralunga and had a very pleasant experience. We ordered several dishes to share and overall we were satisfied.
The Cacio e Pepe stood out for its great texture and a creamy, well-balanced flavor. The burrata was fresh, pairing nicely with the bread and olive oil.
The fried calamari were crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, not greasy at all — a solid start to the meal. The tuna tartare was fresh, beautifully presented, and had a clean flavor.

Nice atmosphere, friendly service, and good quality dishes. A recommended spot for a relaxed meal with Italian flavor.

author: Sakshi2 Jaiswal
review_text: We stumbled upon this little gem and tried their “Hidden Gem” pizza, which is perfectly named. It was honestly the best pizza I’ve ever had. On top of that, their tiramisu was absolutely mind-blowing. I don’t even have the words to describe the flavor, but I would recommend this place to anyone visiting or living here.

author: Tatiana Santos
review_text:
I visited Petralunga in North Miami because they had a 50% off promotion on everything — and honestly, that was too good to miss! The place itself is very nice, the atmosphere feels welcoming, and the service was absolutely outstanding — everyone was attentive and friendly from start to finish.

The pizzas were really good, and the tiramisu was one of the best I’ve had in Miami — truly a must-try dessert. However, I also ordered the tuna tartare and the tableside cacio e pepe, and those didn’t impress me as much.

I’d definitely come back for dessert and a glass of wine, maybe even a pizza night, but probably not for a full dinner.

The only downside is parking — it took me almost 25 minutes to find a spot, so be prepared for that if you visit during busy hours.

author: maria jose
review_text: Great food and vibes! Recommend Bruskhlyn Pizza and cacio e pepe pasta! Linguine Al frutti Di mare was okay, I had better ones. Servers need to be more open with what you’re being charged for example bread: it was given like it comes with the service. FYI, the tips are included at 20%, and they are charged even when it's just a 2-person date.

author: Ashley Nessl
review_text: Came on a Sunday some what randomly, they asked if we had reservations I didn’t really know was need from just stumbling upon this place but they were very accommodating and luckily able to get us in plus a table outside which was amazing, but I would recommend going the route of a reservation. Also was pleasantly surprised to find out everything was 50% off, and they do this every Saturday and Sunday. From here on out the food and service was amazing Sofia took very well care of us and ordered a few of her recommended items. And naza was very kind I will definitely be returning and loved my experience

author: Omar A Morillo
review_text:
We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience at Petra Lunga in North Miami Beach! From start to finish, everything was top-notch. The service was attentive and friendly, and the owner even came by to greet us, making us feel truly welcomed.

We started with the Metzi meatballs, which were absolutely delicious. The tableside cacio e pepe was a highlight—prepared in a giant wheel of parmesan and topped with truffles, it was simply phenomenal. We also loved the pizza with pepperoni, stracciatella, and a drizzle of hot honey—it was the perfect blend of flavors. The New York strip was a bit overcooked for our liking, but still flavorful and enjoyable.

To top it all off, we indulged in their desserts—the tiramisu and the berries panna cotta—both were delightful and the perfect ending to our meal.

The atmosphere, with outdoor seating by the bay, was just perfect for a relaxing evening. We even got to enjoy a digestivo, including a lovely limoncello. Overall, we highly recommend Petra Lunga and can’t wait to come back!

author: Luz Rodríguez
review_text:
I had an amazing experience at Liu. The food was absolutely delicious, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. But what truly made the visit unforgettable was our server. She went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, offering attentive, friendly, and personalized service that turned a great meal into a unique and memorable experience.

Highly recommended!

author: Maria Klann
review_text:
Is not what I expected. I saw one of those amazing reviews on Instagram about this restaurant, but in real life it’s not like that.

The lobster ravioli with zucchini was very rich and salty.
The service is fantastic. The meat was also salty—it was ok, but nothing that takes my breath away.
The tuna appetizer was fresh and good.
Meatballs are good.

About the place…
The restaurant is located on the first floor of an old building that lacks of maintenance. It’s very informal  and there is not ocean view. It’s a view to the marine which is obstructed by some walls.

This restaurant is good for local people who around the area and for the marina.

author: Sileirim Ortega
review_text: This is the typical restaurant that is hyped up by influencers but DOES NOT DELIVER. We entered the restaurant and we were not acknowledged by anyone passing by. Everyone would look directly at us and not even ask if we were being helped. After a few minutes my boyfriend asked a waiter who could attend us, and then he served us. Food was mid AT BEST. The food lacked quality and taste. The pizza was the best tasting plate but it is extremely thin crust, which is not my favorite. The view was great and ambiance was good, but definitely not worth it. I suggest skipping it.

author: Estrella Sagarzazu
review_text: Beautiful waterfront Italian restaurant with exceptional service from Regina. Delicious food, creative drinks, and a perfect atmosphere for a great time. We enjoyed the weekend lunch special — 50% off made it even better! Highly recommend.

author: Leidi Chavez
review_text: This beautiful waterfront restaurant is located near the marina offering inside and outside seating. Place is nicely decorated,  offering some cool photo opportunities especially if you are a ninja turtle fan. Fun. The fresh roses by the tables were a nice touch. Their menus, especially the drink menu is surprisingly extensive which is cool, although a bit pricey. All the food we ordered came out very tasty and fresh. Now, our server was not as attentive as we wish and we had to be reminding him of things, plus service was slow. Besides that, we had a nice experience, but I will recommend management to be in top of the servers to ensure service is to their standards. We will be back again.

author: Glori Acosta
review_text:
I had high hopes for Petralunga and their Cacio e Pepe tableside cheese wheel , but unfortunately, the food didn’t live up to the expectations. From the meatballs to the pasta, everything was just average at best.

The wait for our food was unusually long, and when it finally arrived, the pasta was cold. It honestly felt like something I could’ve made at home.

That said, the tableside tiramisu was actually pretty good — it’s the main reason I gave them three stars.

In addition, the setting is undeniably beautiful. The waterfront location creates a stunning atmosphere and is perfect for photos. I really wish I had come during their 2-for-1promotion — because at full price, the dishes simply don’t justify the cost.

author: Phillip Delgado
review_text:
The pizza was spectacular!!! Light, thin and yummy!! We got the Margarita with pepperoni and the Brusklyn is a must have!!!
Our waitress, Sophia was amazing!! Kind, attentive and friendly.

We are definitely returning for pasta!!

author: Thalia Pardo
review_text:
My boyfriend and I had dinner here and wow… everything was so much better than we expected. The food was incredible seriously, every single thing we ordered was delicious. We tried a bunch of different dishes (we definitely went all out), and not one disappointed. The flavors were rich, portions were perfect, and it all looked just as good as it tasted.

Our server Amanda was amazing — super friendly, helpful, and just made the whole night feel even more special. You could tell she actually cared.

The vibe of the restaurant was also really nice cozy but classy, and just felt like a great place to unwind and enjoy the evening. We left full and happy, already talking about coming back again. Highly recommend.

author: Irene Curbelo
review_text: The place is beautiful. It has options to sit inside our outside by the marina. The music inside is good enough to enjoy a meal with a beautiful conversation. It is clean, staff is friendly. Very good customer service and attention. Food is AMAZING. Servings easily serve 2 people, the dessert comes with a cute presentation. It is fresh and tasty. The drinks selection is so good. So many tequilas .. they can even make your cocktail with the tequila of choice. Our waiter was Malena, truly recommend her , she knows her menu and her recommendation were 10/10

author: Noah Jaid
review_text: Liu was amazing! She was super kind, attentive, and made our experience really enjoyable. She checked on us often without being overwhelming and made sure we had everything we needed. She was genuinely one of the best servers we’ve ever had. You could tell she cared about giving great service, and her friendly personality stood out the whole time. She made us feel welcome, and her positive energy made the visit even better. We really appreciate her and hope to have her as our server again. Highly recommend!

author: O D
review_text: Petralunga is one of those hidden places that you must visit in Miami. The food is delicious (the bolognese, caccio e Pepe, and cocktails) but the best part is the service. Every single member of the staff is very friendly and knowledgeable, but especially Sofia and Naza. They made our experience so much better

author: Vaughn Rondon
review_text: "If you’re looking for a perfect broadwalk spot, Nick’s Bar & Grill is it! I stopped in and was blown away by the food. The clam chowder was rich and loaded with flavor—definitely a highlight. I followed it up with the fish and chips, which were perfectly crispy and fresh. To top it all off, the Don Julio margaritas were expertly made and hit the spot while people watching. Great vibes, football game on multiple screens, and topped off by Karaoke after the game. Excellent service right on the boardwalk. I’ll definitely be back!"

author: Aleksandr L.
review_text: Good enough to eat there twice. The oysters were fresh, steak was ordered was blue rare, Mahi Mahi filled was slightly over cooked(i like mine undercooked and forgor to mention that to the server) and the kids had hamburger that was cooked to medium rare.  Was satisfied 😌 and service was great.

author: Sara Calvey
review_text: I've been to Hollywood a few times and I have to say I always come back to this place. Its open till 4(whoo!) The frozen drinks and priced average for the boardwalk but tasty. They have decent bar food-great for a hangover. If youre a sports fan they will more than likely have it on somewhere in the bar. Good views and good staff

author: Carito Ingberg
review_text:
Nick’s Bar and Grill is a good spot if you’re looking for a casual date or a place to hang out with friends. I wouldn’t call it family-oriented, but it works well for meeting up, especially to watch a game — there are screens everywhere. The location is great, right by the beach with nice views, and the place feels fresh inside with air conditioning.

Food was fine — nothing extraordinary but decent. We had the mojo mahi (grilled fish) and fish & chips, both good. Portions were fair and service was friendly. Bathrooms were clean, which is always a plus.

The biggest downside for me was the music. It was extremely loud, making it impossible to have a conversation. The playlist itself felt random and didn’t really match the vibe. I understand it’s a bar, but it doesn’t need to feel like a nightclub. Seating is mostly high tables inside, with only a handful of low tables outside (maybe 4).

Overall, a fun place if you’re going for drinks, sports, or loud energy. If you’re looking for a quieter dinner with conversation, this might not be the right choice.

author: Kylie Mahaney
review_text:
Stopped here for a beachside lunch and it was perfect.

We started with the Old Bay peel-and-eat shrimp, simple and delicious. Our server recommended the sweet Thai chili wings and the flounder sandwich, and both were great. The wings were crispy, meaty, and flavorful, and the sandwich was huge and tasty.

Service was super friendly, and sitting on the boardwalk made for great people-watching. Definitely a solid spot if you’re in the area.

author: Ms Jackson
review_text: The bar sotsvon the beach.They had Karoke night, the DJ made it very fun. The food came ot pretty fast. The waitress service was good despite the bar being busy.

author: Jared Weggeland
review_text: My wife and I were staying for just one night before an activity tomorrow nearby. We enjoyed some time on the beach, then looked for somewhere to have a tasty dinner. As we were walking along the boardwalk I smelled the burgers cooking and had to try. The atmosphere was upbeat and exciting. The staff were friendly. Our server forgot something and remedied it immediately. He was very attentive and our drinks never saw an empty bottom. The onion rings appetizers was very fresh, crispy and came with a zesty chipotle dipping sauce. I had the jalapeño Swiss burger and added bacon. It came with all the fixings and the fries were uber crispy. There was plenty of sauce to go around. I am glad we stopped by. This was a good choice. Thanks for the good food and service. I would recommend the place.

author: Mike Fitzpatrick
review_text: The bartender was wicked awesome. She was so incredibly friendly, attentive.  The place is clean (the floor can be slick , due to the type of floor), and the little food I had was good. If you are sitting at the indoor side of the bar, and someone on the outside side of the bar is smoking, it blows into the indoor folks. Doesn't bother me personally, but it may bother some. Also a very good beer selection. Dogfish Head, Funky Budha, etc. About 20-25 beers. All bottles, no draft.

author: Joanne Wardell
review_text: Fun little shop, I got an entree of fries, he got an ENORMOUS burger, I got so much fries I could barely finish them, not a bad price either. Very attentive server with the round glasses. Thank you for having us!

author: Leidi Chavez
review_text: This restaurant’s location is excellent since it’s right at the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk and offers a great view of the beach. They open until late and they have indoors and outdoors seating weather permitting of course. This last time we visited during lunch and ended up ordering some burgers which tasted very good as well as the drinks. Our server was attentive and welcoming.

author: Oliver Glasemacher
review_text: Had an amazing strip steak,  perfectly grilled,  nice and quick staff, absolutely love this place. Great views of the beach.

author: Starasia Starr
review_text: Fantastic view, fans blowing, great breeze, amazing server and decent food. Loved the salad with salmon, better than the mahi mahi. Good clams steamed in a delicious garlic wine and butter sauce. Big portions. Excellent sweet potato fries. Great place to eat when at Hollywood Beach. Nightly live music but we were there for lunch.

author: P Oneliv
review_text:
Great place to eat right on the Boardwalk facing the Beach and Ocean.

The restaurant was clean and well staffed by friendly employees. Restrooms were also available.

The Food and Drink menu has something for everyone and the prices were fair and the portions were more than adequate. The Burger was gigantic and cooked as ordered.

Our Server EDDIE was the Best!

author: Debbie Gettler
review_text: Fabulous vibe, great food and outstanding service by Stu! Highly recommend the wings , fries and cadillac margaritas. Perfection with a lovely ocean view. We will definitely be back.

author: Anna Cammarota
review_text: Great food and service, music every night, place to come back over and over, nice atmosphere and right in the boardwalk

author: Oscar Pozo
review_text:
Last Saturday I ordered 3 beers ($24) at the bar. Upon checking my debit card statement, I was charged $100 for this order. Highly unprofessional.
LAST MONTH WAS THE SAME THING!!!!
Be careful with these people 🚨🚨🚨🚨

author: David A.
review_text: This was a fun experience and our group really enjoyed it. We visited during a tropical storm which was unfortunate but the inside is lively and the service was great. We enjoyed the food we tried and the drinks hit the spot. I'm sure when the weather is gorgeous and you're visiting the beach, there couldn't really be a better choice.

author: Michael Holly
review_text: We really loved this place and will be back. The beers were ice cold and our burger and mahi sandwich were delicious.   The only negative was the oblivious bartender who was unfriendly and not attentive at all

author: Carter Schlenz
review_text: Awesome restaurant. Very good food. Our waitress came to our table 3-4 times to check up on us. She was very friendly. My meal was 16.99 with then we added the fries so it was 2.50 more. On the pricier side. Otherwise it was great!

author: Andre Ouimet
review_text: Stopped in for a double rye during the week. A real comfortable place to stop. I tried them on Friday, but left after I was told that double was going to cost me 6 dollars more, coming in over 20 dollars.

author: Rachel Ochoa
review_text:
Great place for authentic Peruvian! Our old favorite spot closed down further down the broadwalk, so we tried this place today, Christmas Eve, for lunch.  Arrived at 12:15 and our party of 4 were seated right away by our friendly server, Roberto. It was a gorgeous day at the beach and a little crowded, but not crazy.

Menu options are great! The kids ordered lemonade refreshers with popping boba (what a fun item to have on the menu!) One got mango and the other got strawberry. The kids split arroz chaufa with steak (my husband tried it and said the steak was excellent). Hubs got seafood ceviche which he said was tasty and spicy.I ordered aji de gallina (one of my favorite Peruvian dishes). It was delicious! I couldn't even finish it! So happy we tried this place out!

author: May M
review_text: We were a big group and everyone was very happy with their food.  Music was great too.  The service was excellent. Overall experience was amazing! It was our first time. We will definitely be back.  :)

author: Karen C
review_text: I found this restaurant on Google, looking for a place to spend a relaxing time with my family. We love Peruvian food (I have been to Peru), so At Peru caught my attention. Everything was delicious! We tried the jalea, pesto with chicken and steak (both tender), fish ceviche, yuca a la huancaina, lomo saltado, and pisco sour. Hector, our waiter, was the best! He was very patient, friendly, and had a great sense of humor. Definitely coming back.

author: Flicka Zhang
review_text: The food was super nice!!! Highly recommend the shared snack seafood dishes. The service was nice and it’s a great place for gathering with friends.

author: Nathan Renaud
review_text: This place has it all excellent atmosphere, delicious food, and a great staff. The food is delicious and they give you surprisingly a lot of seafood in your dish. The food is absolutely delicious and at a great price. If you are T the beach you need to come visit At Peru.

author: Camila Mora
review_text: Great service! The owner came to check in on us multiple times. The food was delicious, we got the grilled octopus, grilled shrimp skewers, chicken chaufa, and the steak with pesto pasta. Will come again!!!

author: Ori Aphek
review_text: The ceviche was so so... The fish was chewy, and there was very little added to it. My partner ate the Salmon which wad OK. Not more. The fried calamari was pretty good. It's a fun place to sit and eat while watching the sea and the bypassers. But the food is nothing to write about.

author: MP Fashion
review_text:
Disappointing experience

We came here for my birthday dinner, and while our server was kind and professional, the experience was disappointing. My seafood dish arrived with something in it, so I couldn’t eat it. The management only removed the dish from the bill, which felt like the bare minimum. For a birthday dinner, I expected better care and responsibility from the restaurant.

author: Angie Roze
review_text: One of my favorite spots to go to… Great spot, amazing food and the staff is fantastic! Plus… the beach view. Can’t ask for more… 10/10 recommend.

author: Irene Smith
review_text: The food was delicious, the portions plenty. The server Roberto was super nice and friendly.

author: Jaime Schlegel
review_text: Rony is the absolute best!!! So familiar with the menu and makes the very best Espresso Martini’s❤️❤️❤️ Definitely will be back again!! Don’t miss this gem Lima Peru on the Hollywood broadwalk

author: Online Support
review_text: Unbelievably delicious ceviche and snapper. Highly recommended. Staff is top notch as well!

author: Brittney Casalina
review_text: Great experience! The drinks, food and atmosphere were incredible! Highly recommended! Our server, Roberto, was fantastic!!

author: pamela grandon
review_text: Great service from Ronny. Ceviche was delicious and the Yellow rice and seafood was also good. Big portion and great view.

author: Debbie Z
review_text: Had breakfast at At Peru this morning. I come to Hollywood Beach every year. Absolutely the best breakfast on the beach. Classic American - crispy bacon is actually crispy and tastes great. Potatoes have just the right amount of seasoning. Pancake is cooked perfectly. Not too mushy. Not too dry. Ronny is a fantastic server. Prices are reasonable - well actually cheap per HB standards. Price is cheap but food is not. Did I mention we eat here at least 4 times during our one week visit! You can’t go wrong if you eat breakfast at At Peru but you sure can go right!

author: Carolina Sanchez
review_text: My waiter Héctor was very friendly and so was Luis ..and the food really good, good portion and the coffee delicious I  totally recommend it !

author: Lenore Johnson
review_text: Fantastic. Ronny (manager) was absolutely fantastic.  I arrived after a rough day of delayed red-eye travel and he took fantastic care of me.  Great food, great service, great prices while looking at the ocean.   Who could ask for more?

author: Catherine Shelton
review_text: Everyone loved the ceviche trio, pisco sours and yellow seafood rice

author: Gorkem Topal
review_text:
Picked up my to-go order, and I loved it. Tasty food, great service, and the owner was genuinely polite and caring.

And back again — couldn’t stay away!  And wanted to update my review.
I wanted to try something else and it was so good. Thank you for great food and service. Let’s check the photos out!!!

author: Kevin Simpson
review_text: We ate here twice while in Hollywood, Florida. Highly recommend the breakfast meal. Roberto and the team were amazing!

author: indy Del
review_text: Only came here for breakfast twice during my stay. I'm normally not a pancake person but let me tell you..EXCELLENT pancakes, fluffy, fresh and NOT too thick. The eggs were good and home fried potatoes were fresh. Coffee was nice and strong, nice views-oceanfront. Music too loud in the morning. Save that for the night crowd. My service was friendly and prompt both days. Best bang for your buck. Under $10 for fresh breakfast.

author: Yoandra R
review_text:
Amazing view and music 🎶
We had a great time and enjoyed the food. Had the biggest drinks I’ve ever had in my life.
Hopefully I will get to visit it again.

author: Jason L
review_text: Large open space restaurant with great latin themed music. Beautiful view of the beach and boardwalk. The fried snapper was huge (MP~$40) and very well cooked, very tasty with plenty of rice and salad. Probably better for 2 people, but I eat alot. My server Tatiana was very nice and provided wonderful service (also very beautiful ). The piña colada was also huge lol. If I had to give a complaint, I wouldve preferred sitting by a fan as it was very humid but that's Florida in the midday for you. I will definitely come back again! saludos de NY!!

author: Rosa Almonte
review_text:
Atmosphere is wonderful, great music and view. Service was not bad. However the food was terrible by far the worst ceviche I have ever had and the fried fish looked amazing and was decently seasoned but it was over cooked and extremely dry. Drinks look deceivingly great but taste like cheap liquor and cheap mixer. Overall, great ambience and view decent service but terrible over priced food.
1 appetizer 1 entree to share and two drinks for 175 dollars. Will not be returning.

author: Bethany Ely
review_text: The Food is good and tastes authentic. They provide large portions. The environment is fun, vibrant, and loud. FYI, they add 18% to your ticket no matter what you order.

author: S T 3 P H 4 N I 3
review_text:
You guys need more servers, and I'm not sure how many chefs yall have back there. But yall either need to PICK UP THE PACE OR HIRE MORE CHEFS!!! Last night me and my family sat down and asked for our food. We waited for AN HOUR!!! AN HOUR!! They gave my dad's food first. And from what I was looking at the rice looks exactly like THE RICE THEY SERVED, DRY!! even the school lunch is better. Also, WHY IS WAS MY DAD'S FOOD SO EXPENSIVE??? IT WAS JUST ONE PERSON MY GOODNESS. IT WAS LIKE 40 dollars FOR ONE PERSON!!!!
Don't think I didn't see the other waiting tables either or the MANY bad reviews i have seen on here, I've been watching at least 5 of you waitresses walking around, some talking to people and the rest just serving a big undercooked fish for supposedly 3 people.
How do you get a FLY? IN SOMEONE'S FOOD? A STICKER IN SOMEONE'S FOOD?? there are probably even worse reviews than mine.

You ALL need to do better or there will be consequences.
Have a good day.
:)

author: Luis Torres
review_text:
This is a solid 3.5.  View is amazingHe hadn't fears.Great, but the food leaves a lot to be desired. But this review is just my opinion.

The fried snapper had good flavor but was extremely dry.
The ceviche  portion was generous but it looked like  it was just thrown lazily  thrown together (precooked shrimp no fish or octopus)  and lacked flavor.

If you love resort drinks you’ll  love the frozen stuff here. They just taste off.

author: Kerly Skaret
review_text: Great atmosphere! The food portion was amazing, the food itself was delicious. The drinks were great! Waitress was very attentive and positive. All in all we had a great time here.

author: maryori guadalupe
review_text: Nice presentation and friendly staff. Mahi tacos were amazing but the chicken was a little over cooked and I could taste shrimp cross contamination flavor in the cilantro rice which felt like it was just reheated and not fresh at all. Not a lot flavor in the rice and beans .Nice view in front of the beach. Little too expensive for tacos 🌮. Meh nothing to write home about in my opinion. Sorry 😐

author: Liz Dunn
review_text: Went here recently for dinner. We were seated quickly and our order was taken relatively quickly. My husbands food (Cuban sandwich) and our d inks came out in about 15 minutes. The rest of our order did not come. After 45 minutes I asked about it and was told it’s a restaurant and it’s busy. No apologies. No offer to expedite. We ordered a burger (for my five year old and 3 year old to split) and two orders of tacos. Nothing fancy. The attitude of the wait staff and management was unreal. I could not believe how rude they were. Also the music is unbearably loud. Do not go here.

author: Addie Monopoly
review_text: I had The shrimp cocktail that was yummy & my daughter had chicken Tenders w/ fries but wasn’t a big fan & she’s very picky. So don’t be discouraged I saw a lot of the plates looked really yummy and people seem to enjoy them. It’s on the board walk so if ur on the beach u can take it to go. Also had a yummy piña colada to go and my daughter had a virgin daiquiri.

author: Patty Lopez
review_text: Love outdoor seating looking at the beach. We shared while fried snapper, sent should've warned how big this thing is $85 worth it was 2 of us, this is enough for 4 people. Flavor was great but the wait is long.  Enough room for large parties.

author: Rachel Jacobs
review_text: What a fun beach place to get some good food and listen to live music/DJ. Great for day time. Went for lunch, family friendly and has beach bar vibe. We didn’t get the whole fried snapper this time but it looked amazing, and can be shared with several people. I also got one of their virgin drinks, a bikini frozen mango was really good and was able to share with my older child. Next time in Sunny Isles will be back again.

author: Kent Rasmussen
review_text:
If you’re looking for authentic, energetic, and rich Latin culture, Mamacitas is the spot on the Broadwalk.

You’re met with vibrant energy from the moment you arrive—live music or a DJ spinning Latin beats, strong margaritas that hit just right, and a menu full of bold, flavorful dishes. The food is fantastic—fresh, in generous portions, and delicious. Whether you’re there for a casual afternoon lunch or a lively night out, Mamacitas delivers the whole experience. Highly recommend if you want to soak in the sights, sounds, and tastes of Latin culture right on the beach.

author: Sharee Edwards
review_text: CHEF'S KISS 💋 the snapper was absolutely amazing .. we were a little hesitant because we didn't think it would be seasoned well, but WHEW it was seasoned perfectly .. it was enough at least 4 people, but we were so hungry my cousin and I ate majority with a little to spare LOL My only complaint was that our waitress was non-existent.. I guess because 18% gratuity was already included, there's a feeling of "no need to check on tables im getting paid regardless." she didn't check on us once .. other than that, it was well worth the $120

author: Sylvia
review_text: Super casual and fun cantina style spot on the Hollywood boardwalk overlooking the beach and the sea! Serving great authentic food from Cuba and Mexico! The whole fried snapper is a must try! It is big enough for 4 people to share. Enjoy it with savory cocktails while taking in the awesome Latin vibes. The service was great, and our server, Karen, was awesome! She went above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed our meal and the time. If you don't want a huge meal, there is plenty to choose from in the extensive menu. Great place to hang out and have drinks, too! It has Latin music playing the whole time. You will not be disappointed if you love Latin food, music, and vibes!

author: Tony Rosca
review_text: Mamacita’s Latin Bar & Grill in Hollywood, FL, delivers a lively beachfront dining experience. Located at 591 N Broadwalk, its ocean views and vibrant Latin atmosphere are undeniable draws. The menu features Mexican and Cuban dishes like shrimp ceviche, Cuban sandwiches, and their signature Red Snapper, praised for its freshness but sometimes criticized for lacking seasoning. Guacamole and chips are a hit, described as “on point” and fresh, though some find portions small for the price. A medium piña colada costs $20, reflecting medium-high prices that some reviewers on Tripadvisor and Yelp call overpriced, especially for drinks like margaritas, which can lack potency. Service is inconsistent—some praise the friendly staff and quick breakfast service (e.g., $6 eggs and pancakes), while others report slow, inattentive servers and issues like missing items or rude interactions. Food quality varies; tacos and seafood soups shine, but some dishes, like churrasco, disappoint due to overcooking. Street parking is challenging, often requiring patience to find a spot. Despite mixed reviews (3/5 on Tripadvisor, 2/5 on Yelp), the beachfront location and live Latin music make it a fun, if flawed, spot.

author: Nereida Crespo
review_text: My favorite restaurant on the Hollywood beach boardwalk. Always my first stop for food when I visit. Great food, service & music with beautiful views of the beach. Highly recommend this place!

author: Jay Culley
review_text:
Food was OK.  My wife's Huevos Rancheros were delicious.  My fish tacos were so-so. The table next to us for the snapper,  which was a pretty cool presentation as the whole fish.  It looked like they enjoyed it.

I did think it was really cool that they have 2 separate kitchens... Mexican and Cuban.

author: Hamza Juman
review_text: The food was excellent. Very tasty! Our waitress was super nice, very attentive. Excellent mimosa's and did not have to wait long at all for the food. Definitely one of my new favorite chill spots at Hollywood Beach.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Annie
review_text: My partner and I decided to check out Taco Beach Shack today given the great reviews and our craving for Mexican food and I can say it definitely did not disappoint! Kourtney, our hostess/ server was the friendliest person; she had a great personality and gave us the scoop on all the different foods on the menu. The food itself was amazing and fresh. We had dined at another Mexican place earlier in our trip on the Broadwalk but Taco beach shack was so much better! I tip my hat off to Kourtney and the gang at Taco beach shack, great food and service. I would highly recommend.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: MultiBeatlesROCK
review_text: We were staying at the hotel+suites next door to the Taco Shack, we had dinner and lunch there. It was A-MAZING!!!!!! Super delicious food! The Churrasco Steak was mouth watering. HUGE SHOUTOUT to our server Alexander, he was very welcoming and gave great service!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: sally blankenship
review_text:
I probably could have had a better meal at a chain restaurant for half the price. Do not order the chips and queso. Unless you went nachos, like you get at the basketball games. This place had the most reviews and their reviews gave it a 4.6 rating. I'm gonna say a bunch of young partying tourists are the ones that rate this place. The steak tacos were too hard to chew.  The chips were overcooked. The cheese for the chips and queso was nasty, liquid cheese from a can and wasn't even spicy. The only mexican sauce they provided was a bottle of valentinos. Believe it or not the best thing I ate there was the "street corn" and that wasn't even all that. They rang us up for somebody else's order.
Not bringing us a ticket, just ringing us up. It was two meals and a kid's meal And one beverage. They rang us up for 139 dollars. I then tipped without realizing they already give themselves a tip. Gratuity is added no matter the size apparently. Because we were charged for gratuity for a party of two and a half. I then asked if I could see an itemized statement, because I couldn't believe that's what we just paid. And thankfully, I did that because then I realized we were being billed for a picture of margaritas. And for adults that were sitting a table away from us. The beans were beyond salty. I literally think someone dropped a container of salt in there and said, i'm gonna run with this. The rice was mediocre. Needless to say, we would not recommend this place to anyone.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Samuel Godbout
review_text: The tacos at Taco Beach Shack were absolutely delicious, packed with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. The service was friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we sat down. Despite how busy it was, the waiting time was impressively short, both for seating and for the food to arrive. Overall, it was a great spot for quality tacos and fast service.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Shelley Skrine
review_text: This was the coolest place! They fully commit to the atmosphere, quality and service. The food was fresh and excellent. Yela was our waitress and she was very sweet and quick! The best part is that our hotel partners with them for discounts and margaritas. I highly recommend this place and if I ever come back to Hollywood Beach. We will revisit!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Dana Beisengaliyeva
review_text: I had a wonderful time at Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant, with my mom and auntie. The staff were friendly and attentive, I would say Big Thanks to Nicholas, our guy who gave us great service! Even though it was raining, short stuff, he was so respectfully talking to us and being super nice! I think he is a great asset for this place who made our experience in this place so easy, so we could relax.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Amy Liz
review_text: Me and my partner had a very delicious meal here - portion sizes were perfect. We had the mahi mahi tacos and beef tacos, and nachos. 10/10. Nice drinks too. Jonathan was a great waiter! Attentive and kind. We will definitely be back :)

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Abc Abc
review_text: Great flavors. Not the cleanest, but its at a beach in open air. The tacos are great, could develop a signature drink, non alcoholic options are limited. Opening for breakfast instead of 12noon, is also helpful-especially for their guest that check out at 11am.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Glenn Gatineau
review_text:
This spot captures a vibrant, authentic Mexican atmosphere complemented by exceptional customer service. The food was outstanding!!!

The beef burrito was fresh, flavorful, and the best I’ve ever had. 🌯

The brisket taco was perfectly cooked, and the sauce really enhanced the flavors.🌮

A must-stop spot if you’re at Hollywood Beach! 🏝️

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Leve Leverett
review_text: Loved the outdoor vibe, sunny and warm!! Come hungry! Serving sizes are super large! Food was hot and amazing! We ordered grilled chicken nachos and the mahi mahi tacos!!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Cesar Davila
review_text:
The food and service at taco beach shack was great, we had the churasco taco combo plate which comes with 3 tacos, grilled corn on the cob with Parmesan cheese, rice & black beans and a chicken salad with honey vinaigrette, monster-Rita and a shot of tequila.

Our server Yela was very attentive, friendly and patient as we switched tables 3 times for a better view of the live performer they had there, she’s a great singer and it enhanced the great atmosphere of this outdoor and festive restaurant.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Colin Scholl
review_text: Love the indoor outdoor vibe with the roof overhead. Even in a rain storm vibes were good with music and they got a nice tiki bar. Very colorful place with some of the best steak fajitas I’ve had anywhere. I came back and got the Tuesday taco deal and those were great also! Soft corn tortilla is the way to go. Zero complaints. Nancy was also friendly!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: MiKayla Delmont
review_text: This place was amazing!!! Kourtney and Chelsea really made our first time here something to remember! Would recommend this to anyone. Food is amazing

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Eric Batson
review_text:
Great tacos. Very big portions on both the tacos and chips and guac. Good prices. Wonderful service, Yela was on top of it all night.
10/10 would recommend. Especially the Carnitas.
Great live music on a Tuesday night as well.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Scout Goodey
review_text: Incredible atmosphere, the food was incredible, I definitely recommend the fajitas if you’re looking to fill up or share with another person. There’s plenty of shade and lots of fans if you’re looking to get out of the heat after the beach. Julio was my server and he was fantastic, so nice and enthusiastic, he made sure we had a great time and were taken care of the whole time.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Sarah Anne Duncan
review_text:
Hidden gem.
You need to look for this place, it's just off the boardwalk. What a gem.

Excellent tacos. Excellent, friendly, helpful, cheerful staff.

Lovely restrooms. Clean, fresh, well looked after

Exceptional.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Sabinus Brutus
review_text: We got each a taco combo with 3 good size tacos with rice, beans and Parmesan cheese corn 🌽. Since we stayed at the hotel neighboring the restaurant, we got a free margarita and 20% off between 5 and 6 pm.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Brittany Redding
review_text: This place is great. The decor is so bright, colorful, and fun! The taco platter was amazing. You can't mix and match but my group just all got a different taco platter so we could try a few. The brisket taco and the Korean short rib with kimchi taco were amazing. Our server, Majo, was amazing. So friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. Will definitely be back next time I in town.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Justin Phillips
review_text: Amazing atmosphere. The staff are delightful. Joe was awesome and recommended the GRILLED CHURRASCO STEAK. They are amazing and I recommend everyone try it. I will definitely bring my friends here in the future! Thank you Joe!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Selene
review_text:
Amazing food and vibes at Taco Beach Shack! The steak fajitas were juicy and full of flavor, and the mahi-mahi taco was fresh, flaky, and delicious. The beachy atmosphere and great music made the experience even better.

Huge shout-out to our server Henry, he was  super attentive, friendly, and made great recommendations. His service really stood out!

Absolutely recommend this spot can’t wait to come back!

author: MaKenzie Bissler
review_text: We found this place on Tik Tok because of the table made hummus. Christina was so kind and welcoming and helped us decide what to order. We got the sampler, the meat for 2, beet salad and baklava. We loved the sausage and the owner came over and talked to us too! Very family oriented and delicious food. My husband is a picky eater and he said that this place was probably the best food he’s had in a long time - I’d say that’s a win!

author: Dalit Rosenfeld
review_text: Taverna Opa in Hollywood is always such a FUN experience! The atmosphere is always alive especially if you come for dinner. Belly dancers, music, and napkins flying in the air! The food is delicious and very authentic Greek cuisine. The service is always good. I have been here many times with friends and for special occasions and it never disappoints. Perfect spot for great food, entertainment, and unforgettable memories right by the Hollywood boardwalk. Totally recommended!

author: Zlatka
review_text:
I was absolutely delighted with this place🔥 and the staff❤️Everything was incredibly delicious, the portions were generous, and the team was so warm and welcoming🥹😻🥰

I want to give a special thank you to the staff for their kindness and attention. My daughter was sleeping in her stroller, and there is a bell in the café that makes a loud siren-like sound. Some kids were pressing it, and my baby got really scared. The staff immediately apologized multiple times 🥹and by covering the button so children couldn’t press it anymore🙏❤️❤️👍

That meant so much to me❤️❤️❤️This level of care and thoughtfulness is truly priceless🙏It’s rare to meet such attentive, kind, and genuinely caring people. Thank you so much we felt really valued and will definitely come back🥰❤️

author: Darrin Tebbe
review_text: I just can't say enough.. we lived in Greece for a few years and just loved the food and Greek hospitality. Taverna Opa takes us back every time we visit. We usually work weekends so this is our first visit on a Saturday nite... WOW!! A wonderful dinner, amazing entertainment, and simply THE best service. George, we ♥️ you! Oh, and the food was simply amazing, just like we remember from our early 90's stay in Greece.. Sincerely, "The retsina guy" 😁

author: Don Massa
review_text: Went for lunch, not crowded, valet parking. The Grilled Octopus was fabulous! Grilled, nice char and seasoned to perfection! Greek salad was fresh cut and we'll seasoned. I added Gyro meat for 6 bucks, seasoned well but on the dry side. Taste was good. My wife wanted  a Gyro sandwich and was informed they only had platters. It was good but not what she wanted, plus the meat was on the dry side as well. Service was excellent and on ;b;;the water. Indoor,  OUTDOOR dinning, Watch the boast go by with a nice breeze. All and all a nice lunch

author: Jason Mont
review_text:
Last night, I had the pleasure of dining at this wonderful Mediterranean restaurant with a group of friends and family. We were looking for three things: exceptional Mediterranean cuisine, a fun dining experience, and a great atmosphere – and this place exceeded our expectations on every level.

From the moment we walked in, the ambiance struck the perfect balance between lively and intimate. The warm lighting and thoughtfully designed space created an inviting environment that was perfect for our group gathering. The energy was vibrant without being overwhelming, making it easy to enjoy great conversation throughout the evening

The menu impressed us from start to finish. Every single dish we ordered was expertly prepared and bursting with authentic Mediterranean flavors. The appetizers set a high bar – each one showcased fresh ingredients and bold seasoning that immediately transported us to the Mediterranean coast.

The standout of the evening was undoubtedly the bronzino. Cooked to absolute perfection, the fish was flaky and tender with a beautiful crispy skin, seasoned with herbs that complemented rather than masked the delicate flavor of the fish. It's clear the kitchen knows how to handle seafood with the respect it deserves.

Our main dishes were equally impressive, with generous portions and presentation that showed real care and attention to detail. The flavors were complex and well-balanced, showcasing the best of Mediterranean cooking traditions.
The service throughout the evening was attentive without being intrusive, and our server was knowledgeable about the menu and happy to make recommendations.

This restaurant has definitely earned a spot on our regular rotation. I'm already planning my next visit and looking forward to exploring more of their menu. If you're seeking an authentic Mediterranean dining experience with great food, wonderful atmosphere, and a fun night out, this place should be at the top of your list. Highly recommended!

author: Cocuti Roxana
review_text: I had a really good experience!! Amazing good food and great service! Dennis was our server and he did an outstanding job. Definitely coming back! Great greek atmosphere and music as well!!

author: Ken Durbin
review_text:
🌟 A Mesmerizing Evening at Taverna Opa, Hollywood Beach 🌟

From the moment we arrived at Taverna Opa, we knew we were in for something special. Nestled along the Intracoastal Waterway, the restaurant offered a stunning waterfront setting that felt both vibrant and serene. We were seated outdoors, right by the river, where the gentle breeze and rhythmic lapping of the water set the tone for a perfect afternoon.

Our server was exceptional — warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about the menu. He guided us through the evening with grace, offering thoughtful suggestions and ensuring every detail was just right. His timing was impeccable, and his energy matched the lively yet relaxed vibe of the restaurant.

As we sipped our drinks and watched the boats drift by, nature added its own surprise: a manatee surfaced just feet from our table, rising slowly to take a breath. It was a quiet, awe-inspiring moment that made the night unforgettable — a gentle reminder of Florida’s wild beauty, right in the heart of Hollywood Beach.

The food was equally impressive. I had the Chilean sea bass, perfectly seared and served over a rich bed of sautéed spinach, accompanied by golden roasted potatoes that were crisp on the outside and buttery within. My wife chose the Lavraki Branzino, topped with a bright, citrusy ladlemono sauce that elevated the delicate flavors of the fish. Each bite was a celebration of Mediterranean finesse and fresh, coastal ingredients.

Taverna Opa isn’t just a restaurant — it’s an experience. Between the impeccable service, the enchanting riverside setting, and the surprise visit from a curious manatee, our evening was nothing short of magical. We’ll be back, and next time, we’ll bring friends to share in the them.

author: Leonard Behaj
review_text:
Gent, listen:

We stoped at this restaurant by accident just because we liked the view, but this restaurant is one of the best restaurants I ever visited in my life.(45 today is my birthday)
The food was wow, fresh, delicious and very tasty.
Service was the best part of it, Alex our server was amazing, he explained everything about the dishes about spices, cocking temperatures and everything else.
I don’t usually write reviews but when I do they generate a thousands of views.
