This restaurant is the best in Miami, you don’t need to travel to Greece, save the tickets and come and enjoy a great traditional Greek meal in this location you will thank me.
Ask for Alex he is the best ever team member at this restaurant.

author: Zachary Dobran
review_text: Amazing long standing greek established that takes huge pride in the service and food. Drinks were excellent, bartender provided exceptional service and the food was on point. We had the chilean seabass and Athenian shrimp both dishes were full of flavor and fresh. Gorgeous view of the water and a little show to help dinner go down smooth

author: karine belhumeur
review_text: Tavern OPA was just as delicious as I remembered from a few years ago! The food was fresh, flavorful, and so satisfying. I’ll definitely be back again.

author: Chris Kasel
review_text: We had an 80th birthday party for my aunt here. The entire staff was so accommodating, very helpful, and took pride in their work. The food was absolutely incredible. We will be coming back and recommending this place to others.

author: Natulya S.
review_text: It was an excellent choice. We arrived without a reservation but were seated on the patio. The food arrived promptly despite the restaurant being full. The food was delicious. The Greek salad is excellent and made by Greek standards: big chunks of feta and vegetables with a very tasty dressing. We got lamb kebab which was slightly burnt but still good and stuffed peppers-excellent. We also took a plate of fried smelts. In Greece it is called small fish. It was excellent as well. The portions are big, we could not finish them and they packed the leftovers for us. I would highly recommend this place.

author: M. Alvarado
review_text: We hosted my aunt’s birthday party here and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The food was delicious, the service warm and attentive, and the atmosphere perfect for celebrating. Thank you to the team for helping make her day truly unforgettable!

author: Natalia Morgunova
review_text:
I think this place needs to be visited by the department of sanitation. Barefoot belly dancers climb up on the tables (and encourage guests to do so too) and then food is served on these tables without so much as a wipe down. That’s just disgusting.

The food was very good, however the atmosphere not so much. Seems like this place has an identity crisis and doesn’t know if it’s a restaurant or a club.
Even at 6pm the music was so loud that you could not hear the waiter, nevermind trying to have a conversation with people you are dining with. Also everything is extremely cramped, so you barely have any room and you are constantly being bumped against by people trying to pass.

author: Alvaro Plazas
review_text:
What a fantastic experience at Opa Taverna! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and inviting, lively but still comfortable enough to relax and enjoy a meal. The place is spotless and clearly well cared for, which made a great first impression.

The chicken skewers were absolutely delicious, juicy, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to perfection. You can tell they use quality ingredients. I also tried the shakshuka, and it was bursting with flavor, rich, hearty, and beautifully presented. Every bite had that authentic Greek touch that makes you want to come back again and again.

Parking was surprisingly easy, which is always a big plus in my book ($5 for valet). Overall, everything from the food to the service to the ambiance was excellent. Definitely a spot worth visiting and revisiting!

author: Lashandra Dorado
review_text:
Beautiful dinner at Taverna Opa

I had such a wonderful evening at Taverna Opa in Hollywood. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, perfectly seasoned, and full of authentic Mediterranean flavor. The grilled octopus was tender and flavorful, the tzatziki bright and refreshing, and the lamb was cooked to perfection and the atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, with that subtle coastal charm that makes you want to stay a little longer. The staff was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was just right. Even without loud music or dancing, it still felt warm and full of life — just the right balance between lively and peaceful.It’s one of those places where the flavors, service, and setting come together beautifully. I’d definitely come back again — next time maybe on a weekend to experience the more festive side too.

author: Ryan Falconer
review_text:
The food was overall great. We had appetizers, drinks & mains. The ribeye was excellent. The appetizer sampler was delicious. Drinks were all very well made & tasty. I would not order the lemon potatoes as a side again.

3 stars for service because of how the rain was handled. We wanted to sit outside for the ambiance, but it rained. The servers/employees worked diligently to get the water screens down for every table except ours- even after we asked them to, it took a while. Wet rib eye was not as enjoyable as when it was dry.

We'll still go back & hope for better service next time.

author: Maiara Pizzetti
review_text: This place is amazing is my 4th time here every time I'm in FL I stop by Great food, live dancers, great music very entertaining for all ages. Me and my family had a blast.

author: Xiomara Osrod
review_text: Since the moment you arrive at the valet, you feel so welcomed! The food is always SOOO good! The Opa Eggplant is amazing! And the lamb stew is my favorite. Ozkan, the server is a very professional waiter who takes care of every detail of your dinning experience. And I love all the dancers they are  all beautiful, sweet girls 💝🙌

author: Hagz
review_text: I love Le Tub. It's a hidden gem! We come here every year when we visit Hollywood beach. The decor is made from a collection of old crab traps, driftwood, toilets (yes toilets) and other treasures found on the beach over the years super unique. There known for their amazing cheeseburgers very basic but huge and has that homemade backyard grill vibe I love it! Be careful how you order your cheeseburger if you say medium rare..it's going to be rare like blue...if you say medium it's going to be medium rare kind of confusing but that's how they get down at le tub lol...there greek salad is massive definitely feeds two maybe three...Good prices for the amount of food and quick service. Also awesome drinks! Amazing view of the inter coastal. You can see all the boats coming through and sometimes see fish jumping in and out of the water pretty awesome. 100% recommend!!

author: Jack Carello
review_text: I love Le Tub!  The staff were friendly!  The food was delicious!  Very beautiful and detailed nautical and costal scenery in the interior!  Plus you get a great view of the harbor!  Without doubt worth going to!  Have a great day!❤️🌊⚓️🔱⛵️😃🛟

author: Paul Ginnane
review_text: Old school “Roadhouse” feel place (without the fights!) that has great music, views and atmosphere! Great bar staff that will keep your drinks topped off and tons of stuff on the walls to keep your eyes wondering. Watched an awesome sunset from the deck seating area and enjoyed their classic burger and fries. Menu had some seafood that looked good too. Well worth the visit if in the area, I’ll be returning next time I’m in town.

author: Busi Ngwenya - Alexander
review_text: Le Tub was Le OK. Having to pay $3 to selfpark in their limited parking lot, is rarher silly. I am already about to go in and spend $17 on a burgerwith no fries? We ordered le burger and le lobster BLT, the egg nog and margaritas. The BLT came on a multi grain bread surprisingly. Such a delicate meat was overpowered by the bread choice I feel. Burger was ok, very tasty and juicy. Atmosphere was lovely,  great views from the dock. Waitress was great. Nice to check it off the list, but most likely not worth a second visit.

author: Jennifer Elenbaas
review_text: This place was recommended by a friend for the shrimp. We went just before the dinner crowd got there. Parking is free if you are dining and leave within 2 hours. It’s a crowded area but in a cute way with lots of memorabilia. The sunset is beautiful for dinner time. The shrimp need to be peeled but the sauce is great with them. The smoked fish dip is also recommended and the vegetables with it were perfect. I had the fresh squeezed margarita, being a margarita lover this one was good but nothing new or special and served in a plastic cup. Overall I am glad we stopped in for a bite, if we were hungrier we would have tried that burger! Ps- don’t forget to get a photo at the front by the tub!

author: Tony Rosca
review_text:
Le Tub Saloon – Hollywood, FL
This place screams old-school Florida! Rustic, funky, and right on the water. The burgers are huge — juicy, perfectly grilled, and totally live up to the hype. Don’t come here if you’re in a rush though; service can be slow, but that’s part of the vibe. Grab a cold beer, chill by the Intracoastal, and enjoy the view. It’s got that laid-back beach shack energy that’s hard to find anymore.

Must-try: The famous sirloin burger 🍔
Vibe: Quirky, chill, and unapologetically Florida 🌴

author: KB
review_text: Very cool spot on the water with a unique ocean vibe and tons of decorative pieces to show it (including tubs and toilets). The burger is large at 13 oz and was delicious, cooked perfectly.

author: Emre Acar
review_text: The place was very unique and beautiful; however, our burgers were a bit dry. The staff member who took care of us was very kind and attentive. We had a lovely time with our children. We would recommend it as a cozy spot by the water.

author: Yuley Gonzalez
review_text:
Went during the week to treat myself to enjoy a beautiful view and dinner. Le Tub did not dissapoint. I was seated immediately even though I know the wait list is usually 30 minutes+ Cristina & Brianna quickly came over to say hello and help me decide on drinks  & eats. Friendly & amazing service. They aim to please and make this a place you'd want to be a regular in.
Must try the Steamed Shrimp & Le Burger. Cant wait to go back.

author: Anissa Be
review_text:
A truly American bar experience!
The place is very unique and beautifully designed, with an absolutely stunning sunset view. The burgers and ribs were delicious full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The only downside was the service: our waitress barely checked on us, which was disappointing. However, the rest of the staff seemed great and attentive. Overall, a memorable spot worth visiting for the atmosphere and food.

author: Kelly Bradbury
review_text:
Perfect views, breezy, tropical; you can’t get anymore South Florida fun than Le Tub!

Situated on the water of the intracoastal in beautiful Hollywood, Le Tub offers delicious appetizers and main dishes. Our family enjoyed the Caesar salad, Mahi sandwich, and every bite of Le Tub’s renowned hamburger.

Our server, Jay, was friendly and professional. Our drinks were always refreshed when needed and our meals beautifully served.

I highly recommend Le Tub for its delicious, fresh menu choices, excellent service, and delightful location.

Pro tip: if needed, there is plenty of metered parking across the street (and a short walk) from the restaurant.

author: Israel Ortet
review_text: First time here. We came for the burger and it didn’t disappoint. It is big and delicious. The place has a unique feeling. Definitely coming back.

author: Maximilian
review_text:
Le Tub gives funky Florida dive bar energy with huge burgers, rustic wood, a waterfront breeze…This place isn’t trying to be fine dining, it’s all about the character, the chaos, and that very specific “old Florida” charm. We ordered mahi mahi sandwich, a chicken club, burger, fries, etc. Portions are generous. Tastes solid. Is it going to blow your foodie mind? Nah. But does it hit the spot with a cold drink in hand while you’re sitting by the water? Absolutely.

Service is on point, our server was chill, friendly, and way more attentive than I expected for a spot that feels like you should be barefoot.😅 Come here for the experience, not just the food. If you like quirky, tropical dives with character, this place is 100% a vibe.

author: Gege Miami
review_text:
We ordered a burger cooked medium rare, but the experience was extremely disappointing. First, they brought us a patty that was completely burnt and dry — clearly overcooked. After we complained, they brought a replacement, but this time the burger was completely raw inside — cold, red, and visibly uncooked. We refused to pay for it, but the staff insisted that this was their standard for medium rare. That is simply not true.

People at the next table agreed with us — they were also surprised that the restaurant considered this to be medium rare. Only thanks to a gentleman at the neighboring table who supported us and spoke up, the restaurant finally agreed to remove the burger from our bill. We were very disappointed with both the food and the staff’s attitude. We won’t be coming back.

author: Vanessa L.
review_text: What a lovely and unique dinning experience, I love the waterfront view, delicious food, great service and unique decor! We always come here when we are in Hollywood because its such a fun spot for dinner and drinks. Cant wait to be back again! Also management went above and beyond to a fix a little issue we had. I thoroughly appreciated that.

author: CHRIS PERRY
review_text: Great spot for a classic South Florida experience! The burger lives up to the hype — juicy, flame-grilled, and packed with flavor. The quirky, laid-back vibe with waterfront views makes it a perfect casual hangout. Service is friendly, and the atmosphere is pure local charm. Don’t expect fancy — just great food and a cool spot to kick back.

author: Jessica S
review_text: Overall our experience here was good, we only had s short wait to be seated unlike other reviews, and we were seated along the water. Double bonus! This place is super quirky and cute, the vibe is definitely beach shack, and the menu as well as how the food is served (paper plates etc) reflects that. Don't come here expecting a ton of food options, of fancy by any means, and if you have anyone picky in your group be sure to make sure theres something they will eat ahead of time. We did the BLT lobster sandwich and fries for $27 and the letub burger, our friends got the chicken sandwich and a salad. Overall the food was good. I would not say the burger is the best burger but it definitely was not bad. The lobster BLT was tasty, and it was the only entree that came with fries without the extra $6 charge. We would absolutely come back, and the vibe and location were lovely.

author: MAX POLOZANI
review_text:
Best burger 🍔 joint around!!
Great burgers & fries, awesome water views
Highly recommend going for lunch or sunset

author: Kristin Weaver
review_text: Le Tub is a cool place to eat. Great water views. We had the Mahi sandwich, burger, fries and key lime pie for dessert. The food and drinks were awesome. Great,friendly service.  Will definitely return!

author: Jim Schaefer
review_text: First time here, the menu is limited, the kids had the chicken BLT, which is huge and looks delicious and  I just had the best oysters I’ve had in a long time. Brooke, our server was excellent and everyone here is very friendly. I would definitely come back to this place.

author: Brian Bush
review_text: Beautiful view.  Food was good. Good menu. Bartenders/servers were great. Very small inside.  There is outdoor seating as well.

author: Protective Dad Pranks
review_text: BEST CUBAN PANINI I’ve ever had! If you love Cuban sandwiches, you have to try the Cuban Panini here. The pork is slow-roasted overnight. And the flavors that comes from this sandwich is AMAZING! I love everything about this place from the decor to the location of the restaurant. With a phenomenal beach view and a laid-back setting. You can’t go wrong eating at Oceans 13. On the day of this review, I had a eight hour layover in Fort Lauderdale. So I rented a car and came here because of the Google reviews. Let me tell you this place does not disappoint. Phenomenal FOOD, LOCATION and STELLAR SERVICE! Easy 5-Star Review!

author: Edmond McClure
review_text: Great place right on the beach!!!  The food and service were amazing.  It was a perfect spot for our last night in FL before heading home.

author: Robert W. Rescue Beats AED
review_text: Vinny and Lisa and just as important the staff that works with them average best on the beach. Drinks, food, and service are way above others.

author: Ames Gonzalez
review_text: I cannot even begin to tell you how amazing this place is. First off the food is awesome! Perfect food after a day on the beach or after fishing etc. exactly the vibe! And the drinks are SOLID too! I had called last minute for a party of around 25 people for Saturday during their busy lunch hour. It was supposed to be a small lunch for my 9 year old son’s birthday. We originally had a different restaurant in mind but found out later on that several family members wanted to join us and the party got too large for the previous location. He was going deep sea fishing nearby with his friends earlier in the day and we needed a chill beach vibe that could accommodate a large party, this was perfect. They were so accommodating for my entire party! And even when his fishing trip was cut short because of bad weather and many guests had become sea sick, I called frantic and worried they wouldn't be able to accommodate us earlier than scheduled and they were already set up and prepared and told us to come on by whenever we were ready! We all showed up at different times because some family were coming from far away. All of the staff we met were very attentive, kind, calm, and everything was so smooth and took away all of my stress (as a mom, when your sons birthday gets ruined by weather/sea sickness and the restaurant staff are so welcoming and reassuring it helps SO much!) we all had a great time! We were able to bring a cake for him and then the staff EVEN did their own special birthday surprise for him! It was just SO sweet and special! I am really truly thankful to Oceans 13 for how well they handled everything, all the food they had to prepare… so many people in the same party ordering at different times. And they even gave the adults an extra Birthday “happy hour” form the bar to lighten the mood! Everyone was so impressed with this place. Just the absolute best! I don’t live super close but I will ABSOLUTELY travel to come back here and support them! So so thankful!  Thank you guys so much for everything! You single handedly SAVED my sons birthday!

author: parisa ighani
review_text: We had their peel and ear shrimp, crab dip and chips, chipotle bowl, quesadillas, chicken tender, andddd steak Philly sandwich. Everything tasted great. We had an amazing View and the best server. Christie was amazing, sweet and attentive.

author: Dana McEvers
review_text: The food was bland, I hate it when cooks do not cook with salt. That tells me they know nothing about salt enhancing all the flavors together. Other than that...Mark was an awesome server and th view was perfect!

author: Breanna
review_text: Great place to eat on the boardwalk. Beautiful view of the ocean and tasty food! Our waiter was kind, quick, and attentive. Loved my Ocean Cobb salad!!! My only gripe is that I wish the drink menu had prices.

author: Jennelle Johnson
review_text: If you are looking for a beautiful, vibrant, ocean front establishment then you have found it! Oceans 13, where you can regularly find the owner Vinny. He is kind, fun and full of life just like the property that he owns!!  The charismatic ocean blue interior reminds you that you are on the beach as you enjoy every sip of your cocktail with the amazing staff!!!  Don't skip this little gem and their yummy menu while visiting the fun Hollywood Boardwalk!!

author: Jessica Coleman
review_text: Overall we were very disappointed with our experience.  Our waiter seemed rushed and impatient. He rushed us when ordering and seemed annoyed when we needed something. The food was less than appetizing.  The Cuban is apparently premade. My step dad asked to not have the relish on it and was told it’s premade and cannot be changed. It also didn’t taste good. The fries had no seasoning, the mashed potatoes seemed like instant potatoes, the snapper was ok but lacking flavor, and the crab dip was way overpriced for what it was. Overall I wouldn’t recommend dining here. We spent over $100 for 3 adults and 2 kids and McDonald’s would have been much better and less expensive.

author: Christine Eastvold
review_text: Absolutely amazing staff!  Fabulous food!  Don’t miss out on this hidden gem!  I will be back soon!  Thank you for an amazing afternoon!

author: Sarah L
review_text: We stopped in for dinner the night before we flew home and it was so worth it. We got the crab dip, lobster and shrimp empanadas and the Cash Cay fried seafood platter (all 3 are appetizers) and it was so much food. But worth it because it was *delicious* (the empanadas were my favourite). We had great service while sitting outside and watching the boardwalk/ocean. Highly recommend this stop if you’re in Hollywood Beach!

author: Brittany I (Mitts13)
review_text: I ate here with my friend 2 days in a row. The first day we had breakfast which was amazing and then the second day we had lunch since they opened later on weekdays. Both times were fabulous with great service! Drinks were amazing! We ate the bacon egg and cheese sandwich, grits, eggs Benedict, turkey club, and blackened mahi tacos. Great atmosphere, good music, great service! Awesome view of the boardwalk too!

author: Verouska Ferrario
review_text: Great location and lovely customer service. Food was a bit of a mixed bag. The tuna nachos were excellent. The fried seafood platter was a good size but fries were soggy and fritters overdone. Key lime pie was ok (but I'd get rid of that artificial radioactive looking syrup). Overall a nice experience anyway, prices are good for the area.

author: Tiffany Roldan-Howell
review_text: My friend and I came to do a sunrise meditation for her bday and after stopped by here for breakfast. The views are amazing for sure, but what really stands out is the service. It was 8:30 am and both the servers were so nice and welcoming. The food and drinks were really good and the executive chef Vinny even came out to say hello and happy birthday to my friend. You can tell this place is has a family dynamic and that’s a lost art now and days in the restaurant industry. Would recommend this to anyone & Will definitely be coming back!

author: Sarah Slatniske
review_text: If you’re like us and not from the area and this place comes up nearby… GO EAT HERE!! 100/10 experience. Menu was amazing!! Decently priced. Great staff and wonderful owner. Family friendly!! Perfect privately owned place at the beach and the food was amazing.

author: Jacob Hill
review_text: Our visit to Oceans 13 on the beach in Hollywood was nothing short of fantastic! From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality. The Ahi Tuna Nachos were a delightful start to our meal, absolutely mouthwatering. My son was thrilled with his chicken tenders, and the complementary fries were a thoughtful touch from the manager. The service was fantastic & the bartender went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time. The ambiance was perfect for a relaxing evening, with stunning views of the beach. Plus, my son couldn't stop talking about the extra cherries in his Shirley Temple! We're already looking forward to our next visit. Highly recommend Oceans 13 for a memorable dining experience by the sea!

author: Scott Richardson
review_text: Great sandwiches and wraps. Appetizer sampler was very mid. Want to watch football games on a Saturday because they have lots of screens and games on which is great, but no TVs were turned up and all you heard was worn out music. It was ok,  but there are too many other places to spend our time than going back here.

author: Lori Villani
review_text: Nice and clean! Katie was AMAZING! Fun, spunky, beautiful inside and out. Go to Oceans 13 on Hollywood boardwalk for sure. Great atmosphere, great food & drinks and the servers are excellent!

author: Joanna Osborne
review_text: Sooooooooooo after COVID, they started opening later on Sundays, but we're early birds, so we started going to another restaurant on the beach. Today while walking to the other place, we realized they were back open early on Sundays, and we got extremely excited. So we are back eating at our Oceans 13 spot. Today, I had the lobster frittata, and it was delicious. I also had a mimosa, which was Amazing!! So glad they are back open early!!! The best on the Beach!!

author: Natalia Ciobanu
review_text:
TIKI TIKI – Hollywood, FL

We had a lovely dining experience at TIKI TIKI, a waterfront restaurant with a relaxed, tropical atmosphere. The décor is casual and inviting, and the setting by the water really adds to the charm. One of the highlights is that boats can dock directly next to the restaurant deck, which gives the place a unique marina vibe and makes it especially enjoyable.

The food was mostly excellent. We had fresh raw oysters, a very flavorful seafood chowder, and the pasta with lobster was delicious, rich, and well prepared. The cocktails were also very good — refreshing and nicely balanced.

The only downside was the stone crab, which unfortunately was a bit overcooked and didn’t quite meet expectations (as in my food experience in Keys 😉 )compared to the rest of the meal.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience with quality ingredients, a beautiful waterfront setting, and a great atmosphere. With a bit more attention to cooking the seafood, this place could be outstanding.☺️

author: Bello Solano
review_text:
We had a great experience at Tiki Tiki. We were able to pull up in our boat, and staff immediately came over to help us tie up at the dock, which was a huge plus. Service was excellent—everyone was attentive, friendly, and quick.

Our drinks came out fast, and the food followed not long after. The chicken wings had great flavor without being overly salty, which can sometimes happen with Asian-inspired sauces. The kids’ chicken tenders were a generous portion and surprisingly flavorful. The grouper tacos could’ve used a touch more salt, but that was easily fixed at the table. The coconut shrimp were delicious—perfectly cooked with a dipping sauce that paired really well.

Overall, a great spot with solid service and tasty food. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Adam Zdeb
review_text: We love this place for the reason we were able to bring our dog 🐶 with us to eat. Verry solid food with great views on the water. The Best item we had was the Key lime pie in a jar, it was a great spin on the classic and we enjoyed it a lot. For the food it was all solid but nothing was mind-blowing.  The tiki tiki chicken was  juicy but the rice under needed a bit more flavor. Fish tacos were well cooked had good flavor. The fish and chips had great flavor in the batter bit just too much batter.  And my fish sandwich was blackened but it was missing that blackened spice.  We really liked the tuna nachos because the flavors were on point and the chips  super light and crunchy.

author: hungryhappyhippo
review_text:
Great location, good food and immaculate vibes. FYI there’s valet parking only $5 but worth it in my opinion. The valet was super nice, I forgot my phone in the car and he brought it in to the waitress. I sat outside right by the water for a beautiful sunset dinner and boat watching. The vibes are chic coastal. I had Lobster Rigatoni and a mocktail. And the serving size was great and good amount of lobster meat in there.

Be mindful that once it started to get dark I could feel like bugs biting me since I was by the water. Other than that the bathrooms were clean and decorated with fun vintage photos.

Love this place, would come again.

author: Jilla Marie
review_text: Great service and a great Friday bar experience overall. Got the for the start of HH when the bar was 95% vacant. Had a very reasonably priced seafood/shellfish platter and a couple of tasty drinks. Would visit again because the location and vibe is great!

author: IDProductionsIT LLC
review_text:
The atmosphere 👌 is top tier

Food is very decent and priced well, mostly under $40 averaging around $20-$30 a plate.

Salmon was very well cooked, but the rice 🍚 pared with it was bland

Shrimp pasta was nice but a little too heavy on the sauce, if they would have lightened up the sauce a bit, it would have been much better

The key lime was a 6 out of 10, I bit sour and I never had it in a cup 🥤 not a brilliant move

The chocolate cake was a tad rich for me, but my party liked it.

Andrew was a great server

author: J.W. Werner
review_text:
Even though this place was busy I was still able to get a table for one fairly quickly.  It is beautifully decorated with the South Florida vibe.  You may have to wait a little extra, but you might consider asking for a waterside table. Just be prepared that you may be in the sun. But it’s worth it.

This sweet tea is pretty good and I ordered the Smoked Fish Dip, Key West Pasta, a side of coleslaw, and the Sticky Toffee Cake for dessert.

The smoked fish dip was good. I do think it had a little too much jalapeño that was overpowering the smoked fish. Maybe less jalapeño and add a hint of lemon or lime. I squeezed some lime for my tea and it was great. The coleslaw had a really good flavor and texture, but a little dry. I like my slaw a little wetter.
The Key West Pasta was fabulous!  The linguine was perfectly cooked and so were the shrimp. The sauce was extremely flavorful, almost like an Italian tomato-vodka sauce. The crispy, crunchy toasted bread was a perfect match.
The Sticky Toffee Cake was really buttery rich and flavorful but mine was a tad on the dry side.  Still a great finish to the meal.

The waterside tables and atmosphere was inviting and super relaxing. At least 6-7 boats honked their horns as their passengers waved at the dock side guests.  One boat even docked at the restaurant and those aboard came into the restaurant to dine.
The staff was very friendly and attentive too.

author: Angeli Paray
review_text: Excellent brunch! We had bottomless mimosas and our server truly made sure my glass was never empty. Great location on the inlet so yes there are seats directly next to the water. Lots of umbrellas for shade and more than enough space for large parties. Our server was running around on double time taking care of all of the tables. The food, was excellent.  We had the banana bread which came out hot and fresh.  The coconut shrimp had this great mango salsa that gave it a fresh acidic flavor. Steak tacos were flavorful and cooked correctly so it was tender and soft.  The lobster roll had full on clumps of lobster meat which you can clearly see is fresh and not from a can.  The chicken wings were also very well seasoned and nice and crispy. Overall we had an amazing experience and the food did not disappoint. There is only valet parking for $5 unless you want to park across the street and walk.

author: Dolly
review_text: To start off, our waitress Karla was amazing! This was our first time here and I came with my fur baby. We were in the area and decided to give this place a shot. As New Yorkers, we were beyond impressed! The food was amazing! The seafood was fresh, that’s all that matters. To top it off, the peach cobbler was to die for. I’m just thinking about it and drooling. I would definitely go back, your $$ will be well spent. Take my word for it! Ooo the valet personnel was very nice and friendly.  She was on a roll!

author: Michelle Medrek
review_text:
Tiki Tiki has quickly become one of our favorite spots, especially for their outstanding ceviche! It's absolutely delicious, bursting with flavor, and the fish is incredibly fresh--definitely a must-try! I typically indulge in their amazing churrasco steak, but I find that the ceviche leaves me feeling satisfied every time.

My partner usually opts for a fish dish, but he decided to switch it up with the fish and chips this time, and we were thrilled! The fish was lightly battered, cooked to perfection, and the flavor and texture were simply excellent.

The staff is wonderful, and the bartenders are always welcoming. Plus, the view of the intercoastal and watching the boats pass by adds to the charm. It's the perfect spot for a romantic date or a fun outing with the whole family.

After every meal, we always ask ourselves, "Would we come back?" The answer is a resounding yes! We'll definitely be returning!

author: Jeff Bell
review_text: Amazing spot for great service and fantastic food. We had the watermelon margarita, seafood platter, tuna poke, and the spicy salmon crunchy rice. Our server, Mila, was very attentive and helpful. It was all incredible and well returning!

author: Briana Villanueva
review_text: Food was great, server was kind, and the chocolate cake was to die for. The parking situation was rough, very small lot and they charge $5 for valet, which isn’t a big deal but they don’t actually give you an option to park your own car?

author: PATHY MURDOCK
review_text: I loved the location of this restaurant with its beautiful ocean view, the music was incredible, the service was good, the sea bass was delicious, and the cocktails were amazing. I recommend it 100% The Sunset was Phenomenal!!❤️

author: Tasheena S
review_text: I hidden gem! I came here for a solo brunch date on a Saturday. The service and views were perfect. This is the perfect hidden gem. Restaurants by the water is always so beautiful. The food was delicious! I decided to have the red snapper and eggs. It was so good. I can't wait to visit again to try something else off the menu.

author: Amanda E.
review_text: Awesome experience. Such a perfect, open air, al-fresco ambiance. The food has been outstanding each time, this is my third visit. I plan to continue going. It’s right on the water so I’d say they need to just improve the conditions of the outdoor seating from the mosquito overtaking. Aside from that, kind and attentive servants and bomb music. Chill vibes.

author: Jon Nakamura
review_text: Tiki Tiki in Hollywood, Florida is a laid-back waterfront escape with a breezy island vibe. The open-air patio overlooks the Intracoastal, making it perfect for sunset cocktails. Their menu features fresh seafood, casual bites, and tropical drinks made with care. With live music, friendly service, and a chill, coastal charm, it’s a great spot to unwind and soak in sunny South Florida.

author: Melissa Lapin
review_text: Absolutely fantastic place. Doc-side dining for the win. The whole experience was fabulous. The menu selection was good. Our food was delicious and our waiter Hector was a dream!!

author: Julia Oliveira
review_text: This place is so pretty, especially at night. The hosts give you a table immediately and the servers are always available. The food is really good as well. I've been there 3 times already and i loved it every time.

author: carolina Bolanos
review_text: Every time I go to the beach, I have to come eat at this delicious Tiki Tiki restaurant, as I love all the food!!! It feels super fresh, the atmosphere and the service are spectacular, in addition to the beautiful view, if you are near Hollywood or Davie you cannot miss this spectacular restaurant, my husband loves the oysters and I of course the shrimp! Dishes that I highly recommend in addition to their wonderful cocktails, I also have to highlight the espresso Martini, you have to try it.

author: Celeste Kerina
review_text: LOVED EVERYTHING! The gracious services, attention from management and the attention to detail for our food allergies.  The food was DELICIOUS. This will be our new go to spot!

author: N J
review_text: Awesome location right along the beach. Service was great and they were all nice. I ordered the mariner platter and it was delicious. Breading was falling off of the fish but it was still good. Nice happy hour specials as well. If you are allergic to bees might want to make sure you have your epi as they are all over.

author: Mark VanPatton
review_text:
Had time to kill waiting on our flight. Party of 3 with luggage and the waitress was nice and told us we could have our bags by us. And we could hang out for a few hours no problem!
Very good food and great service!
Liked the location and the atmosphere.
Ubered over and quick seating outside.
Honestly didn't look around.
2 burgers and the fish tacos.
Chips and salsa.
Overall experience very good!
Highly Recommended-MVP

author: Carolina Diaz
review_text:
The food itself wasn’t anything extraordinary for my taste. I found it a bit bland and lacking in seasoning, so it didn’t really stand out compared to other places.

What truly made the visit worthwhile was the service. Samaira was absolutely exceptional, attentive, warm, and genuinely caring throughout the entire experience. She went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable, and her professionalism and kindness left a lasting impression. Without her, the experience would have felt very average, but thanks to her, we felt truly valued as guests.

On the other hand, the drinks were quite disappointing. We tried the piña colada, but it tasted more like sugar water than a proper cocktail. We even had to ask to change it for something else, which is surprising given the $13 price tag. For that cost, you’d expect a much higher standard.

The location itself is a strong point, spacious, right by the beach, and with beautiful views. With better consistency in the food and drinks, this place could match the level of service provided by Samaira.

author: Mariah Matt
review_text:
Lucky Fish @luckyfishbeachbar
📍Dania Beach, FL
Follow @eatzwithsweetz on ig and fb for more!
Such a great spot only steps away from the beach! Here's what I had:

Kiwi Melon Daiquiri
Mermaid Water
Rum Punch
@ketelone Espresso Martini
Tuna Poke Nachos
Crispy Calamari
Island Chopped Salad with shrimp
Florida Fish Sandwich
Fried Oreos
Key Lime Pie

Everything was great! Cant wait to visit again!
When are you pulllin up to Lucky Fish?

#LuckyFish #DaniaBeach #BeachBar #Seafood #Fresh #OceanBreeze #Poke #MermaidWater #KetelOne #BeachFood #Oceanfront #Vibes #LetsDrinkz #EatzWithSweetz #LetsEatz

author: Ronette Yarbrough
review_text:
We love going to Lucky Fish Bar & Grill in Dania Beach. It’s our go to place when we want to have a relaxing lunch or dinner. The food is great! No matter what we have it comes out perfect.
My favorite is the shrimp tacos. I get them fried. So yummy.  I think I have tried most of the seafood on the menu and everything is great.
My husband’s favorite are the chicken tenders and chicken Mediterranean wrap.
Our favorite server is Zoe!! She is the best. So friendly, sweet, helpful. We always ask for her.
The managers are awesome too. Kevin and Shane always stop by to see how we are doing.
Lucky Fish is a great addition to Dania Beach!!

author: John Sutton
review_text:
Let me start with the service, if there was a way to give them 4.9 Stars that's what I would give them. They were a little slow with service in the beginning. Because I think it was shift turnover. Otherwise the little gal that helped us was fantastic.

I had two Lucky's Rum Punch, and they were pretty good. Had we more time, I'd have probably ordered a third or more. My wife ordered a watermelon Mojito and it was very good. Didn't detect very much watermelon but that is such a delicate flavor, the drink was still very good.

I had the Traditional Fishing Village salad, which is a Greek salad and I added blackened Mahi Mahi. That fish was cooked perfectly, to my tastes, I know that your mileage may vary!  The dressing was mild and the red onions were a little hotter than I'd like, but my experience lately is that all red onions have been hotter, which means that either my tastes are changing, or the onion crop this year was different. I regret that I did not get a picture of this, we just come off of a cruise and I was not in the taking pictures of my food mode. My wife ordered the blackened mahi mahi version of the Hooked Up Tacos, she said they were excellent, it's fair to mention we had a pretty good amount of seafood on our cruise and no Mexican cuisine. So she may have been a little bit hungry for the tacos, but that fish was very good!

I like the atmosphere of this place, The View can't be beat and the Pagoda over the bar is massive and very cool. We sat at one of the covered high tops and that was additive to our lunch.

We shared a piece of key lime pie, and since we had just come off of that cruise we had more than a little bit of experience with nicer desserts. I know that not everyone has the same requirement from Key Lime pie, but for us, this was amazing! We had key lime pie on probably three different meals, and this easily surpassed all of them.

This place was a little pricey, but not expensive by any stretch. If I lived nearby, this place would be a regular stop.

author: Kiana Braun
review_text: Honestly the only thing that saves this place is the location. The French fries tasted like they had sat in a porta potty so I’m not sure if they just use way too strong of cleaner in the kitchen or if they were using a cleaner while cooking the food but I couldn’t eat them. The smash burger also had no flavor, it is a seafood place so hopefully the seafood is better. My other issue with this place was the outfits the waitresses and hostess were wearing, they were terrible and not flattering at all. This place would be great if the food was 10x better and they allowed these ladies to wear proper clothing that actually fit them because the views and the vibes were great!

author: Alisa M.
review_text: Lucky Fish in Dania has everything going for it—amazing views, great food, and drinks that hit the spot. It’s the kind of place you want to spend hours at, just soaking it all in. The only downside was the service; our server kept asking if we needed a box every 15 minutes, even though we clearly weren’t done and had plans for two more rounds of beer. We hadn’t even finished our drinks when the check arrived. It’s such a great place to enjoy yourself—if they let you! 😂 Unfortunately, we ended up leaving early.

author: Melissa C
review_text: We came on our one night before our cruise, and the food was solid. Very flavorful, fresh, and great portions. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food came out quicker than expected, and nice and hot. The sauces with our calamari and the coconut shrimp appetizers were so good as well as the mango pineapple salsa that came on our dishes. Having a beach view was icing on the cake. We had a great time!

author: Harry Plendl
review_text:
There’s the usual busy crowd from the beach, tourists, locals who are obsessed with being at the beach. Come during a storm and it is your play ground. Otherwise it is a beehive of activity. The food is above par for the course when it comes to bar food. It’s nice island vibe.

What needs improvement is there should be a food allergy codex for the menu. What is halal what is kosher, what has the gluten monsters in it? Actually add some stuff that’s gluten free and we’re on the right track .

The staff is great. They need to authorized to wear crocs or proper footwear for wet and humid climates. It’s raining half the time and wearing wet shoes and socks is crazy. Want to talk about safety? Listen to a podcast on trench foot. I know no one reads at insurance companies or else their documents wouldn’t suck so bad.

I’ll be back.

author: LH Smith
review_text: Emillie is always there for Amanda and me. Not only is the newly constructed bar clean and aesthetically appealing, along with the views being amazing, the service is warm, friendly, attentive and FUN!!! Excellent salmon and rice dish, too.

author: Kenn P
review_text: It has a dark moody beach vibe. It's paid street parking. On Fridays they have live music. It feels more like for an older crowd, 40+. It's up close to the water and at sunset its really nice. There's 3 TVs for sports, but not really a sports bar. Large selection of beers close to 40 if I had to guess. Come with your own crowd and make the good times happen.

author: Barrie Waisserberg
review_text: This place is the perfect beach scene. Since it's raised up, the ocean view is great. There is live music 6-9 weekdays and 3 - 6 weekends.  Prices are surprisingly reasonable for a restaurant on the beach. Overall, Nice, fun experience.

author: John Fronczak
review_text:
First time here. Being a local I usually stay in my local spots but decided to venture out to Dania Beach.  We came here to Lucky Fish. What a great discovery. Fabulous place. Food, price atmosphere and the service.
Rachael was the best. Attentive, funny, prompt and excellent customer service. 5⭐️
When in Dania I recommend coming here and asking for Rachael.  You won’t be disappointed. 🍺👍🏻

author: Tasheena S
review_text: My coworkers and I stopped here for a bite to eat. It was a Friday afternoon around 2pm. We were seated immediately. Our waitress was super friendly. The restaurant was super quiet and relaxing. The ocean views and breeze really did add to the ambiance. I had the grilled mahi mahi. It was pretty good. I would definitely return especially after a long day at work.

author: robert hawkins
review_text: Stopped for breakfast with friends between cruise pickup and airport drop off. Beautiful beachside venue with a nice view of Dania Beach. The food was delicious and the service was very attentive. An all around great experience.

author: Vanessa Diaz
review_text: We wanted to spend a relaxing and memorable afternoon with my family. We found this lovely place with a perfect view, and the food was amazing! We ordered fish and chips, and since the portion was generous, I shared it with my husband—it was more than enough. Such a blessed afternoon :)

author: Joaquin Urbonas Alvarez
review_text: Great food and drinks very reasonable prices and even better ambiance and view. Will definitely come back. Shame in you miami for not having nothing remotely close to this .

author: Kiah J
review_text: Perfect oceanfront breakfast/lunch spot. Ate breakfast then came back to order lunch and eat on the beach. Loved my breakfast burrito and their fresh mango salsa. We ordered the mahi mahi for lunch and it was delicious along with the mixed veggies. All the drinks I ordered from the bar were nice and strong. Service was fast and the servers were so nice I really enjoyed this spot.

author: Liz Selles
review_text: I'll be honest, I wasn't expecting much from a beachside restaurant. But boy was I wrong. We went on a Friday around 2:30 pm. It was a beautiful day so this was the perfect spot. The food was so good. And so were the drinks. And very reasonably priced. But my favorite part was Amanda our bartender. She was awesome and my Sea Breeze was perfection. Took great care of us. Can't wait to come back. And a shout out to manager Shane. Great job. Thank you.

author: Trey Neely
review_text: This place is awesome. 100% delivered for exactly what I needed in the moment I was there. I was in town for a work event on the beach and was traveling in a large truck with a trailer. Miami isn't exactly made for this type of transportation, so when I found Duffy's with the huge parking lot - I was very relieved. I was tired, and hungry, and didn't want to deal with a crowd. When I walked in, I was immediately surprised by how huge it was! I can imagine this place is hugely popular for big sport days. I went outside and easily found a seat at the bar. It's next to a POOL, which had no one in it at the time, but I'm sure it's awesome when in use. My bartender was KiKo and he was on fire. He had the whole outdoor bar to himself and was taking excellent care of everyone. Very impressive! The food was pretty good. The calamari was great and I was in the mood for chicken tenders, so I wasn't very adventurous, but they were good! Beer was cold and Kiko never left me hanging empty. Another big plus when you sit outdoors is the scenery. You're right on the water and get to see all the high end yachts come through...saw some amazing million dollar yachts pass by. All in all - if you want an EASY, well serviced, good bar food type experience - Duffy's is THE PLACE. Highly recommend!

author: Tracy Andrews
review_text: If you're in Miami. Please make this your place for Lunch, Dinner or snack!! Had no idea that I was walking into Paradise! I will be back with more people!! Thank you for showing love to me on my Birthday 🎂! Food and Drinks (2for1)💕 are out of this world! So, was I when I finished!! LOL

author: Robert Taylor
review_text: This is one of the nicest Duffy I’ve been to. Located right next to the water with outdoor dining amazing view. Bartender Tina is amazing, very welcoming. She suggested the daily special which was amazing. Thank you Duffys for another great time.

author: Roxanne Raphael
review_text: Tony was amazing! It was so nice to be sitting out by the water enjoying good food! My friend and I had the chicken nachos and we split the firecracker shrimp.....scrumptious! The drinks (espresso martini and cosmos)  were delicious and potent. I will definitely be back!

author: Aquarius Dawn Nancy
review_text:
Wendy, the beautiful bartender is the bomb!
I ordered the tasty All-American hot dog. It was very well done as I requested . My old fashioned Arnold Palmer was the the best I ever had made! Love North Miami Beach Duffy's Oliver took me to. He always takes me out and I appreciate him for always covering and making sure I get enough drinks!

author: Mistique Hernandez
review_text: The food was great and the atmosphere was lovely. Our waitress was Kayla she was efficient and nice. She even sang happy birthday to my friend twice which made the experience fun and playful. It was a great time. Highly recommend.

author: Carla
review_text: I had the firecracker shrimp tacos bomb. Com. Lol my cousin had them first and recommended them. So freaking good. The staff at the front bar was more attentive than the one closer to where the music is playing hit still good vibes overall and I just realized it's 2 for 1 drinks, all day everyday. I wish I didn't read that but lol that's a great deal especially in this economy. I have no complaints the djs on the weekend really get this place jumping. Pure good vibes. I will be back again and again ✨

author: Ciara
review_text: i love this spot so much, best calamari and 2 for 1 drinks all day! last night i had the pleasure of having Tony as my server and he was the BEST server i’ve had at any restaurant recently. he was consistent, funny, fast, and on point! the other servers who brought our food out were great as well. i also had the ribs that were falling straight off the bone and seasoned so well. if you come to this location, ask for Tony!!

author: lea'nora spencer
review_text: I came in on Monday and had an amazing experience thanks to my server Nehry!She was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. The service was quick, professional, and welcoming. She truly made the visit enjoyable and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Life Of Glo
review_text: I love coming here especially when Nehry is working! She’s such a sweet, caring server. She’s persistent always make sure the orders are done correctly, that we’re okay, & enjoying our food & drinks. I haven’t been seeing her much but i hope that she’s still there & to keep hiring great employees like her. Beautiful young lady!

author: J L
review_text:
* I'm updating my review - down two stars. The last 2 times I've been this month the service is abysmal. Management doesn't care. The one male bartender is a joke. Seriously.

Btw, I earned A LOT of rewards on my card. i.e. Ive spent money. Act like you care.

Went recently for the first time and was pleasantly pleased. Picked a very slow day to get a real experience. My burger was cooked exactly how I wanted it, as well my fries were nice and hot. Winning. The server was also very attentive. This is when you know.

They also have an interesting rewards system so I'll be taking advantage of that.

It's a large space with awesome views and will be back soon. Thanks again.

author: Carol ODell
review_text: Excellent food cooked exactly as requested! The meal was awesome and Yoshi was more than helpful with his service. On our table was, a medium burger, full rack of ribs and a rib/shrimp plate. The sides were delicious as well with no room for dessert! Overall was a great place, great dinner, great experience. Do yourself a favor and go!!

author: Tiphanie Wright
review_text: Nehry was absolutely amazing from the moment we arrived—she was patient, attentive, warm, and made us feel genuinely welcomed. She was super nice and very intentional with our table, always checking in at just the right moments. Her service was fast, efficient, and she listened carefully to everything we needed. You can tell she cares about her guests and takes pride in providing great service.

author: Michael Robert
review_text: Food was very good and not overpriced. The place was very busy during Sunday foorball. The server who was handling our table was overwhelmed. Luis, who has working another area, noticed she was behind and got our food and drink order in. Good group of people there.

author: Gabriella L
review_text: I came with my homegirls and we had a great time. Great vibes and our server Nehry was 10/10!!! Very attentive, funny, welcoming and beautiful. She made the experience more comfortable. The food and drinks were great. Would come again!!

author: Joseph Flagge
review_text:
I would give them ZERO stars if I could. Even though all was pretty good. The listed kids eat free on Dec 10, 2035 and a visit with Santa Claus. I paid the bill and realized that they DID charge us for the Kids Meal despite the waiter stating YES, Kids Eat Free Tonight!
I live in the community and used to come to this place a lot but after tonight I am done and I will make sure to let other know about this scam!

author: Simone
review_text: Absolutely unacceptable! I was served a drink with two bottle caps sitting at the bottom of the glass. This isn’t just careless; it’s a serious hygiene and safety issue. Completely ruined my experience, and I would never recommend this place to anyone until they seriously rethink their quality control.

author: Anthony Torres
review_text:
Lovely place! My family and I went for my brother’s bday dinner tonight, attention was great, food was delicious and 2 for 1 drinks amazing! Lovely Sofia took care of us and made our experience fabulous.
Will come back!

author: Andre E
review_text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Duffy’s Sports Grill recently, thanks to our amazing server, Keyra. From the moment we were seated, Keyra greeted us with a friendly smile and made us feel right at home. She was attentive without being overbearing, checked in often to make sure we had everything we needed, and handled our table with genuine warmth and professionalism.

The food was fantastic everything came out hot, fresh, and perfectly prepared but it was really Keyra’s excellent service that made the meal so enjoyable. She made great recommendations, kept our drinks full, and made sure every detail was just right.

author: Tabitha Hall
review_text: This place! Was fantastic!! On my first night in town, we laughed, we ate, we danced, we partied, and we had such a great time! Duffy's was a 10 out 10. The dj really kept the night going!! Being next to water, enjoying great food, great friends, and craft music was just what this tourists needed to settle in to Miami!; To get the feel of the Saturday night life for those want to have a great time, meet new people, and listen to a huge variety of music. I will definitely be back on my next trip.

author: Rawlins Amar
review_text: We took our friend for her 70 th birthday our experience was not very good. The server was rude rude his mannerisms not of the caliber to be a server. We had to leave the premises before something unpleasant happened. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone neither would I return. I feel though the food has some quality and the chefs knows what they are about however the front line people need some attention. We came because we saw an add on the Google chat about the restaurant and what they do for brunch this was totally misrepresented. Nothing on the add came to past. The restaurant had nobody.

author: Levent T
review_text: I can say almost perfect. Service and atmosphere is very good. Kitchen if we speak about appetizers 5 over 5, about seafood they know what they are doing 5 over 5, just steak cuts and cooking NY steak and serving that average, it was cold we told server and they act immediately and changed with new one but unfortunately also second one was cold and the cut was wrong and chewy but steak quality was delicious . It is worth to go again but you will definitely order seafood

author: Joelle Fhima-Berdowski
review_text: After a long travel day, Mykonos was the perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal with a view. Our waitress Valentina was wonderful and so attentive. She recommended the Special Greek Salad and lamb chops. Both were delicious and did not disappoint. If you love an Old Fashioned, you must try their Greek Old Fashioned… it’s nothing like we’ve tasted before.  We loved our experience, the service and food so much that we’re coming back with our family in a couple of weeks… can’t wait!!!

author: Mariam A
review_text: What a hidden gem! Was looking for a waterfront restaurant to celebrate my 30th birthday at and found Mykonos kitchen and bar last minute. Decided to give it a try and I am so happy we did. Our server Valentina was the absolute sweetest server. She was so accommodating to everything our family of 4 needed, which included an infant and a toddler. The food was good. The atmosphere was perfect. There was live music on a Friday night. Thank you to the singer and the crew for singing the happy birthday song for me. We really enjoyed our dinner here!!!

author: Emily Etman
review_text: We had Family dinner there.  A cozy and beautiful Mediterranean restaurant with a stunning water view. The atmosphere is warm and inviting—perfect for a relaxed quiet  dinner. The food is absolutely delicious: all appetizers where top of the line, especially the grilled octopus, which was tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Every detail, from the presentation to the taste, reflects authentic Greek cuisine. lamb shank, souvlaki, lamp chops 👍 A must try lava cake for desert ! A wonderful spot to enjoy great food and wine while watching the water.

author: Diana Mendelson
review_text: Food was really good but hot food was served before cold food/salads which is very weird. I wish service was better, our server wasn’t that good - seemed new. Food took some time to come out even though it was relatively empty for Father’s Day… idk probably not coming back unless someone else makes the rezzo.

author: Jennifer Sellers
review_text: This place was wonderful. Beautiful views and great vibes. We came with a group of 13 for a bachelorette party dinner. The food was delicious. The live music was also so nice! Highly recommend the meatballs and the halloumi.  The server and staff did a great job!

author: Berta Gonzalez-Eloy
review_text: We had an amazing experience at Mykonos Kitchen and Bar! The service, especially from Matias, was excellent — he was incredibly attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. The quality of the food was absolutely incredible, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The view was very nice, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The live music was definitely a plus and made the evening even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

author: Anzhelika S
review_text: I think it’s one of the best Greek restaurants in Miami. The amount of detail put into the decor and atmosphere, it looks very authentic. The food is on another level, every single dish is top! I celebrated my mom’s birthday there recently and it was perfect.

author: Michelle Rowlands
review_text: I absolutely loved it!  The food was amazing.  Service was good. Not too over the top & not lacking either.   I went for Sunday brunch.  Prices were pretty good especially for the amount of food.  Would highly recommend.  My husband actually went back that same evening to meet some colleagues.  If I lived closer, I would definitely be dining at least once a week.

author: Moshe
review_text: Very nice place. Location is amazing, right on the calm waters of the canal. Romantic if you are looking for a date night. We had lamb shank and scallops.  Wine selections were good. The interesting thing was, even though this is a Greek spot, they also have sushi.

author: Sofia Varela
review_text: Such a nice spot. Im traveling for work and staying nearby and the food was fresh! amazing branzino papillote. The service was friendly and made me feel at home. The manager came by to check on me, which I thought was a really nice touch! the place was empty but Valentina and the manager really took care of me.

author: Nick Diamantidis
review_text: I would definitely recommend this restaurant. The food was excellent, and the staff were very friendly. Matias did his best to take great care of us. We will certainly come back again!

author: Joanne Bowie Alvarez
review_text:
It was a great spot – we arrived right at opening, so it wasn’t crowded, and the food was fantastic. They have live music on Fridays and Saturdays, plus valet parking or a nearby parking lot. The outdoor area is absolutely breathtaking, and the chef’s ceviche was delicious and very flavorful!

Overall, an amazing experience! Margarita welcomed us warmly as we walked in, and our bartender, Sebastian, was very nice.

author: Kylie Camarda
review_text: Beautiful restaurant, food was amazing, and our server Valentina and the whole staff made our experience absolutely perfect! Highly recommend

author: Laura Castaneda
review_text: I went last night for dinner with my family and we completely enjoyed it since the first moment we walked in, everybody were so friendly. The environment was fabulous, nice music, beautiful place. Food was outstanding that i cant even explain how delicious it was. Wonderful service, always checking on us and making sure we were having a good time. I totally recommend it. They have a new fusion menu with sushi which let me tell u is the best in town and a wonderful seafood platter. THE BEST!!! I will definitely be back!!!!

author: Jeniffer Reyes
review_text: Matias was a great server but food was mediocre at best.. they offer free desert for the review… I guess now you know why they’re so highly rated! Come here for drinks skip the rest.

author: Stasi Michailidis
review_text:
Absolutely fantastic experience at Mykonos Greek Restaurant in Sunny Isles! We hosted a group of 25 people, and the evening could not have been more perfect. From the moment we walked in, the manager Natalia and her incredible staff went above and beyond to ensure our event was magical. Every detail was thoughtfully attended to, and we truly felt like we were in the best hands.

The food was out of this world – authentic, fresh, and bursting with flavor! From the appetizers to the main courses, every dish was a hit, with the grilled octopus and lamb chops stealing the show. The ambiance was second to none – a perfect blend of warm Greek hospitality and a lively, beautiful setting that transported us straight to the islands.

We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Thank you, Natalia, and the entire team at Mykonos for making our evening unforgettable! Highly recommend for anyone looking for an exceptional dining experience.

author: Andreina Salazar
review_text: Delicious food, beautiful place, and amazing service! Roberto was super attentive and helpful, and the whole staff was incredible. Thank you for a great experience! I truly enjoyed it and highly recommend this restaurant. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Colt Murgio
review_text: Mykonos is a unique Greek fusion restaurant featuring high-end Greek dishes. We booked a reservation for 11 people and were very flexible on the timing, as we ended up being an hour late. Once we arrived, we got seated immediately at the table. Also, we noticed the beautiful decor and atmosphere.  We ordered a variety of appetizers and entrees. I will say I was a little disappointed with the lack of service, considering only a handful of tables were occupied. The food tasted amazing, with my favorite being the lamb chops. Overall, I would come back here and have a great meal.

author: Moshe Chinn
review_text: Very loud. Great for birthdays and kids but can be overwhelming and hard to hear conversation. Food is delicious!

author: Ed Kaplan
review_text:
Gave it 5 stars since there are no half-stars.  Overall excellent restaurant: The cowboy steak was made to perfection. The cocktails wer some of the best we have ever had. The ambience was great- as long as you expect the loud party-like atmosphere with frequent celebrations. The service started out great but then became the only negative:  Our server was experienced, nice and helpful...in the beginning. She was rushed- but that makes sense here. The problem was that we were forgotten . People near us that came in later and seemed to order similar were served much quicker. I understand busy- but we wited quite a bit at the end. She did come over to see if everything was good but we had been done for a while and had to ask for a dessert menu when she started to walk away. Then after.getting and waiting another 10 minutes without service, we decided not to get anything (even though we were down as having a anniversary).
Then, when we asked for the check- I signed at the table and , as usual around here, 18% gratuity is automatic. She asked if I wanted to add to that and left in a huff when I said no (should have explained that I would have added if her service was stellar)

The appetizers were great (but ask about Cilantro if you have issues). I recommend the Dirty Nachos.The Cowboy steak was fabulous- and enough for 2 of us- especially with drinks and appetizers. (tho we would have made room for dessert if she didn't forget about us) . Sweet potato fries were perfect.The cocktails were excellent:  Berrylicious and Tropical Breeze.
Despite the negative feeling at the end with the server, I still highly recommend Fuego!

author: Eli Shmerler
review_text: The food at Fuego was absolutely delicious, especially the steak, which was perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The service was fantastic as well, with the staff being attentive and friendly. However, be prepared for some noise if you go. Whenever someone celebrates a birthday, the music gets cranked up to dance club levels, and it happens pretty often. It’s a fun vibe if you’re in the mood for it, but not ideal if you’re looking for a quiet meal. Overall, great food and service, just keep the lively atmosphere in mind!

author: N
review_text:
Worst ever food. The customer service zero. We ordered tomahawk 54 Oz. First of all it wasn't tomahawk, second it wasn't 54 Oz. Even the bone didn't belong to the piece of meat we got.
Worse than all these the steak wasn't even chewable. When we told the waiter and manager, they laughed....they don't even know how to apologize. Don't eat here there are many better restaurants in Miami. Fast food is better than this.

author: Avromie Fogel
review_text:
Our waiter, Branislav was the best waiter I’ve ever had in any restaurant.
He was super friendly and knowledgeable, constantly checking in to make sure we were good but not overbearing at all!
Food was top notch, drinks were crafted to perfection.

Best of all, it’s always a party at fuego with the constant celebrations.

author: Sam
review_text: Fuego is a really fun and outgoing experience! The place is amazing for a birthdays...

author: hilary doan
review_text:
Best kosher dining experience and steak I ever had!

I recently dined at Fuego by Mana in North Miami Beach, and everything was perfect! The service was fantastic, and overall experience was outstanding from start to finish. The staff greeted us warmly, and our server was attentive and knowledgeable, enhancing the dining experience.

The ambiance of the restaurant is vibrant and inviting, with tasteful decor and comfortable seating. The lighting and music created a lively yet relaxed atmosphere, making it perfect for both intimate dinners and group gatherings. 

We started with the carne asada tacos, which were amazing. The beef was tender and flavorful, and the salsa and toppings were spot on. For the main course, we had the Fuego Reserve Cut steak cooked medium rare, and it was cooked to perfection—juicy, tender, and full of flavor.
Service was fast, the food came fresh and piping hot!

Overall, Fuego by Mana exceeded our expectations in every aspect. The combination of exceptional service, a lively atmosphere, and exquisite food makes it a must-visit for anyone in the area. We will certainly be returning soon!

author: mario hernandez
review_text: This place was outstanding we had a large party about 30 people and the staff was terrific, friendly, efficient, and the food was incredibly good.  From appetizers to dessert every thing was fantastic we will be returning keep up the good work.

author: Aaron O
review_text:
3/4/24 New*

My wife and I came back with our daughter, and had a wonderful time. The service was excellent. Above and beyond what you would expect at a restaurant. Our waitress was amazing with our daughter, answered any and all questions, and made sure we were well taken care of. We came back due to our amazing experience last time, and I'm happy to say that everything, from the service, to the food, and atmosphere was top notch!

Old*

An absolutely amazing experience for my wife and I. Staff were on top of everything, making sure we had anything we needed. No long waits for a server was a huge plus.

The food was excellent as well, but the experience, atmosphere and incredible staff will have me coming back the next time I'm in Miami

author: Eli Geller
review_text:
If Miami had a beis medrash for serious carnivores, Fuego by Mana would be the Rosh Yeshiva.

Let me explain.

You walk into this place and instantly understand why every visiting bochur on mid-winter vacation suddenly develops “a cheshbon” to be in Miami. The ambiance is so sleek and upscale that even my jacket sat up straighter on the chair. Between the lighting, the music, and the smell of perfectly grilled meat floating through the air — you start to question decisions you've made in your life up until now.

Now, the food?
A whole sugya by itself.

The steaks arrive looking like they were prepared with more kavana than most people put into Ne’ilah. The plating is gorgeous — the type of presentation that makes you hesitate for a second before digging in, but then you remember who you are and that hesitation disappears fast.

Every bite is this slow, dramatic moment where you wonder, “Should a human even be allowed to enjoy something this much?” The flavors are deep, balanced, and honestly, borderline emotional.

Even the sides are next level. I ordered them “just to fill the table,” but they ended up stealing half the spotlight — like an unexpected chiddush from the back of the shiur.

The staff? Total mensches.
Attentive, patient, and somehow able to handle frum guests debating between three entrees and then choosing all three. Respect.

Yes, it’s pricey — but you’re not just paying for dinner.
You’re paying for an experience, a memory, and the ability to brag to your friends back in Lakewood that you “mamish felt transported.” (Transported where? Not sure. But definitely somewhere with better lighting.)

Bottom line:
If you’re in Miami and want a meal that hits like a Shabbos-day nap after kugel — this is the place. Perfect for dates, simcha trips, anniversary dinners, or simply proving to yourself that you deserve nice things.

Highly recommend. Would come back in a heartbeat, diet permitting.

author: Eigud R
review_text:
Food was amazing and even more was the great uplifting vibes and atmosphere, with every celebration lots of music and balagan and singing, was a lot of fun!
Great place for young generation!
Steak was delicious 10/10! Brisket Flatbread ok, 10/7.

Our waitress Max was great and patient and tried to be helpful as much possible since was super busy and overwhelmed.
Thanks!

author: Michael Gee
review_text: I had a great experience at this steakhouse. (The only downside was waiting about 15 minutes for a waiter to come to the table.) Once he arrived, everything turned around. He gave excellent service, was very attentive, and the food was truly delicious.

author: Hedika Azizi
review_text: Best restaurant experience in my life!! So happening and lively !! Great food and amazing presentation! Loved the music and celebrations !

author: Shayndl Horowitz
review_text: We had such a wonderful time at this restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, everything was clean, and the vibe was so lively and enjoyable. We truly enjoyed our experience and would definitely come back!

author: Patrick Elmaleh
review_text:
We had a great time at Fuego! The food was delicious and the service was absolutely amazing – friendly, attentive, and welcoming.

It was a bit on the loud side, but the kids had a blast and the atmosphere was full of good vibes. Definitely a place where you can enjoy a fun family night with great food.

Always a pleasure – we’ll be back for sure!

author: David Gerstman
review_text:
The food and service were both top notch. I enjoyed the Fuego burger and chocolate mousse, very much. Really nice ambience too.
Update 01/29/2023: service and food were wonderful. Our waiter was friendly, helpful and made our family very happy. Another wonderful experience.
Update 02/09/2025: this place is always happening. Great waiter, Manuel. And a birthday.

author: Stuart Wiston
review_text:
There aren't words to describe how amazing the food was. Each of the 6 of us got something different (except for my son and I who shared a dish for 2 that could easily have been for 4) and all of us said WOW.
Not an inexpensive place, but worth every penny
If you're in the area and have a chance to go Don't Miss It

author: Baila Kahan
review_text: We not only enjoyed the food , the atmosphere is massive and festive , and most of all our wonderful waiter Elinyer  topped it off wirh his service, friendliness,  and honest opnions !!!! Thank you!

author: Yosef Gindi
review_text: Fuego by Mana is an excellent spot with incredibly flavorful food, especially their burgers – they’re both satisfying and filling. However, if you’re seated on the outdoor patio, you might miss out on the lively atmosphere inside, where all the fun happens. That said, the patio can be a great option if you prefer a quieter dining experience, as the inside does get quite loud. Overall, a fantastic experience with delicious food and a vibrant vibe!

author: Alisa Henkin
review_text:
Burger was good, steaks were mediocre.
The music and noise level are unbearable.
Quality has gone down compared to years ago. They overbook Christmas week. We waited 40 minutes for our table with a reservation….not acceptable

author: Irina Uvarova
review_text:
This is hands down the best hookah lounge for me and honestly one of my favorite places in Miami. I’ve been coming here since the very opening, and after the latest full remodel the place looks absolutely amazing — more space, a completely new design, and an even better vibe.

Every Friday and Saturday they have DJs, plus daily specials and great deals. Even though it’s a hookah lounge, the food here is delicious — you must try the beef tartare, calamari, Caesar salad, syrniki, and tiramisu. They also recently had a sushi chef, and the sushi was incredible: super fresh and huge rolls.

They have some of the best hookahs in Miami, with high-quality tobacco and a great variety of flavors, along with a wide selection of cocktails and alcohol. Amazing hookahs, tasty drinks, and great food — all in one place.

The atmosphere is always beautiful and cozy, and the staff is absolutely wonderful — friendly servers and professional hookah masters who really know what they’re doing. I highly recommend this place for birthdays, events, corporate parties, or just to come, relax, smoke hookah, and enjoy the vibe. Truly the best of the best

author: Francisco Lozano
review_text: This has been our preferred date night option for more than three years now and even more so after their recent renovations. The menu options feel curated and the quality of each dish shines through. We’ve been lucky enough to try just about everything on the menu and pleasantly surprised by all of the options. My wife is particularly fond of their hookah and has never been disappointed with the preparation or service. Phenomenal staff, food, quality, ambience, and value. This has been our highest restaurant recommendation to friends and family when visiting the area. Highly Recommend.

author: Viktoriia Stepanushko
review_text: The most incredible hookah place to visit! Food was so delicious, I highly recommend to try sushi, skirt steak shawarma and fried calamari! I’ve got Sicilian Sour and Pineapple martini cocktails - really good, believe me. Hookah was also as strong and good as I wanted

author: Grigorii Rybakov
review_text:
Yo, this spot is straight-up FIRE 🔥 Hands down the best hookah/tea lounge in the whole MIA area! Chill vibes, clouds on clouds, flavors hittin’ different every time. The teas? Insane selection, bro.
But real talk — shoutout to Olga, our server, she’s an absolute QUEEN 👑 Super friendly, on point with everything, knows the menu like the back of her hand, and legit the prettiest smile in South Florida, no cap. Made the whole night 10x better.
If you’re in the area, pull up ASAP. You won’t leave disappointed, fam. 5 stars easy ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Already planning the next sesh!

author: Lilliana Vallejo
review_text:
Food and drinks were really good, and the hookah was yummy and smooth
The staff were really sweet as well But honestly, all the stars are because of the DJ,, he was AMAZING and completely set the vibe for the night. The music, energy, and overall atmosphere were on point. Definitely made the experience i was bumping

author: Игорь Мыза
review_text: The restaurant makes a great first impression with its cozy outdoor terrace, stylish seating, and warm lighting. The palm trees and sunset view add to the relaxed vibe. Hubble Bubble is a stylish spot for dinner or a night out with friends. Delicious food, great hookah, and a cozy atmosphere make it an excellent place to relax and enjoy your evening.

author: Alex Was There
review_text: One of best hookah place in Miami in terms of quality of the hookah product, atmosphere and service. Their signature Hubble Bubble tea is also one of the kind. This place was recently reconstructed and has a much better vibe now. 8 out of 10 overall.

author: Ivan Balandiuk
review_text: Been stopping by every week to have some proper tea and hookah and let me tell you, even on the busiest day I had a proper ETA and high-end service from both servers and hookah specialists.
