No matter who assisted us, Olga, Zlata or Victoria, we had and have a great time here. Quite a difference to local spots because of the European quality of service. Definitely a place to check out and recommend.

author: Isabela Jazmín Santana Polanco
review_text:
Amazing experience all around!
Hubble Bubble truly exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, the hookah was smooth, flavorful, and perfectly prepared, and the food was absolutely delicious. Everything we ordered was fresh and full of flavor, and the service made the experience even better. It’s the perfect spot to unwind, enjoy great food, and have an amazing hookah session. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great vibe and quality all around!

author: Charles G
review_text:
Wow! what a great place to eat, relax, and enjoy the great vibes, that the kind  folks at Hubble Bubble Lounge have created.

The best hookah ever, great drinks.. INCREDIBLE FOOD!
You will feel completely welcomed by the whole staff who are all lovely, and very attentive to make sure that your whole service is perfect!
They also showcase some great DJs that bring amazing sound live to the lounge setting. What more could you ask for?! This place is epic! Go for dinner, a date, a drink, some tea, great hookah, and awesome music. Excellent! 11/10

author: Dolce PicolaJO
review_text: The atmosphere is beautiful and cozy, and the staff is absolutely wonderful — friendly servers and professional hookah masters who really know what they’re doing. I highly recommend this place for birthdays, events, corporate parties, or just to come, relax, smoke hookah, and enjoy the vibe. Truly the best of the best. We are thankful to our friends who invite us for a New Year 2026 dinner.  I highly recommend this place.

author: David Ryabov
review_text: This place is amazing. You do not even notice how time flies by (manage your time accordingly lol). Food is amazing, especially tea - when you go you HAVE to try the tea and dumplings.

author: Aaron Walker
review_text:
Yesterday was my first time visiting Hubble Bubble Lounge, and unfortunately, the level of service we received was extremely disappointing.

From the moment we ordered, the waitstaff was inattentive and unresponsive. No one checked on our table at any point during our visit. We asked for water when placing our food order, but it never arrived I had to physically get up and track down a waiter just to receive it. The same issue occurred when it was time to receive our check; I had to ask multiple staff members before anyone assisted us. As they would always just walk past or table consistently.

Additionally, I clearly informed the staff that I am allergic to watermelon and requested a simple substitution for extra strawberries. Despite this being a reasonable request, they were unable or unwilling to accommodate it.

Overall, this experience fell far below even the most basic expectations of service. I was genuinely shocked by how poor it was, especially for a first visit.

At the very least, I believe a refund of the mandatory 20% service charge/tip is warranted, as the level of service provided did not justify it in any way. Hopefully some one can reach out to me to resolve this matter.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously, as this experience has significantly impacted my impression of your establishment.

author: Alice Cooper
review_text: I love this place, food is delicious! Also, atmosphere is good for meeting with friends. Staff is very helpful and friendly! Will back soon.

author: Anna Minets
review_text:
I am such a fan of everything this restaurateur does, from Davinci, All You Need to Hubble Bubble. Whatever he opens next, I already know I will be a loyal guest.

The main reason is the atmosphere and care you feel from the team every time you walk in. The service is consistently exceptional! Wonderful Olya remembers all my favorite dishes and tea and always greets me with a big, cheerful smile. The bartenders go out of their way to make sure you get exactly what you want.

The food is delicious, and I really appreciate that they stay open late.

author: abner
review_text: This place is amazing. Staff is very attentive and friendly and the food is AMAZING. Great vibes with live music and a comfy atmosphere to go with friends or family. Drinks and Hookah were also top quality. You won’t regret coming here it truly is a gem

author: Ahmed Mohammed
review_text:
Amazing experience at Hubble Bubble Lounge!
The food was delicious, the service was exceptional, and the atmosphere was absolutely perfect for relaxing and spending time with family and friends. The place has such a cozy and welcoming vibe — everything from the music to the presentation felt top-notch.

A special shout-out to Olga, who truly made the night memorable with her outstanding customer service. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure every detail was perfect. Her positive energy and professionalism really elevated the entire experience.

Highly recommend this spot — it’s easily one of the best lounges in Miami!

author: Joseph Siraki
review_text: This place was the best hookah lounge we have been in Miami!  Amazing service by Zlata and her tea recommendation was absolutely great!  Will be coming back for sure!  And will let my friends who are visiting Miami to come here!

author: Shikhar Das
review_text:
The Best Hookah Master in Miami!

If you’re in Miami and want a flawless hookah experience, look no further than Amir at Hubble Bubble. I’ve been to lounges all over the city—and honestly, no one comes close to the level of skill, care, and hospitality Amir delivers every single time.

From the moment you sit down, Amir makes sure everything is perfect. He knows exactly how to craft the smoothest, cleanest, and most flavorful hookah mixes, and he pays attention to every detail—heat management, airflow, bowl preparation, the works. You can tell immediately that he’s a true master of his craft.

What really sets Amir apart is his attitude. He’s friendly, attentive, and genuinely wants guests to have an amazing experience. He checks on you without hovering, remembers your preferences, and always brings positive energy to the lounge.

Hubble Bubble is great on its own, but with Amir there, it becomes a must-visit spot. Whether you’re a hookah expert or just enjoy a relaxing night out, ask for Amir—you’ll instantly understand why he’s the best in Miami.

Highly recommend!

author: Justin
review_text: Amazing place! Super cozy with that authentic hookah vibe, you relax from the very first inhale. The food is fantastic; I especially recommend the new rolls on the menu, they’re absolutely delicious. The service is quick and friendly, and a special thanks to Olya for her warm smile and attentive care. We’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

author: Audrey Bennett (She’s a Little Local)
review_text: Small but well designed restaurant with a nice ambience. The service was wonderful - we really enjoyed all the staff. The boquerones with the tomate were delicious, we ordered it with a side of their toasted bread which was the perfect crispy exterior & soft fluffy interior. The steak tartare was fantastic - had ours topped with a soft fried egg to add that luscious yolk. Paella for main course - was a special with rabbit & escargot. Finished with the creme Catalan - delicious.

author: Doni Digiovanni
review_text:
I’ll fully admit—I’ve written a review for Niu Kitchen before, but it deserves another. I’ve been in this industry for 16 years, worked alongside some of the top chefs in the game, and grew up with my grandmother, who was a chef at the Waldorf. I’d like to think I know what I’m talking about. And I can say with absolute confidence: Niu Kitchen isn’t just one of my favorite restaurants in the U.S.—it is my favorite restaurant in the United States.

This little slice of Spain in downtown Miami is understated at first glance. But once you sit down, you’ll feel it: the warmth, the soul, the authenticity. What sets Niu apart—beyond its incendiary food—is its people. While so many restaurants around them are turning and burning through staff, Niu has kept the same loyal faces for nearly a decade. That kind of consistency and heart is rare in this industry, and it shows.

I’m grateful this gem survived the pandemic, because they deserve every bit of praise. The food is transportive. I lose myself every time I dine here—each bite better than the last. The Bronzino tartar is a must, the legendary ous (only on Tuesdays, so book ahead!) is a revelation, and the squid ink arroz will stop you in your tracks. Don’t miss Chef Deme’s new clam dish, a family recipe from his mother—it’s soulful, heartfelt cooking at its best.

For me, no trip to Miami is complete without a visit to Niu Kitchen. It will forever hold the most special place in my heart and truly feels like home.

author: Jenelly Edith
review_text: This is my go-to for a healthy lunch! Absolutely amazing everytime! So healthy, delicious and amazing vibes! I always feel so good after eating since they use raw ingredients and no seed oils! They also have GF options! I recommend getting the salon, sweet potatoes, carrots and beet sauce. So delish! One of my favorite lunches in Miami!

author: Miami Judge
review_text: If you only have one night to dine in Miami, this is the spot! Chefs Lomas and Cabrera put their hearts into every dish, and the team makes you feel like family. Great wine selection and top-tier music. ¡Gracias!

author: Monica Nieto
review_text: Delicious Spanish food and great selection of tapas! Make sure you order the grilled oysters.

author: Mike Richardson
review_text:
12/10 will be back. Don’t sleep on this spot!

The charred oysters are not a dish, they are a life event. Smoky, briny, buttery perfection that made me question every decision I’ve ever made that didn’t involve ordering more of them.

Pro tip: be like me. Order the charred oysters as a starter. Then, when the server asks about dessert, ignore all social norms and order the charred oysters again. Sweet? No. Satisfying in a deeply emotional way? Absolutely.

author: Carmen Tun
review_text:
I really liked this place! We went on a wednesday night so not busy at all. Food came out quick and extra delicious.

We ordered an assortment of foods and everything was a hit! Especially loved the Ous, the artichoke, and the gamba al ajillo.

Super fresh, lovely tasting food and a very charming atmosphere. Staff were so nice and attentive as well.

One thing I will say, is that you might want to order a few side orders of bread since a lot of the dishes really benefit from having it, but do not come with it (like sopping up all the delicious sauce from the gamba al ajillo). I don’t think you can really go wrong with anything you order on the menu.

There was only one thing I did not particularly like, which was the foie gras, but I think that’s only because the pairings on this dish overpower the foie. I’m chalking it up to personal preference taste though.

Overall great spot, very happy I stopped in.

author: Katy Huang
review_text: The go-to tapa place in Miami. Quality ingredients paired with authentic flavors of Spanish cuisine makes dining at NIU kitchen an outstanding experience.

author: Arturo Picicci
review_text: Amazing spanish food! Best tomatoe bread then Artichoke, paella, octopus, camarones al ajillo! And sarah the best giving the best service!

author: Karen Young
review_text: What a gem! We need GF, no dairy/no egg. Found what we wanted with several options here. And the GF baguette was perfection! We had the roasted artichokes and mushroom paella. So satisfying to eat such good food!!! Photo of our empty paella pan because I dove in so fast.

author: Jess St
review_text: I love this place - easily one of the tastiest restaurants in Miami. The atmosphere is simple, but the food more than makes up for it. Every dish is packed with flavor and creativity, with combinations that feel both unique and comforting. A real hidden gem for anyone who cares about amazing food

author: A J
review_text:
This place has been on my list for years. Food was absolutely excellent! A bit pricey for the portions but we will be coming back here again. Everything was tapas size including the larger dishes. We ordered the charbroiled oysters, steak tartare, tomato bread, seared foie, bavette steak and arroz bec.

Charbroiled Oysters - wonderful flavor of smokey with the mild oyster taste. A bit pricey at $8 per piece but would absolutely order again

Steak tartare - My only critique would be that the steak tartare had a bit too much brine that overpowered the steak flavor but it was still quite good

Tomato bread - can’t go wrong with this to complement the meal

Seared Foie - loved the combination of flavors. Definitely combine each bite with the sweet and salty sauces on the dish

Bavette Steak - made perfectly rare as we ordered despite the thinner cut of meat. Both he steak and roasted vegetable relish was had an amazing Smokey flavor! Only comment would be to have the relish warm instead of cold

Arroz Bec - added this last minute to give one of the rice dishes a try. The combination of mushrooms, sausage and aioli with the rice was delicious. We couldn’t finish to wrapped up to go home and my husband ate it before the end of the night lol

The establishment also only does wine so unfortunately no beers and cocktails. We didn’t ask but would be interested to know if they allowed customers to also BYOB. Looking forward to going back!

author: Binder Family
review_text: We live an hour north in Delray, and this is still our go to dinner date spot. Dishes are light, and flavors are intentional.  We really appreciate the consistency here.

author: Erick Maitin Morales
review_text:
I received this recommendation as the best representation of Spanish food in Miami, and it was a disappointment.

Service: Unprofessional with wines, lack of knowledge about the menu and allergens, but the most notable issue was charging for dishes that were not served.

Food: The dishes were very risky and lacked refinement. The recommended paella had overcooked rice, and the artichoke was undercooked.

author: Lyon Hu
review_text: The food had good taste, but the portions were small. The service was average.

author: barby terzian
review_text: Food was great! Sara was nice and very professional. She suggested good plates!

author: Laurence Mercier-Lafond
review_text: Just WOW! Will definitely be back soon! We were lucky enough to get seated early on a Thursday night without a reservation.  My boyfriend said he’d come back here for their bavette steak rather than go to a steakhouse, it was THAT good! He even ate the artichoke which is a miracle! Everything was delicious. We also enjoyed the Arroz Sec, Tomato Bread, and Mahon + Chorizo. The skin contact wine Mission was funky & delicious. Service & ambiance were super pleasant

author: Agnes Hermann
review_text:
By far the best restaurant in Miami. Every time we went to Niu Kitchen, the food was AMAZING.
We love the simplicity of the place, very quick service, every single dish prepared with professionalism and love.
We appreciate to have a place like this.
Can’t wait to be back again.

author: Josh Friedlander
review_text:
Exceptional food. The oysters are a
Religious experience. The paella is very good. The pan con tomate is worth the carbs. The chocolate ganache dessert will end you. For the quality of the food, the prices are reasonable. I recommend you eat here while you can get a table.

author: Santiago Garcia
review_text: This is my go-to spot for spanish seafood dishes. Can’t go wrong with the rice and the charcosl oysters. There is always great wine options.

author: Stephanie Abil Vicente Gonzalez
review_text: It’s my first time here and I absolutely love this place. The atmosphere is excellent, and the service is outstanding. The quality of the food is truly 5-star—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The coffee is delicious and simply incomparable to any of the nearby places. The service is impressively fast, and the music is at the perfect volume, creating a very pleasant and welcoming ambiance. Overall, it’s an exceptional experience from start to finish.

author: Abraham Daruich
review_text: Yiri was amazingg! The food was Great and tasty ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Absolutely loved MIAM MIAMI! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every bite felt thoughtful and well-balanced. The atmosphere is super chill but stylish, perfect for brunch or a relaxed meal. The staff was friendly and attentive without being overbearing. Definitely one of those places you keep coming back to. Highly recommend!

author: Debora Chong
review_text:
Upon walking into Miam I thought, "Wow, this place is really nice!" The staff are so friendly, place is so organized and clean and as I looked into the kitchen the cooks were so busy and diligent at work. They looked so efficient. The star of the show was he food! Everything we ate was so delicious! We had the buttermilk pancakes, match latte and the breakfast burrito. Everything just melts in your mouth. You can't go wrong ordering anything from the menu.
Amanda was super friendly and nice. Always there whenever we needed anything extra. We will definitely come back here again.

author: Erica Matos
review_text:
I had such a great experience at this breakfast spot! Everything came out fresh, hot, and beautifully plated. Our server, Dani, was fantastic — super friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without ever feeling rushed.

The pancakes were absolutely delicious — fluffy, buttery, and perfectly golden — but definitely huge! One order could easily feed two people, so I’d recommend sharing if you want to try other items too. The bacon, egg, and cheese croissant was another winner: buttery, flaky, and packed with flavor.

The only miss for me was the matcha — not bad, just not something I’d order again next time. Still, with food this good and service this warm, I’ll absolutely be back. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a satisfying breakfast and great vibes!

author: Viral J
review_text:
Miam Café in Miami is one of the best places for brunch, breakfast, and coffee in the Wynwood area. The café has a modern, cozy vibe with a menu full of fresh, flavorful, and healthy options. It’s perfect whether you want to grab a quick coffee, enjoy a relaxed meal, or meet friends for brunch.

The menu offers a great mix of eggs, avocado toast, sandwiches, salads, pastries, and fresh juices. The ingredients taste fresh and high quality, and the presentation is always on point. The coffee is excellent, and they also have great vegetarian-friendly choices.

The café atmosphere is relaxed yet stylish, making it a great spot to hang out, work, or simply enjoy a meal. The staff is friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even better.

author: Ms Flo
review_text:
My husband and I visited the Miam Cafe located in Miami about a week ago while we were in town. We were greeted promptly upon arrival. We then proceeded to the register to place our order. Once our order was ready, it was brought out to our table.

They looked to be a little short staffed on this particular day, although I'm unsure if this is the typical set up regarding the number of staff daily. However, it didn't hinder them from getting the orders out in a timely fashion.

The food was fresh, hot and delicious when it arrived. The cashier/waitress checked on us quite frequently despite her being the only one working both the register and waiting tables. Would definitely return to this location.

author: Leslie Schmerfeld
review_text: Eggs Benny was amazing! paired with rich smoked salmon and perfectly seasoned potatoes. Front hosts were very kind but need to work on communication and better flow. Our seat was moved twice. The food and drinks came out super quick!

author: Emilie Veyland
review_text: My first time here and I will for sure come back! Amazing and peaceful atmosphere, food is top notch, the menu is quite elaborated with different meal types, I did not know what to choose, so many great options! And cherry on the cake, the staff is wonderful, kind and caring 🫶🏻 thanks for such a nice lunch experience!

author: Chantil Sanchez
review_text:
The Miam Pancakes were good, menu said it came with maple syrup but it was def not. It was what you’d expect with a high fructose corn syrup kind. The fruit and whipped topping was great and the pancakes themselves were fluffy but at room temperature, so not sure how freshly made they were.

The Miam breakfast burrito however was fantastic. Very flavorful and jam packed with fresh ingredients and piping hot.

I found it perplexing that we got our food before our coffee order. I had to ask for cream for my brewed coffee after being told when I initially ordered it that it was given on the side.

Also be warned that the restaurant automatically adds a 4% “Restaurant Charge” to the bill.

author: Janna Rae
review_text: I LOVE LOVE Miami Cafe! Laureen & Judith are the absolute sweetest! the service is great and the food even better! it can get a little busy , they do their very, best to accommodate you and get you seated as soon as possible. We had no prob and got seated right away. Miami cafe is a miami brunch staple and a must go to!

author: Maribel Sanchez
review_text: Local & cute eatery! As soon as we walked in we were greeted and felt a super homey ambiance. The food was 10/10! we had some Miami fluffy pancakes topped with fruit & whip cream, a breakfast croissant with a side salad & a Miami sandwich with some side of sweet potatoes. I loved it !!!!

author: Layla P
review_text:
Here’s a clean, friendly review you can use:

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Amazing Experience at Miam Café!

Miam Café is truly an amazing place, and Judi made the experience even better. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the servers are super kind, attentive, and always on top of everything. Judi especially stood out with her friendly attitude and great service.
The food came out fast, everything was fresh, and the overall service was smooth and efficient. If you’re looking for a spot with great vibes, delicious food, and staff who genuinely care, Miam Café is definitely the place to go!

author: Jessica Diaz
review_text: We had a wonderful breakfast, avo toast, side of bacon and a bacon/egg/cheese croissant. Get the hot sauce on the side. Everything was hot, fresh and savory. I also had a hoy lavender latte and it was just right.  Next time I will definitely get the pancake stack. Everyone had them around us and were raving about them!

author: A J
review_text:
Absolutely amazing experience at Miam Cafe Biscayne!
The food was delicious and beautifully presented, the pancakes were unreal and the matcha drink was perfect. The atmosphere is bright, clean, and so inviting.

But what really made my visit exceptional was our server, Dani. He was incredibly attentive, pleasant, and professional from start to finish.

author: mikiah fribbley
review_text: Great food and even better service! Everything was fresh and flavorful, and the atmosphere was welcoming. Dani, our server, was absolutely amazing—friendly, attentive, and made the experience even better. Overall, a smooth and enjoyable visit. I’d definitely come back and recommend this place to others.

author: WILLIAM WHITE
review_text: Somewhat more of a "diner" type feel in a luxury condo bldg. Food was very good & portion size was excellent. I ordered the buttermilk pancakes w/whip cream & mixed berries. One portion cook really feed 2 ppl so if you're out with your girl fellas, order 1 & split it with your lady & it will be enough. Service was fine, plates & utensils were clean. Overall, I'd give it a 7.5- 8/10

author: Mayra Volquez
review_text: If you are looking for a nice breakfast/ Brunch place in Downtown Miami, this is your place. I will definitely come again and bring my sister.

author: Danni G
review_text:
Such a great experience for my entire family — all 17 of us! While in Miami awaiting our cruise, we stopped by Miam for brunch, and it did not disappoint! The food was absolutely DELICIOUS and the portions were huge. 🍳🥞
Our server, Karè, took such good care of us and made the experience even better. From the Eggs Benedict to the French Toast, Nutella Pancakes, and Breakfast Burrito, you really can’t go wrong here. Highly recommend if you’re ever in the area!

author: Tiffany Leung
review_text: Food was delicious, and the menu has several bakery, breakfast, and lunch options. The staff are very friendly, and the space is lovely with big windows for lots of sunlight. Dani was helpful and kind!

author: AG
review_text: Miam Cafe was relatively close to our hotel. We’ve been hunting to find a good breakfast spot while visiting Miami, and man am I glad we found this place! They were really busy so we had to wait outside for a little bit but we had cover from the rain. The atmosphere inside is amazing, service is amazing, and the food is AMAZING! Probably some of the best food I’ve had, especially the breakfast burrito. The Dubai pancakes were so unique, presented beautifully, and tasted fantastic (although you can definitely split it with others, the portion is huge). This is just the place we were looking for the really get the Miami experience. Would absolutely recommend to anyone wanting some tasty breakfast/lunch that is unique and delicious!

author: Ann Zakkery
review_text:
The place looks good on the pics and in reality. But the restroom is dirty, the faucet in the restroom needs replacement , it’s so dirty that you don’t want to touch it.

The rolls contain too much of sugar, too much.
It’s ok for rice to have sugar BUT not THAT much.

As for the ramen - it’s tasty, but it’s not classics Japanese. The broth is tasty but not the Japanese style, more typical American. With big chunks of ingredients. Was supposed to find almost the whole zucchini in my ramen.
The music was super loud and disturbing.
The water has a scent of ray or smth that shouldn’t be in the water. Needs improvement
In general - it’s ok place to visit once. But will not return.

author: Daryna Paterylo
review_text: The food was amazing — the sushi was just wow! I especially recommend the Volcano Roll. The atmosphere is very nice, but the big downside was the service, which felt very unorganized and messy.

author: Paola Fuentes Hernandez
review_text: I recently visited Sushi Sake for lunch and I really liked their variety in lunch special options. I ordered beef noodles and my friend had shrimp noodles; we liked it. I am giving it 4 starts because we arrived to the restaurant and no one was in the front so I ended up asking the security guard where was the person and he asked me to wait until someone showed up; after seated, the server took a while to come and take our order plus we ordered sriracha sauce and were charged $1 for it. Who charges for sriracha?? It is like charging for ketchup 🤷🏻‍♀️

author: Martie Parfait
review_text: I really don’t like this new upfront gratuity! The service should be above par for 20% gratuity. Sat out on the patio, waited a few to get served. The miso soup was tasty. The grilled calamari was bland. The veggie fried rice was good.

author: Jamieko Lane
review_text:
What a great find. We only stayed a few nights in Miami and wanted to eat here every night. Our server Luisa was great. She was the only server for happy hour and even with a full restaurant we felt attended too.

We had the shrimp shumai, nfl roll, spicy conch roll, veggie fried rice, and the combo tempura. We came during happy hour (which was pretty late) and scored some great deals!

The old fashioned we had took a little while but was worth the wait. The food was great. The spicy conch roll had a hot sauce that was different but not bad. The veggie rice was definitely under cooked but it had a great flavor!

They have an amazing outdoor seating area with fire pits. We chose to go inside bc we had our little with us.

Highly suggest!

author: Alberto Miami
review_text:
I’ve visited the Sushi Sake chain before at other locations around Miami, and this was my first time at the Biscayne location. I came to the restaurant on a Wednesday around 4 p.m.; it was pretty much empty. The hostess told me I could pick any table I wanted, inside or outside. The weather was nice that day, and the veranda looked very pretty, so I chose a table outside. Also I had a quick look inside, and the restaurant looked modern, nice, and clean.
My waiter came over pretty fast and was nice. BUT he only brought me the regular menu and didn’t mention anything about the Happy Hour menu, which actually starts at 4 p.m. at Sushi Sake restaurants on weekdays. I had to bring it up myself, and he acted like he had forgotten about it. When I asked for the Happy Hour menu, he told me they didn’t have physical menus available at the moment, which seemed strange. Then he just started listing a few of the dishes from the Happy Hour menu, and of course, he missed a lot. Luckily, I had done a review of another Sushi Sake location a few months earlier and had ordered from their Happy Hour menu. So I pulled up that review on my phone to remind myself what I wanted. I ended up ordering the JB Roll and the Miami Heat Roll again.
My food came out fast - about 10 minutes after I ordered. Everything looked and tasted as expected: nice and delicious! The portions at this restaurant are big and filling. Personally, I’m always fully satisfied after eating two sushi rolls. I absolutely love the JB Roll + Miami Heat Roll combo - they go really well together! As for the regular menu, it offers a lot of variety, which is great. I’ve never had bad food at this sushi chain. For drinks, I always order an iced tea. It’s very tasty here, plus they offer free refills. I also love that they have agave syrup and simple syrup, which I always ask for instead of sugar.
Price-wise, I find this restaurant generally reasonable; just a few items on the regular menu seem a bit overpriced to me. But the Happy Hour menu is an excellent deal! My final bill after ordering two items from the Happy Hour menu plus a drink is around $22, which is fantastic!
I absolutely recommend the Sushi Sake chain if you’re looking for good, tasty sushi and rolls. And the Biscayne location is a great option - it’s in a tourist-friendly area of Miami and not far from the Port of Miami, which makes it a perfect spot if you’re arriving by cruise ship and want to grab some Japanese food!

author: Lo Allison
review_text:
Vibe was awesome, restaurant was clean, staff was friendly and food was delicious!

As a vegetarian I never know what to expect, especially at sushi restaurants but the sushi was phenomenal. I got the veggie roll and asked to have cream cheese added. Ended up getting an additional roll.

The veggie eggrolls were some of the best I've ever had. So delicious!

Our 2 year old loves sushi but she ate more here than she typically does. Very impressed!

author: Jos S
review_text: I give all 5 because Edwin made our night while we were waiting for out server that took a little to come take our order! The food is good, the restaurant is pretty and Edwin was the best! Our server was super nice too but I really wish that Edwin would serve us. He had knowledge of what we were asking but he county take the order, since he could not serve us he was very nice and on top of the service while the server came to the table. No complains for the server, I just want to recognize that it was a team that made our experience nice!

author: Monica Nicholson
review_text: Great service from Danny at the bar! Amazing decor and atmosphere. The cocktails were amazing, Fuji apple crisp and espresso martini were deeeeeelicous!!!

author: Sophie Seltzer
review_text: Kept asking locals where to get good food, this place kept being named. Did not disappoint. Loved the octopus nigiri, so many amazing rolls and the vibes were super cool. Lots of sick neon.

author: Olga Acosta
review_text:
On my first visit to this location after an event at the Kaseya Center, the experience was unfortunately below expectations. Upon arrival, the host immediately mentioned a private event and seemed discouraging about the wait time. However, I had already observed several tables simply waiting to pay, and a couple who arrived before me was seated while I briefly stepped away. Given this, it was unclear why an accurate wait time could not be communicated.
During my wait, I also observed a man who appeared to be a manager inform a server that a table was about to leave without paying due to how long they had been waiting to check out. Instead of assisting directly, he stepped back, which gave the impression that staff support and oversight were lacking.
After being seated, no one approached our table for about ten minutes, not even to offer water, so I had to request assistance. When the food finally arrived, it was disappointing to find that my meal was cold and clearly not freshly prepared. When I shared this feedback with the server, she appeared unfazed and simply walked away. Later, after asking for the bill, we waited an additional ten minutes before having to flag her down again because it seemed the request had been ignored.
To make matters worse, a 20% gratuity was automatically added to the bill, despite the service falling far short of that standard. Having visited other Sushi Sake locations, this experience was by far the most disappointing. Based on this visit, I do not plan to return to this location.

author: Vinh Ly
review_text:
The location and ambience was great but the food is subpar. Nigiri tastes old and the rice on the rolls were falling apart as we picked them up. We also ordered a seafood fried rice that was decent, packed with meats but was very very oily. The most disappointing was the fried/tempura ice cream, which was 90% dough. Overall, food looks better in pictures…

I came with ONE other person and yet they automatically charged a 20% gratuity despite not refilling our water at all.

author: Taneisha Tomlinson
review_text: I went here with my husband in November for brunch while we were in Miami, and we had a good time. We were seated outside, which was great. The day was cool and breezy, and we enjoyed the ambiance and the view. The food and the drinks were delicious. We would definitely go back for sure.

author: Mariya Doncheva - Real Estate Agent
review_text: During our vacation, our visit to Sushi Sake Biscayne was a delight, marked by friendly staff and amazing food that truly stood out. My husband was particularly impressed with their sushi, praising its freshness and flavor, while I found myself enamored with their chicken fried rice and chicken hibachi—both dishes were cooked to perfection. We also indulged in their desserts, which were a wonderful end to our meal. The ambiance is welcoming, making for a memorable dining experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-notch sushi and more.

author: Tina Sargent
review_text:
This place was amazing! So delicious and fresh! You won’t be disappointed!! Give it a try! Ask for Stephanie, made dinner ever more enjoyable! full of joy and a beautiful smile. Very helpful!
The jalapeño mahachi is the best!!

author: oriana rojas
review_text: my fiance, cousin, and I came on a whim after a billie concert and WOWWW SO GLAD WE DID!! Danny and Gladys were absolutely amazing! they were kind and made the best recommendations. Ten cuidado con los dos por que son como familia después de 10 minutos

author: Marissa Smith
review_text: This place really sets the date night tone with the low lights and tabletop spotlight. The beyond exceptional service our waiter Danny gave, made our experience just as great as the food was! I had a virgin Lychee Mojito (which lived up to my pregnant expectations lol) while my fiance had a bottle of Nigori Sake, which Danny made sure his glass was always full!! We started with the Sake Tostones. Followed by a small ginger salad before receiving our entrees. Our hibachi shrimp and filet mignon plates didn’t survive photos but I 10/10 recommend!

author: Yvonne W
review_text:
Disappointing experience. They only gave two people one menu to share, which was already strange. Plates weren’t properly cleaned and even had greasy fingerprints on them. The shredded carrots and lettuce used as sushi garnish were dehydrated and wilted — either not fresh or being reused.

On top of that, they still automatically expect a minimum 20% tip for this level of service. Would not recommend.

author: bianca magadan
review_text: sushi sale was an exceptional dining experience with tasty food, gorgeous interior design, and attentive staff. i ordered the volcano roll with the steamed gyoza, the result was a beautifully garnished platter with an even more flavorful taste. we couldn’t help but order more sushi later that night. besides the sushi, there are plenty more options to choose from, so there’s a taste of heaven for everyone!

author: Edwin Rios
review_text: Asked for a glass of water while looking at the menu and this has to be the worst tap water I've ever had in a restaurant. Enough to take your appetite away. Food was average and if they use the same water for  cooking, this is likely affecting their food quality. Had to order a bottle of sparkling water to get by. For the price of their menu, the least they can do is give you a decent glass of water. Music was high enough where I had problems listening to the servers or the person a cross the table. This takes away from enjoying the environment with your party.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Meredith Sanders
review_text: The food was amazing and the restaurant is phenomenal. I got the crispy calamari, risotto of the day which it had all the seafood in it and definitely didn’t taste super fishy it was a super nice blend. Their tiramisu was really good and better than I expected. Definitely took me back to Italy for sure! The service was so great. Samet helped me with what I should choose and he was very knowledgeable about everything on the menu as well with the restaurant even if he’s been there for short time. Excellent service, food and atmosphere definitely will be back again!!!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Thomas Strehle
review_text: Stunning space in a beautiful newish area downtown. The space is amazing.  Realize it is Miami but I just got back from NYC and felt the comparative prices here were ridiculous for the quality of food.  The least expensive spaghetti with tomato sauce (no protein) is $25. It was ok. They advertise San Marzano tomatoes in it but I question it. Service was VERY friendly and accommodating. Shortrib ravioli was ok for $36 for lunch.  Looks like it would be a lot of fun at happy hour. Raspberry espresso martini was wonderful!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Yanely Balbontin
review_text:
Serafina in downtown is hands down one of my favorite spots. The food is consistently amazing, but the mussels are on another level—absolutely delicious and always perfectly cooked.

What truly makes this place special, though, is the service. The bartenders, Kat and Alyza, are incredible. Their energy, professionalism, and genuine care for guests are the reason I became a regular. They always make you feel welcome and taken care of, and they know exactly how to elevate the whole experience.

Great food, great drinks, and even better service. Highly recommend!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Steve Ludwig
review_text:
I come to Serafina often as a regular usually sitting up at the bar area.  Kat is awesome and a great bartender!  The food is great and atmosphere is perfect.   There is a good balance of happy hour food specials + regular menu items.  Also they sponsored an event with my apartment complex.  It was very nice and great environment for meeting other people.

The best items are the Alfredo with chicken, the meatballs and the chocolate cake.    It's great Italian food matching the quality of other restaurants in the area.

Recently my last two visits were really great.  I could not travel for Christmas because of nose surgery.  Serafina had a Christmas brunch which was so great and made my holiday.  Also for New Year's eve they had a nice menu with really good cake.

Serafina is fitting into the neighborhood very nicely and caters both to tourists and the regulars like myself very well.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Julia Doell
review_text: Attended Serafina Downtown Miami for date night last night.  Our server was Daniel and he was very attentive and kind. Our food arrived to our table very fast. It was delicious and you could tell, house-made.  I ordered the Gnocci, it was soft and delicious. Only thing I feel it was missing was a nice piece of bread. The tiramisu for dessert was quite good as well. I loved the chocolate shavings on top.  Overall we really enjoyed our experience and would return next time we visit Miami.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Grekys Ferrer
review_text: I had an amazing experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. On top of that, the service was outstanding. Jessica was extremely attentive, friendly, and professional, making sure we felt welcome and well taken care of at all times. Thanks to her excellent service and the incredible food, our visit was truly memorable. I highly recommend this place and especially Jessica!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Dan Bob
review_text: Great spot for people watching seated at an outdoor table. Conveniently located just outside CitizenM hotel. Delicious mussels in garlic butter, shallots, cherry tomatoes and sprigs of fresh thyme. My waiter, Samet, was informative, attentive, efficient and very cute. Enjoy your time here!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Cynthia Gutierrez
review_text:
Ok, so I don’t like to give this kind of review, but unfortunately this place just... I don’t even have the words to express my disappointment. I chose this place for my partner’s birthday and was excited because it was a new spot and we love Italian food. When we arrived, we had to wait a few minutes until someone was available to attend to us. When we saw the host, we asked her if that was where we were supposed to wait, and she said yes—just wait for me, I’ll be right back—which never happened. A lovely woman showed us a few minutes later where to sit and was kind, especially since the table was for four and we were just two. They offered us prosecco on the house, and we appreciated the gesture. We waited more than 15 minutes until someone took our order. The waiter was really kind and did his best with the resources available to him. As for the food, it wasn’t anything extraordinary.
Honestly, I’ve been in better places. My boyfriend ordered a truffled beef carpaccio and bruschetta, which weren’t good. I ordered a pepperoni pizza, and I have to say that was the best dish of the bunch. I also ordered truffle fettuccine, and my boyfriend had spaghetti al pacino. According to him, it wasn’t bad, but unfortunately, the chef didn’t want to accommodate our requests, so we moved on. I honestly didn’t have a good time there. Maybe it was just that day, or I don’t know, but for a barely new place, it was pretty empty.
And can we talk about the bill? Too expensive for that quality. The worst money I have ever spent
P.S.: Please also pay attention to the restrooms. They were pretty disgusting.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Paola Fuentes Hernandez
review_text: Stopped by Serafina with a friend to kill some time before a Miami Heat game and really enjoyed the pleasant atmosphere. We first sat at the tables near the bar, but no one came by after several minutes. As soon as I moved to the bar, we were helped within two minutes. We had two glasses prosecco, a Margherita pizza, and the fried calamari. The pizza was just okay, but the calamari were really good. Overall, a nice experience, and I’d come back to try more of the menu.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Artem Moldsvskiy
review_text:
The restaurant is beautiful, with a pleasant atmosphere, and the food comes out very quickly — that’s a strong plus.
However, several issues affected the overall experience.

The bread served with both the tartare and the bruschetta was extremely dry — so much so that it actually hurt my gums.
The Caesar salad was disappointing, no better than a 2/5. The dressing didn’t enhance the flavor at all.
I was offered water, but it was never brought to the table.
Also, the salad plate was unstable and kept moving every time I tried to take a bite, which made eating quite uncomfortable.

On the positive side, the calamari were tasty, and the beef tartare itself was very good. The Margherita pizza was also enjoyable.

Overall, the place has potential, but several details need improvement.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: May P
review_text: Elegant, spacious and inviting Restaurant with ample seating inside and outside. Expansive beautiful bar area with great Happy Hour offerings and prices every day! Nice plantings give it a tropical flair. Some nice vegetarian, but didn’t see much vegan options. Definitely recommend labeling the offerings so patrons can tell which meals are vegan and or vegetarian as so many other finer establishments do.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: neshat shahabi
review_text: Absolutely the best. My boyfriend and I loved it so much we went there twice during our three day vacation. Cute and bougie, close to everything. The space has a lush green vibe and the food was incredible. We left smiling and our hearts are still with them.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Erica Matos
review_text: Tammy was an excellent server at Serafina—on point, super efficient, and genuinely attentive. I never had to track her down for anything, and she knew the menu inside and out. The food was amazing, and the tiramisu was absolutely out of this world. Thoroughly enjoyed!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: A P
review_text:
Whenever you see a new restaurant with low reviews, and especially a chain restaurant that has done this multiple times, one always wonders what happened, and mostly it’s about the leadership at the top - especially the restaurant management.

In our case, we ended up on a Monday with the restaurant 80 percent empty. On this particular day, they had run out of the house red to go with the food. While there were five other wines that were available by the glass , we were not allowed to substitute. Finally, courtesy the bartender we were offered a low cost Malbec that was not on the wine list. Several questions here: why do you have a cheap wine in the bar but not on the menu unless you are feeding it to unsuspecting customers. How much money are you gonna lose by substituting one red wine glass with another from already open bottles? And most importantly, how well are you training your staff to create happy experiences for your customers? After all, 80 percent of the questions your servers face are tied to 20 percent of the issues. Just remind your staff about these issues in your afternoon staff meeting till it becomes like A, B, Cs for them.

On the food side, we simply had the pizza and it has nothing special to it. One can totally avoid it if needed.

But, not everything was bad. a shout out to Vlada for giving us a listening ear and understanding the issues.

To the super senior management, you can invest millions of dollars, but without the right people, you are just another 4.1 rated restaurant in a busy Miami restaurant scene. Good luck!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Irena D
review_text:
This place is located just downstairs of the building where I live, so I had visited it for a couple times already.
I can say, very average and definitely not for a special occasion.
Beautiful interior, nice patio, but food is not so great.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Dayton Blanco
review_text: Aury is an absolute star behind the bar! Super attentive, friendly, and always makes you feel welcome. The drinks were perfect, but what really stood out was her energy and the way she takes care of everyone with such ease. She truly made the night memorable. Highly recommend Aury if you want amazing service and a great vibe!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Eric Hayes
review_text: I have been a loyal Serafina customer at both NYC locations and now the new Downtown Miami World Center location. I am a Condo owner at a neighboring building called Marina Blue at 888 Biscayne Blvd. I am so happy that Serafina is my neighborhood restaurant. I order takeout most of the time due to the proximity of the restaurant to my home. The bartenders and hostesses and especially the manager are always professional and respectful, which I expect as a New Yorker and they have always gone above and beyond to make me feel like family which is rare as a transplant from the Northeast. The food is always delicious and ready on time. Best addition to the neighborhood!!!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: stephanie von lapcevic
review_text:
Last night I visited this place and had an Amazing experience!
The place is super warm and welcoming, with a really nice atmosphere✨. We tasted several dishes recommended by our waiter, Federico, who was incredibly kind, cordial, and attentive. Every single dish was delicious, and his suggestions were spot on.

Thank you for such a great experience, we will definitely be coming back!🥂🤩

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Hector Leon
review_text:
A new Miami staple right here. I feel like they’re bringing the quality of service and amazing food I love from NYC top spots, but with their unique Miami flare.

Good place for Happy Hour and date night

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Katerina Denisenko
review_text: A stunningly beautiful place with completely clueless management. The food is absolutely tasteless, and the service is unbearably pushy — the waiters, seemingly high, don’t serve you so much as rush you out from the moment you arrive. To top it off, the staff apparently doesn’t know that on a birthday, the candle on the cake is supposed to be lit before it’s brought to the table, not after. Ridiculous.

author: Yongkwan Song
review_text:
The food itself was excellent—especially the steak and the shrimp bucket, both of which were very tasty.
We ordered the steak medium and medium rare. The medium was slightly overcooked, while the medium rare was much more tender and flavorful.

The overall atmosphere of the restaurant was nice, but it wasn’t easy to get a staff member’s attention. If you wanted to place an additional order or ask for something, you usually had to wait around three minutes before seeing a server.

Personally, when it comes to steak, I thought this place was better than Hard Rock Cafe.

author: Harrison C. Davies
review_text: 🎬 🍤🏃🦐🌊 “Life is like a box of chocolates… you never know what you’re gonna get,” and that fits perfectly because every Bubbly Gump Shrimp Co. location really does have its own vibe. This one is packed with throwback film memorabilia and feels like one of the flagship spots of this fictional-but-all-the-more-fun enterprise. The vibes were great, the service was friendly, and they definitely captured the Forrest-verse charm. Just wish they still did the movie trivia — that was always such a fun part of the experience.

author: Julio Andres
review_text:
I had an amazing experience at Bubba Gump Shrimp Co. on Biscayne Blvd in Miami! The food was absolutely delicious — every bite full of flavor, fresh, and perfectly cooked. The whole place has such a fun and unique Forrest Gump theme that makes the atmosphere lively and memorable.

But what really made our visit special was our server, Ramona. She was incredibly kind, friendly, and genuinely funny — her great energy made the whole experience even better. She went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and kept us smiling the entire time.

Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Miami. Great food, great vibes, and ask for Ramona if you can — she’ll make your meal unforgettable! 🍤🌴

author: Rodney-James
review_text:
We got a prompt greeting
All food came out hot.
App
Calamari
Came Crispy. A bit bland though. Some fried peppers come mixed in as well. Comes with two sauces. Marinara an spicy aioli. App isn’t terrible.
Entree
Baby back ribs
This was full rack
Ribs were falling off the bone.
Alabama Chicken linguine
Tatstes like a creamy scampi. Alfredo and scampi. This location in Miami did not charge a 20% percent gratuity.

author: Özge Evlek
review_text: I don’t know how I missed this place before! It was my first time at Bubba Gump, and I enjoyed every single moment and every bite of food. Everything was delicious—even my son, who is very picky, ate everything! We loved the classic shrimp plate, ribs, mac & cheese, and the crab sandwiches. And the mojitos… OMG, they were amazing! This will definitely be my go-to spot for daytime lunches. Highly recommend!

author: Piotr Treter
review_text: A must-visit for Forrest Gump fans, but also for those who appreciate great food. The dishes served are truly delicious, which, combined with the surrounding Bubba Gump atmosphere, creates something incredible. This place captivated us, wow. I recommend a visit; it's truly worth it ❤️

author: Joshua C Bonifas
review_text:
I recently dined at [Restaurant Name], and I have to say, the service was truly exceptional. The staff was attentive and always made sure we had everything we needed, checking in frequently without being intrusive. It really enhanced the dining experience.

As for the food, it was decent but didn’t quite meet my expectations. While the flavors were good, some dishes felt a bit underwhelming compared to the high standard set by the service.

Overall, I would recommend this place for its outstanding service, but I hope they can elevate their menu to match the quality of their hospitality. I look forward to seeing how they improve in the future!

author: Mark
review_text:
The food was amazing.  As you see from my shrimp salad.  The only issue was service.  That could be attributed to low staff and the tempo of the crowd.
I still highly recommend this place.

I‘ve been to many locations and this bayside/downtown Miami Restaurant was no disappointment! It was exactly what I wanted. Good food, good service and an ok price. Overall, worth the visit!

author: Brad Paradis
review_text: We snuck into the Bubba Gump Shrimp company for dinner while in downtown Miami.  It was really great.  The staff was attentive and amazing and we loved the Forests Gump trivia challenge amongst tables while waiting for your food. We won too!

review_text: Had an excellent meal here. Ramona served us and she was lovely, walked us through the basics and made sure we were catered to. Ordered the shrimp and crab boil, man was it so good. author: Danny Woodson
review_text: Walking by on our way back to the hotel and saw bubba gump shrimp (a restaurant I’ve ALWAYS wanted to eat at). But as we walked by we saw a bartender with an amazing vibe!  His energy was pulsing and we couldn’t pass it by!  His name is Juan P!!!  He was SUPER friendly and had such an amazing and outgoing personality that we just had to stop for a drink and conversation.  All we can say is WOW!  The vibe, the atmosphere and his awesome personality really made such a huge impact on us!  We highly recommend this restaurant AND a drink especially if it’s from Juan P! author: Manuel Gonzalez
review_text: This Subway in downtown Miami is a solid choice; the shop is always clean and the service is consistently fast. The manager, Kenya, is great and runs the place really efficiently, making sure everyone is taken care of quickly. It’s my go-to spot for a reliable meal, especially since the delivery is always so prompt.

author: Marcus Johnson
review_text:
I’ve stopped by this location a handful of times now, and honestly, every visit feels like a coin toss. Some days things go smoothly, and other days you walk out wondering why you bothered stopping at all. It’s really one of those hit-or-miss places.
The good first:
The store looks pretty clean most of the time, and the downtown location is convenient if you’re already in the area running errands. When the right staff is on shift, the service can actually be decent.

I’ve had one or two employees who were friendly, patient, and moved things along as best as they could. And when the food is fresh, the subs are exactly what you’d expect nothing fancy, but good enough for a quick bite.

But here’s where the place loses me: the service is wildly inconsistent. There are days when the employees look completely checked out, chatting among themselves while customers stand waiting at the counter. I get that fast food can be stressful, but sometimes the attitude is just unnecessary.

I’ve also had a couple of moments where I had to repeat my order multiple times because the person making the sandwich just wasn’t paying attention.

Another issue is the closing hours they really need to update the times or stick to what’s posted. A few times I’ve arrived well before closing, only to find the doors locked or the employees already cleaning up and refusing to take an order. It’s frustrating, especially when you walk there thinking you’ll grab something quick.

Food availability is also inconsistent. One visit they told me they were out of tomatoes, another time out of a specific bread, and once the cookies tasted like they’d been sitting out for days. It’s pretty obvious when something hasn’t been rotated or baked fresh.

Overall, I keep hoping the place will improve because the location is convenient, but it feels like management really needs to step up better training, better communication, and just a bit more pride in the service. I wouldn’t say “never go,” but definitely go knowing your experience might depend on who’s working that day.

If they could just tighten up the service and stick to their posted hours, this spot could easily be a reliable go-to. For now, it’s a solid “it’ll do if you’re nearby,” but not somewhere I’d go out of my way for.

author: Coy Swint
review_text:

She pretended to be busy and didn't even look towards the counter. This has happened before with me as well as other customers.

Perhaps another training course on customer service can correct this behavior.

My rotisserie chicken foot long sub was delicious.

This store has a lot of potential, so hopefully, they can improve in this area.

Two horrible experiences in a row. This place needs to be closed.
On my first visit, they said they couldn't accept the coupon that I had because the machine that scans the coupons was broken. The manager got defensive as if this were my fault. I hesitantly accepted and paid full price anyways.
After about 2 months on February 22nd, I decided to give it another try (THIS TIME without coupons) and upon check out they said that the Tuna Sandwich (FOOTLONG only, not the meal) went from $9.99 to almost $15.00. I asked the manager why prices on the menu haven't been updated and she decided to start yelling, saying she couldn't do anything because it was a system thing. She simply took the sandwich from my hand, threw it in the trash bin and started to be verbally aggressive towards me. I feel like the machine being broken is a lie and they try to charge customers more.
TERRIBLE SERVICE. TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE. SUBWAY, CLOSE THIS LOCATION SINCE IT'S NOT DOING ANY GOOD FOR YOUR BRAND!

author: Francisco Casal
review_text: They overcharge every time and claim their system doesn’t let them charge the right amount.  They claim they can’t use the simple menu, so they select a ready made sandwich with a higher price than what you actually order.  Adds 15% to the price.

author: alaska harston
review_text:
DEAR OWNER OF THIS STORE
You better be paying these people extra to work in that heat!

author: Gleryca Perea
review_text: They closed 20 minutes early and we literally wanted cookies they were going to throw them out anyways. If I could give them a 0 I would bad Service she ignored us and Started mopping in front of the door saying she is not going to open they closed AT 10 but we go there at 9:40 and they didn't let us in.

author: Ivan Ramirez
review_text: The service I received today in this subway is unacceptable. Salad was nothing near what I wanted. Portions are not good. The lady that attended me was rude and with a lack of courtesy. I'm not coming back to this place. Period.

author: Lisa Matos
review_text: I work across the street and I came across this location decided to come in before my shift in the morning will I was the only customer there the women did not greet me after I stood there for about 8 mins straight while she set up her station when she was done doing her sit up she decided to acknowledge me finally gives me a blank stare so I can give her my order even after I order and paid she still did not say a work to me and I know she wasn't a minute cause she was having a full conversation with her coworker while making my order I work as a waitress one of the most important things we do is greet and make customer feel welcome as soon as they step in the fact that this women felt the need to be so rude as to ignore me in such a nasty way I will not be coming back the sandwich was good but the service was horrible

author: Liz Miniel
review_text: The food was fine, but they charged me for the wrong sandwich, even after I clarified I wanted a different one.

author: Agustin Tirado
review_text: I went at 8:44 pm today and they didn’t have any meat to make any sandwich? I mean

author: youcef ould
review_text: No Language , very  rude , uneducated staff , I wish i could select below 0 star!

author: Cassandra Strozier
review_text: The subway downtown it's sad they never have 2 things to match 😕 they wait to prepare the sub then say we don't have onions no tomatoes 1 kind of bread I never go there again

author: Curtis S
review_text:
The young woman working the counter made this visit extremely uncomfortable. She was rude and dismissive from the beginning, and her attitude made it feel like I was an inconvenience for simply ordering food. There was no greeting, no patience, and no basic customer service.

On top of that, communication was a problem. It was genuinely hard to tell if she understood English, because she barely responded, didn’t acknowledge questions clearly, and seemed irritated when I tried to clarify my order. If you’re working directly with customers, clear communication and professionalism are the bare minimum—and neither was present here.

This employee single-handedly ruined the experience. I won’t be returning unless management addresses how customers are treated.

author: killian aperce
review_text:
The food was good, but the staff were very unpleasant, condescending, and barely spoke English.

I recommend walking an extra 5 minutes to eat somewhere else.

author: Victoria Prokopovych
review_text: I really loved this place! We had breakfast inside, but there are also plenty of cozy tables outside in the backyard. The atmosphere was great and the service was excellent,  the staff were very friendly and welcoming. We ordered the avo toast, PLT croissant, and Dubai latte, and everything was delicious. Highly recommend!

author: Riadh Said
review_text:
I was really impressed by the reviews before trying this brunch place, so my expectations were high. I ordered the avocado toast with extra salmon and, given the price (around $30), I was expecting something more refined.

The sourdough bread was excellent & crunchy on the outside and fluffy inside. However, the avocado was overly mashed and tasted very similar to the small pre-made guacamole cups from Costco. The egg was also disappointing, it felt like a standard machine-boiled egg, similar to what you’d get at McDonald’s or Tim Hortons, rather than something house-made or authentic. The side salad was another letdown as the dressing was very watery, as you can see in the picture, which took away from the overall freshness.

On a positive note, the salmon was good, and the service and atmosphere were both great. Overall, a pleasant experience, but the food didn’t quite live up to the price or the hype.

author: Emma Lopez-Ponnada
review_text: Enjoyed my lunch here. Belen was a very nice server. They have a $19 lunch special. 1 protein, 2 sides, soup, & a coffee. I chose lamb kofta (juicy), humus, and salad. We also tried two delicious pastries: orange pound cake & spicy beef sfiha (also juicy). They do charge an automatic 18% service charge when you eat in & ask if you want to leave tip on top of that when you check out.

author: Carlos “Carlos H Mencia” Mencia
review_text: Place is a great quaint cafe I got breakfast in. Food was excellent along with the service and ambience.  Definitely recommend going here if you want to have a good breakfast. My server Fabriccio was excellent server making sure food was on time and we were always comfortable. He was also not intrusive just checking the right amount of times.

author: Kim Cano
review_text: I tried Bobe yesterday with some girlfriends as I found in on TikTok and unfortunately I would have to say it was an ok place to eat. My server was super sweet and friendly and very accommodating to any allergies i had. The decor on the inside is super cute but unfortunately we are here for the food but why I’m giving 3 stars is because the food does lack in flavor unfortunately and so do the drinks. I wouldn’t be back but I will say the vibe is cute but as far as for the food and drinks * I had a strawberry matcha latte * you’re not missing out on anything and they’re are better places nearby that are so much more flavorful in their food.

author: Shannon Lee
review_text: First day in Miami and we stumbled on such a gem! Love the whimsical decor inside! The shakshuka was so hearty and the lox bagel was perfect! Belen was our waitress and she made sure we had everything we needed. Can’t wait to come back tomorrow!

author: Cathy Dang
review_text: Such a cute establishment with so much seating! Both indoor and outdoor. Great assortment of food and drinks. Service was excellent. Only thing I didn’t appreciate was that the photos of the grandmas on the wall Were so clearly AI generated. Would have loved to see real family photos or real grandmas. But that’s not enough to Derail my review from being a five star regardless.

author: Raquel Hokett
review_text: My sister and I were in town for a concert and were staying at the Port of Miami Holiday Inn. This little café/bakery was right behind the building! I could not stop stating how damn cute and fabulous this place was, the instant I walked in. They have a little gift shop where you can get shirts, cups, and little knick knacks. Too pricey for me (coffee mug in the $25-$30 range) but I understand it’s a small business thing. The items were seemingly well crafted and adorable! The atmosphere was very cutesy and welcoming and I just wish there was a place like this where I live. I would literally WALK there every day! We had a chocolate muffin and a hazelnut filled croissant which were out of this world. I had asked if I could  get an iced vanilla latte with oat milk (was not on the menu) and the barista told me he could make me anything I wanted. Those three items cost $20. I was delighted to see that they actually serve lunch/dinner items and regret not going back. I heavily contemplated only eating from this place for our entire weekend stay! It really is that good. Reminded me of the bakeries in Italy. I actually thought all of the food on display was fake. Like when you go into Starbucks or something. But it is REAL! My croissant and my sister’s muffin was plucked right from the display window! Highly recommend! You will NOT be disappointed. We got our food to go and I was just praising my coffee the entire time I took a sip. Best coffee I have EVER had made. So creamy and flavorful and not bitter or too sweet. Just perfect.

author: A Viz
review_text:
The food is out of this world. The service is amazing. The atmosphere is way beyond what we expected. Can't believe that we have not visited this place before. Will definitely come here again.  You can't go wrong with anything on the menu.
Camila was our waitress and she was AMAZING.

author: Dominique Guirand
review_text: Efereń was amazing, he helped me through and through and even helped me charge my computer while attending to busy guests. I got the beef kebab and it was 10/10 — also the matcha was amazing. Def a great study spot.

author: Mahesh choppa
review_text: Such a delightful experience! The shakshuka was rich and flavorful, and the pistachio affogato was exceptional. The complimentary pistachio tart was a lovely touch. Warm service, lovely staff, relaxing atmosphere — I left feeling genuinely happy. Highly recommend! 🌿

author: Logen Willey
review_text: My friends and I wanted to try a cute little place for a delicious breakfast and that’s exactly what we got. I couldn’t decide because everything sounded so good but I chose French toast and a caramel frappe. I was not disappointed. The atmosphere is very aesthetic and pleasing and a fun place to go with friends. I would come again for sure !

author: Ayleen Trindade
review_text: I’ve been here twice in one week and it’s just so good. You get the great service, tasty food, good coffee, and the pink aesthetics. Thank you Valentina & Annabelle! You ladies are so hospitable! 10/10 recommend

author: Edonore
review_text:
Loved the vibe at Bobe Kitchen & Bakery. The black coffee hit just right — smooth and strong, without being too bitter. Tried the “Dubai Style” croissant and some Danish pastries and everything tasted incredibly fresh and flavorful.

Sandra, who was working that day, was the sweetest. Super kind and attentive. Definitely one of those little spots you remember. 🥰

author: m caparra
review_text: Amazing! The food, the people, the atmosphere are all amazing. The rose and white chocolate coffee and any of the PLT sandwich were chef's kiss. I will miss this place and will definitely come back to Miami just for Bobe!

author: Richard
review_text: Great breakfast restaurant with fast and corteous service! Camila was very nice! Definitely a recommendation!

author: Cassius Clay
review_text: Bobe Kitchen & Bakery is incredible! The environment is really cool with such a creative design that makes you want to stay and enjoy. The staff were so friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. I ordered a pizza and a latte through Uber Eats and both were delicious. Everything on the menu looked amazing, so I definitely want to come back to sit down and try more. Highly recommend this spot!

author: Henry
review_text: Friendly bakery / coffee shop. Enjoyed a lovely Salmon bagel breakfast as well as coffee and some of their pasties. Good to see stuff being baked in front of your eyes.

author: Natasha Zeba
review_text: Special thanks to Carolina and Camila for making my birthday super special! Very friendly staff and amazing atmosphere. Muchas gracias. This is one of the best bakeries ever. I went there for some coffee and cake and guess what! Someone ended up paying for my treats.

author: Ale P
review_text: Service was great and the place is beautiful. We had an iced pistachio latte and iced almond milk latte with the omelette and banana cake. The service was excellent and very attentive. We got are food pretty quick!

author: {Michie-Bea}
review_text: One of my absolute favorite places to go nearly everyday! Highly recommend. Very pretty place with the best hot chocolate for blocks. Amazing orange juice and amazing eggs. Absolutely try the French toast as well!

author: Laura Jeraci
review_text: came for a quick breakfast / brunch before heading on my flight. ordered a hot coffee with milk, got no milk. asked for milk, was met with confusion and given like half a shot of it. whatever no big deal, some places use creamer mainly. we ordered a waffle and eggs benedict. the eggs Benedict came with balsamic glaze on it?? not sure why but that's not usually a dish that needs acidity. and the waffle was "like cardboard, no flavor" according to my friend. i guess i was expecting more for it being near so many hotels and the ports. if you need a quick bite go for it, but don't expect too much.

author: Alan Staton
review_text:
Lovely local cafe, we past it a few times on our walks to and from the hotel so we went in on our last 2 mornings for breakfast.

You order and pay at the till, then take a seat. The decor is lovley, all neon signs and plants, theres a few TV screens but they were just showing a screensaver.

The food was excellent and set us up for the day, think we skipped dinner we were that full.

Crispy bacon and maple syrup is so nice. Infact thats why we went back a second time.

author: Janardhan MP
review_text:
Very poor service and waited close to 1 hour. Totally understaffed and no proper response either from the staff. When ordered they mentioned it will be 20 mins but ended up waiting 1 hour. We had kids who were hungry and asked to expedite and all we got is sorry. Definitely not recommending the restaurant as the staff need to be trained on customer service.

Chocolate chip cookie was mentioned as 50 cents in the menu but was charged $2.79. We did ask about the cookie before ordering and was misguided. When asked about this all we got is just sorry again.

author: Celio Centeno
review_text:
The food was good. And the service too.
They serve a lot, so have this in mind when you order.

author: Bob Job
review_text:
Cafe Papillon has great food, but unfortunately the service really fell short. After paying, we asked for milk in one of the coffees and never received it. The Turkish coffee also wasn’t prepared properly.

When we were seated, the table hadn’t been cleaned, there was still a bit of a mess on it and we had to call the server back to wipe it down. The space itself is very small and tightly packed, with chairs and tables extremely close together, which made it uncomfortable.

On top of that, some of the staff came off with an attitude. I understand early mornings can be rough, but it still affects the experience. Overall, while the food was good, the poor service and lack of attention made it disappointing. Wouldn’t recommend.

author: DiM 1
review_text: Place is small inside, but there's some seats outside. Servers are very relaxed. Need to speak slowly and confirm your order. Food is really good they rush so make sure your potatoes are fully cooked. The Cuban coffee is BANGING! great! They make fresh OJ. French toast is great as well.

author: Perica Milicev
review_text:
Very small place, just 4/5 tables inside available, but the location is good. No free parking around, so you gotta park on the spot which is $5 per hour.
The service was quick and no much hassle. We liked fresh squeezed juices which were delicious but the food was just mediocre, not too much taste and flavour, just a basic experience which i think wasn’t worth for the price we paid for it.
If you want a nice coffee or fresh squeezed juice while walking around downtown, this is a good place for it.

author: Antonionia “Marie”
review_text: $4 champagne $6 bellinis cant beat that. Nice big breakfast portions cant beat the price for the amount of food. Nice ambiance. Super soft baguettes. Tasty french toast. I enjoyed my meal. The food compared to the price, location and ambiance is unbeatable.

author: Tiago França
review_text:
Man, I gotta tell you…
What an amazing breakfast!!!
I’ve had the “Papillon Special Omelette” with a fresh and real sweet orange juice.
Absolutely divine. It’s a well deserved place to visit and enjoy the low back playlist and “zen” environment.

author: Daniela Bárbara Martínez Ramos
review_text: I love the food at this place — one of the best breakfasts I’ve had in Downtown Miami.

author: Lea Flego
review_text: Unmarked missing items from the menu. Food is mediocre. Drinks from the fridge not cold. Rude service when asked to correct an order. Decor is cute, but seating is awkward. Surprised at this place having such a high rating on Trip Advisor. Wouldn’t come back.

author: Hannah Marymarie
review_text: This is the cutest little breakfast place we have been to on vacation so far! The inside is instagram worthy vibes with plenty of photo opportunities! My only complaint thus far is we couldn't sit inside to eat because it was so hot! It could be tolerable but not comfortable.

author: Amanda Antonino
review_text: This place is terrible. The service sucked. We all got our food at a different time. They sold one of our meals to someone else and told us it was gonna be 30 to 45 minute wait for them to make it again after we’ve already been here for an hour. Don’t waste your money go somewhere else.

author: Yazmin Bu
review_text: I definitely adored this place! The food was amazing and prices were very affordable. The service was great, friendly staff that make you feel at home. I had brunch with friends after taking a walk and it was definitely a lovely way to finish our morning. Excellent atmosphere with beautiful decoration and great choice of music to complement an ample variety of delicious plates!! I recommend the Dulce de Leche Croissant waffle 😄

author: Geneva Williams
review_text: So me and my guy wanted some breakfast while in Miami we came across Cafe Papillon the pictures outside the door looked great and I glanced at some of the plates through the window they looked great so we decided to go in . We had to order at the register and pay before we ate ok didn't like that we found a table sooo presentation is everything to me and when she brought the breakfast out I looked at my eggs which supposed to be egg whites but the were gray the cook either burnt the butter or just didn't care what was going into my bowl the food wasn't good it seemed like they just threw it on the cutting board and served it to us . But I was really upset when I seen the gentleman on the side of us platter was perfect looked just the picture. They treat us tourists any kind of way and their own like a celebrity which I don't like.. Sorry I'm giving you guys a thumbs 👎 👎👎👎.

author: Camila García Varas
review_text:
Best brunch in town!  Delicious & Good pricing.
Definitely coming back!

author: Bonnie Harrell
review_text: Within walking distance from our hotel, the Cafe Papillon provided so many options to choose from for Breakfast. I chose the Magda’s combo breakfast with eggs over medium.
