The eggs were not too oily or buttery or salty. The bacon was also not very salty or greasy. The French toast was the perfect way to end the meal on a sweeter note. Coffee was great, as was the cappuccino.

author: W. V. F.
review_text: Nice breakfast place, great food and a lot of it. Coffee is  good too, and the orange juice is fresh pressed. Prices are not much more than a fast food breakfast at Denny’s,  so for the location I can highly recommend it.

author: OB
review_text: Food looked pretty good when it came out. Everything tasted ok in the end, it was just lacking a bit. Staff thought it was a good idea to give us plastic forks and knives to cut steak. Had to ask 4 times and wait 20 minutes before we got it. Service was worse. It really felt like none of the staff members wanted to be there.

author: Mehul Behar
review_text:
Tried Ben’s Pizza at Bayside, Miami and it was great! We had two slices and loved them.
Fresh, flavorful, and satisfying. Perfect spot for a quick in-and-out bite with solid quality. Would definitely come back! 🍕✨

author: The Felix show 1
review_text:
Ben’s Pizza at Bayside is proof that joy can still exist while the world slowly collapses.
The pizza? Genuinely great. Like, “sit in silence and rethink your life choices while chewing” great. Crispy, cheesy, zero regrets. If this was my last meal, I’d be at peace.
The view is the real plot twist. You’re eating pizza while staring at boats floating peacefully in the ocean, pretending you’re not one bad decision away from selling everything and disappearing onto one of them. Sun, water, yachts, and existential dread—beautiful combo.
Perfect spot to eat excellent pizza, watch rich people glide by, and briefly wonder where things went wrong… before ordering another slice.
Would absolutely return. 🍕🚤

author: Glory T
review_text:
I love Ben’s Pizza and usually go to the one by the water, but since I noticed it was the same brand, I decided to try the one in front of Bayside. I bought two slices, and they charged me an extra dollar for a box — without telling me that the charge was optional and that I could’ve just gotten a plate for free.

When I asked why they didn’t mention this, they had no real explanation. I asked for a refund for the box since I didn’t need it, but they refused. The young lady who gave me the pizza, Lizzie, didn’t really help — she barely spoke English, which made it difficult to communicate. This is surprising for a tourist-heavy area like Bayside.

I also spoke with the manager, Joel. He apologized but said there was nothing he could do about the charge. It’s disappointing since I expected better service from a place under the Ben’s Pizza name.

Beware of extra charges on your receipt — always ask for your receipt and review it carefully before paying.

author: Jonathan Zapata
review_text:
I was looking for pizza near the Bayfront Park area, and my friend recommended Bens Pizza.

Bens Pizza is a casual spot right with waterfront views. I first ordered the veggie slice, complete with zucchini, yellow and red bell peppers, and eggplant. Truthfully, I was not expecting much because of the proximity to all the tourist spots.

I was surprised at the great quality and went back for seconds: a classic cheese slice. But here's the breakdown:

I thought the toppings were distributed well. It was just the right amount - but I did wish the eggplant was a little more fresh. It was dry.

The cheese is a very thin layer, as well as the sauce. I love a saucy pizza, but I understand the light sauce is a compromise in order to make the thin crust possible.

The highlight of Bens Pizza is definitely the crust. It's carefully calculated to be thin, fold with ease, and yet has that nice crunch to it in the right spots. See photo and you'll know what I mean. Great ode to New York style pizza.

Pricing seems what you would expect to pay because of the proximity to the waterfront/ action. The slices are big - they cut mine into two smaller slices. I would definitely come back next time I'm in Miami! Thanks, guys.

author: Heather Li
review_text: My husband and I popped over to Ben's Pizza after arriving late in Miami Beach. They were open late - thankfully. Ben's Pizza hit the spot. The slices were enormous and very tasty. I got a slice of pepperoni (which of course I didn't take a picture of  🤦🏻‍♀️). The pepperoni was so good. You can tell it's not super processed like a lot of pepperoni. One slice was more than enough. This little pizza stand is cute and  totally worthy of a late night pop by.

author: Ignacio Larrea
review_text:
Stopped by Ben’s Pizza in Bayside for the first time — and wow. The slices are legit: super fresh, perfect crust, and full of flavor. The staff was all smiles, and you could tell the chef takes real pride in his work — his whole station was spotless and dialed in.

I was so impressed that we’re planning to use Ben’s for our end-of-the-year swim team party. I’ll be back for sure! 🍕🔥

author: Leah Johnson
review_text: This is a great pizza by the slice spot! I loved that you could order at a kiosk and the quality was great. The lady who gave us the pizza was very kind and friendly. Pizza came out warm and was delicious. I got the meat lovers slice. The pricing is high when you think of pizza by the slice but it’s a GIANT slice (really 2 slices and they divide it for you). I would recommend if you’re looking for a quick slice of pizza that tastes good.

author: Mike Vavosa
review_text: Amazing pizza! 2 huge slices is "1 slice" so good!!! Staff were so friendly!

author: Alicia Velasquez
review_text: Joelle was very attentive and the pizza smell drew us in like moths to a flame. The taste was even better than I thought it would be.

author: George Fine
review_text:
We were on a trip to Miami, and coming from NYC, we know a thing or 2 about pizza.

We ordered the fresh moz slice, and the flavors were on par, the only ding was that it was a tad undercooked, but all in all, pretty good.

Also, their concept of a slice, is really 2 slices here in NYC.
They call a quarter of a pie 1 slice and they cut it into 2 slices, a bit odd, but no biggie.

author: Stephanie
review_text: Best pizza ive had in a long time! 1 slice is actually 2 and they were HUGE and so yummy

author: Francesca
review_text:
Delicious Classic Slice!

I had a classic Margherita slice and it was really good! Thin crust, flavorful sauce (thankfully not ketchup-like), and just the right amount of cheese. You can add oregano and Parmesan on top, which made it even better. For $5, it’s definitely worth it. Simple, tasty, and satisfying – exactly what a good slice should be.

author: Stephanie O
review_text: First of all the slices are HUGE ! The pizza is nice and thin but full of flavor with a good size crust (I like crust). We stopped by the location inside of bayside while walking around. Location is great they actually have two one by the water and another one as soon as you get into bayside.

author: German
review_text: Over priced low quality pizza,and they charge extra if you take the slice to go. Not to mention staff is unprofessional and rude. Only reason this place survives is cause of the tourist who dont know any better, there are way better pizza spots around the corner.

author: Ankur Jajodia
review_text: We ordered margherita and cheese slices. The pizza was good and portion size was great for the price. They should add more vegetarian and chicken options though.

author: Aaron Gonzalez
review_text: Pizza is very good but my 2 cents is the slices are too big one slice equals 2 normal slices. Would make more sense to charge 50% less and just serve normal sized slices. I got a cheese and a pepperoni but had to throw out the other two slices

author: Lisa Valle
review_text: My husband and I love to eat pizza here but encountered a disappointing moment as we went back to find a slice is no longer bigger like before.  We asked girl she said they changed the formula. Lol what ever that means but the price is still the same  too over priced

author: Alexis Velasquez
review_text: Quick service and delicious 😋 Joel was awesome! Thanks Ben's for great food!

author: Mario Gómez
review_text: Went to try it out with my family as a first time, we were all disappointed, the quality of the pizza wasn’t the best and for it to be categorized as “New york style” is way off. Also cashier Valeria didn’t give the best service just to top it off, i think owners should know who they hire to provide a representation of their business.

author: Maday D
review_text: Pizza is thin but “one slice” is two slices of pizza. Considering the thinness, it’s still very tasty. I recommend trying them out if you’re in the area. They were pretty busy when I went but they were quick in getting the orders out.

author: Nicole from HBCU 20x20
review_text:
La Industria Bakery & Cafe has the best food in Miami, and I stand on that.

We stumbled in while walking through Bayside before a boat ride and ended up eating here twice in one day. For breakfast, my husband had La Combi Completa and couldn’t stop talking about how fresh everything tasted. I had the Chicken Bacon Waffle Sandwich and it was perfect.

And their bacon? The best I’ve ever had. Forget millionaire bacon elsewhere.

We later skipped a dinner reservation at the former Versace Mansion just to come back. I had the ribs (fall-off-the-bone amazing), my husband had the La Boricua Burger, and we tried a Venezuelan empanada out of curiosity… unreal.

Best empanada I’ve ever had. We actually risked missing our flight to have 2 to made to go.

Amazing food, kind servers, attentive managers, great ambiance.

Believe the hype.

10/10.

author: Melissa Texidor
review_text:
My Husband and I are Holiday for the holidays and our very first dining experience in Miami… La Industria.
LA COMBI COMPLETA had the best of everything on one dish. He began eating before I got the full pic. I ordered NICKY JAM'S FAVORITE -Guava marmalade, cream cheese frosting, graham cracker crumbs served … both AMAZING!! Service was great and even my take home bag was a surprise❤️
with a guava and cheese pastry

author: Mario Flores
review_text:
We traveled into Miami for a convention and arrived early, so we stopped at Nicky Jam’s La Industria Bakery & Café for breakfast. It definitely has an interesting vibe, but it felt like it was missing a few atmosphere elements that would have elevated it into a high-end spot.

The food was excellent — I ordered La Combi Completa with the Strawberry Cheesecake topping, and it even came with a slice of cheesecake, which was a great surprise. The coffee was strong and just what I needed for a morning pick-me-up.

Overall, good food and good start to the day — with a little more attention to the ambiance, this place could really stand out even more. Worth a visit if you’re in the area early and hungry!

author: Miguel Alvarez
review_text:
The Boricua Burger at La Industria had great potential the flavors were there, but the arepa was served cold and could’ve used a creamy sauce to tie everything together. Our server seemed distracted and missed two of our items, which took away from the experience. When it came time to pay, she mentioned that a 20% tip was already included, and seemed upset when I didn’t add more that was uncomfortable.

The milkshakes were beautifully presented but a bit overpriced and not as sweet as expected. Overall, the atmosphere and concept are nice, but there’s definitely room for improvement in both service and food consistency.

Overall I would not recommend or return!

author: Arihant Paruchuru
review_text: We ordered cheese arepas, fries, and a guava marmalade waffle, and every item was disappointing. The waffle had no noticeable cream at all—only the bland taste of the waffle itself. None of the food stood out in a good way, and honestly, the only thing worth consuming was the water. Overall, a very underwhelming experience.

author: m daniels
review_text:
Great Vibes, Overwhelming Portions
The vibes at this brunch spot were absolutely amazing—stylish atmosphere, great music, and a fun crowd. However, the food itself was just okay. What really stood out (and not necessarily in a good way) were the portion sizes. Each dish easily serves about four people, which might be great for those with a big appetite, but as someone with a smaller stature, it felt overwhelming. I ended up wasting a lot of food, which was disappointing. I wouldn’t recommend this place unless you're coming hungry or planning to share.

author: Gissella Lightsey
review_text:
Loved the food, loved the environment.

The lady who served us was very attentive, polite, nice and gracious. Her name was Carolina . We were blessed to have her.

We were party of 3. We. shared some ribs, blue cheese burger 🍔, empanadas and some frappes ..
We enjoyed what we had

The ribs was about $30ish (I think)
The blue cheese burger $22
Each empanada about $6
The frappes $14.99 each

We had an awesome time.
20% tip was included in the bill and after that you have the option to tip 3, 5, or 7% more .

author: Celio Centeno
review_text:
The food was good. The service was good too.
Be advice that they serve a lot of food.
We order "la convi completa" and we ate two out of it. The "arepas were really good too".

author: Michal Berkovich
review_text:
Great spot next to Bayside Marketplace!
Excellent coffee and desserts, with friendly and attentive service. Perfect place to grab something to eat before or after a boat tour at Bayside in Miami. Highly recommended!

author: Shandreka Hall
review_text:
Brunch at this upscale gem was everything I didn’t know I needed! From the moment we walked in, the vibes were immaculate — the decor is stunning and absolutely perfect for photo ops. Every corner feels curated for both comfort and aesthetics.

The food? Delicious with impressively large portions that left us full and happy. Every dish was seasoned perfectly and beautifully presented.

What really made the experience unforgettable was the service. Carolina was our waitress and she was phenomenal — attentive, kind, and incredibly professional. The entire staff worked like a well-oiled machine. If we had a dirty dish or napkin on the table, it was gone within seconds. Our table was kept spotless the entire time, which really elevated the dining experience.

author: Yachai Reilly
review_text: I am obsessed with mofongos, so it was a must to stop here for brunch. Love the bayside market area. So much to do. Brunch was great. Gets very busy & is so much fun!

author: Adibe Garces
review_text: The food was presented beautifully and tasted delicious. Dayanara was so kind and friendly, she made us feel so welcome. Everyone had wonderful customer service. And the ambiance was increíble! I will definitely come back next time I’m in Miami!

author: Julianna Diaz
review_text: Nicki Jam's restaurant. I thought the whole time I was going to see Puerto Rican food, but to be honest, I think it's more Venezuelan food. It's very tasty. The arepitas with cheese are delicious, and the arepa with beef is delicious. Everything was great. It's best to make a reservation, especially if it's the weekend, because there's usually a wait time.

author: Sarah Devereaux
review_text: Such a relaxing space to share breakfast on our last day in Miami! Food was truly exceptional, from the maple bacon French toast all the way down to a simple, plain arepa. Coffee was awesome, and service was also fantastic. This will be a new tradition during our annual Miami trip! Thanks to the staff and chef!

author: SUNSHYNE315
review_text: First time here and I was so impressed...The food was excellent. My server Dayanara was amazing. Very friendly and accommodating.  Thank you!

author: Gavin Peterson
review_text:
Had outdoor seating for a quick bite. Or indoor seating for a more dedicated experience.

10/10 staff. Music was upbeat and kept the mood lively.

The food was fantastic.

Service charge is a part of the meal.

It was a bit pricy, but some of the best breakfast items I've ever had. Definitely worth it.

author: Mursal Guliyev
review_text: I had a great experience at La Industria. The atmosphere was vibrant and stylish, with great music and decor. The food was fresh and flavorful.The staff was friendly and attentive, and everything came out quickly. Definitely a great spot for a casual lunch or a fun dinner with friends. I’ll be coming back soon!

author: Tiffany Morales
review_text:
Worth Every Bite!

From the moment we walked in, this restaurant impressed on every level. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, but it was the exceptional staff who truly set the tone for the afternoon. Friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do—they made us feel like VIPs from start to finish. Our server Evelyn was superb!!

Now, the food? Absolutely phenomenal. Every dish was a masterpiece bursting with flavor. The ingredients were clearly fresh and thoughtfully combined—each bite felt like a celebration. Whether it was the perfectly seasoned appetizers, the beautifully presented main courses, or the decorative coffees, everything was cooked to perfection.

This place is a shining example of what great dining should be: delicious food, outstanding service, and a memorable experience. We’re already planning our next visit!

author: Chloe
review_text: Perfect spot for those Instagram 🤭 worthy pancake shots 📸🥞 The pancakes were yummy, but the toast with whipped cream was definitely the winner for me 😋🍞💛

author: Filip Świercz
review_text: Thanks to Susana, I’m giving this place 5 stars. I met the manager(probably), and he wanted to serve my coffee in a paper cup because of some rule. Honestly, if it wasn’t for Susana, I would have left a negative review — when you pay over $4 for a coffee, you don’t expect to drink it like it’s from a vending machine. Luckily, Susana really cares about the restaurant’s good reputation and made sure I had a great experience.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Yongkwan Song
review_text:
I ordered delivery through Uber Eats to my hotel, and tried the USDA Prime Beef Picada. The portion was reasonable, and overall the flavor was good. The best item was the Churrasco — the meat was tender, aromatic, and not tough at all. The only disappointing part was the Lomo (Prime Pork Loin). It was quite salty, so I couldn’t eat much of it.

If you don’t feel like going out but want to enjoy some meat in your room, I would recommend it. And if a full set feels too heavy, choosing individual cuts might be a better option.

The mashed potatoes and corn that I ordered on the side were also delicious — especially the mashed potatoes, which were extremely smooth with just the right seasoning.

One downside: I ordered twice from the hotel and asked for utensils both times, but none were ever included. Luckily, my hotel had utensils available, but if you’re staying somewhere without them, it could be quite inconvenient.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Clint MacLeod
review_text:
Really decent steak sandwich, comes with 3 mini dips - the hot sauce and chimichurri are excellent, didn’t try the third & includes a portion of chips. All for $16.

As a Scottish tourist here I did not expect that much of a bargain. Thoroughly worth a visit. Only downside is no seating - but it is a snack van so understandable.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Magdalena Velichkova
review_text: The food was soooooo delicious we ate until we couldn’t. The meat was professionally cooked and the sides with it were perfect. For these food we would have paid at least 200 dollars if we were on the bay side. AMAZING

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Ivo Salazar
review_text:
I am writing to formally express my deep disappointment regarding an order I received today from your Bayfront Park location. I ordered two pounds of meat, but what was delivered was approximately 90% fat and scraps, completely unfit to be served as food. I have photos and videos of the order to support my claim.

It is unacceptable and frankly a shame that whoever prepared and dispatched my order considered this quality of product acceptable. I have always enjoyed eating at your restaurant, but after this disastrous experience, I am left feeling deceived and frustrated. Out of a $50 order, the only thing I was able to eat was the $4 rice.

I strongly urge you to review the quality control at this location, as serving customers in this manner seriously damages trust in your brand. If you would like, I am willing to share the photos and videos of the order for your review.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Adolfo Cañamar
review_text: My first time in Miami FL, Came across this Food truck so I gave it a try & I didn't regret it! Came back the next day for more, the food was delicious! I got the lamb chops with corn on the cob & even a simple mashed potatoes was so amazing with a unique flavor . My wife had the lomo sándwiches & really enjoyed them. Great service, very friendly and the prices were very fair for the quality of the meats .. No tables but we walked to the front to the pier & u can enjoy it there or have a picnic on the grass anywhere .. Highly recommended it ..

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Audric strongestkarate
review_text: Good quality of meat. Cooked well. Right amount of seasoning. Friendly staffs. But no tables to eat. Try them out. Servings are huge too.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: INQUSE GENERAL CONTRACTOR
review_text:
I stopped by this food truck, and I can confidently say it has nothing to envy from the big steakhouses.

The quality of the meat cuts is simply outstanding—perfectly cooked and full of flavor.

The service was incredible, with friendly and attentive staff that made the experience even better.

Definitely a highly recommended spot for true meat lovers.

A solid 10/10!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Gary Floyd
review_text: The menu pictured on the side of the truck looked amazing, but the actual food we received was the exact opposite. Bacon wrapped chicken was as dry and tough as could be, pork tacos were dry as could be. The portions were definitely not as pictured on the menu. We walked by the truck several times and never saw any customers. Makes sense now.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Rocky Ali
review_text:
I went twice, the first time I got the steak sandwich and was great. The 2nd time I took my wife, we got the steak sandwich again w churrasco and an order of lamb chops

We both got extreme food poisoning. Would not recommend, at least not the food truck.

Dont even want to bother with the restaurant if they cant keep their food truck to safely handle food

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Andrija Milinkovic
review_text: This place is amazing I loved the food and the staff were so friendly and welcoming. I am amazed by the quality of the meats whole Miami should eat at this place!!🦾🍀

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Albert Martirosyan
review_text: the meat they put on the menu does not correspond to reality and the same weight dishes. the wait is very long. file mignon is the cheapest beef..

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Angel Travieso
review_text: THE WAITRESS WAS VERY CANDID IN EXPLAINING THE MENU AND RIPPED US OFF 2 PEOPLE A 179.00 PLATE . THAT IS JUST WRONG.... AND A 44.00 SERVICE FEE PLUS A TIP.... THAT IS WRONG. THE FOOD WAS UNDER COOKED WHEN ASKED WELL DONE. HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Jörg Baumeister
review_text: Lunch was fantastic. Highly recommended. Angus burger and chicken special with bacon. Very friendly service.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Shannon Jones
review_text: Smelled so good we had to try it!! We were not disappointed!! It’s very good!!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Izzy C
review_text: Don’t tell them the bacon wrapped chicken is dry like a cardboard, there is a blonde manager that will get mad and tell you that the chicken is normally very dry… 😅 we have been at this restaurant like 20 times last two visits not so good

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Sydney
review_text:
Paid never got food, gave me a beeper neber beeped, vibrated or anything came back less
Than a hour later they gone with my $60 and my food mind u im starving no dinner no refund nothing

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Lisa Bennett
review_text:
Amazing food! Ordered the picahna steak sandwich, it was sooo good! Great flavours and came with 3 different sauces which made it even better if that’s possible!
Fabulous service with a great smile from Antonieta, told us about the other locations of the restaurants and trucks. Make sure you try this in Miami, just the best ❤️

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Yovanna2 Pardo
review_text: Love the pican̈a sandwich.  Cravings for steak.  Great price . Buying another skirt sandwich for my coworker 😋

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Erick Morales
review_text: This spot is a must when you are in the area and are craving delicious steaks and burgers, very flavorful food. My favorite is the Picada with their delicious chimichurri sauce. And Let’s not forget, the great service I received from the staff.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Andres Yepez
review_text: THE BEST FOOD ON THE AREA!! What’s better than good food? Great service! The food was delicious, the environment was fun, and everyone was super friendly. I will return; thank you to the whole team for the great experience!

author: Jennifer Stewart
review_text: Great location! We sat outside to enjoy the view, people watch, and listen to music from nearby restaurants. Ernest was very attentive and had excellent suggestions for menu items to try out. Portions for the mains are generous- so bring a healthy appetite or get a to go box. Everything we tried was flavorful and fresh. It was helpful to have photos of the menu items and drinks.

author: Marilyn Secor
review_text: We made a reservation for Christmas Day for my family of five. What a disappointment. Please check all the current negative reviews before you decide to dine here. The food was mediocre at best. The service was the worse I have ever experienced.  The bill was 185.00 and we did not order drinks. Two of the dishes came out coated with sesame seeds which was not listed as one of the ingredients on the menu. I had oral surgery a week before and not able to eat nuts or seeds. When I made the server aware of it she nasily said it was listed on the ingredient list amd asked me if i wanted to order something else. I couldn't believe she didn't offer to bring another without the seeds. I said no and she abruptly left. I took a picture of the menu, sesame seeds were not listed. I wasn't able to eat anything. I asked to speak to the manager and he was unsympathetic. He offered free dessert. We were given 2 desserts to share for a family of five in a brown paper bag to go. What a waste of money. Not a great way to spend Christmas. Avoid this place. There are so many other places to dine that are so much better, especially if you want excellent food and top notch service. They also automatically add 20% to the bill for the tip. I suppose they have to or the servers would never make money. Since they know they are getting a tip regardless they don't work for it.

author: Amy B
review_text: Wow! Easily the best meal I had in Miami! The location is great, in the marina, but the food is what stood out. The pulled pork (lechon asado) and tamal (not pictured) were fantastic! The mashed potatoes, steamed vegetables and plantains were also fantastic. We actually ate here twice during our vacation because it was that good. The staff was very friendly and attentive. Cannot recommend this place enough!

author: JT Ysseldyke
review_text: Great food, and a fun atmosphere. I just fell like I was hung out to dry when it came to the bill. The server when I was ordering my drink asked if I wanted a small cup or medium. I said medium but unbeknownst to me the medium is a $40 drink (compared to the $16 "small"). To say when I got the bill I wasnt a Happy Camper is an understatement. Plus they add a mandatory 20% tip. I wish that was disclosed somewhere on the website, because a $40 drink (2x more than my food) lead to a massive mandatory tip I wasnt aware of until the server was breathing down my back. Just be aware of these tactics and switcheroos.

author: David Dars
review_text:
We are so glad we skipped Bubba Gumps and cane to Kuba. Awesome service by all the staff, good food and good prices. The Crispy Boniatos was new to us and so tasty we would go back just for those. The meals were very good but we would have enjoyed a bit more spice but this was our first for Cuban style food.
Shredded flank steak with salad and shredded pork with rice/black beans

author: Tim Ou
review_text: Food was good and serviced is excellent. Not the typical ones you get from Miami.  Lobster was worth a tried. And service charge 20% is already included in the bill and waitress make sure you know about it. Worth it .

author: Faith
review_text: Atmosphere kind of busy because it's located on the boardwalk. Great for vegetarians. The congris: black beans 🫘 and rice was okay. Maybe i should have tasted it before eating the Kuba Fried Rice (V) I added eggs 🥚 it was delicious 😋 one of my top best rice I've had so far. The snapper & Sandwich Kubano was also very flavored and succulent.  Only downside is gnats was swarming around my personal vinergeret salad 🥗 I just covered all my plates up until I was ready to divulge into them 😉 great servers kind of pricey but you pay for quality of food right? 😉 It was wroth it will visit again

author: Donyel Byrd
review_text: There were many choices in the marketplace to eat. However, we were SO happy with our choice to eat here. We really wanted Cuban food. It was so good! It was very hot, so we opted to eat inside. The ambiance and service were excellent! Highly recommend!

author: erin
review_text: Yasniel was excellent! Every item we ordered was recommended by him and excellent! Tha Vaca Frita was incredible and can never go wrong with maduros in Miami. Great service and great food!

author: Maria T
review_text: Lively area inside Bayside. Very nice views by the water. Food was delicious. Anthony gave us great service.

author: Fermin Coto
review_text: Fantastic place!!! The music on a Wednesday afternoon before Thanksgiving was a little loud, but I think that is the vibe, and likely I'm just old now. The food was fantastic, one of the best Cubanos I've ever had. The Kubiche was phenomenal, the right blend of citrus and savory.

author: cindy davis
review_text: Our food came hot, and it tasted fresh. We got the sandwiches that were circled, and to go with them I got white sweet potato (very good), husband got Cuban rice and beans (really good). Erin is a good server. As you can see on the ticket they already do a 20% tip. I would go back but we're just visiting.

author: LeAngela Robinson
review_text:
We were celebrating birthdays! The food was delicious! The drinks were delicious! Ask for the house hot sauce. It's so good!The music and atmosphere were a vibe. Couldn't stop eating the good food and couldn't stop dancing while eating. Yummy Fun!
💃🏽💃🏽💃🏽💃🏽

author: Daniel Rothamel
review_text:
The food was amazing. The Kuba fried rice was delecious, and had a perfect balance of rice to ingredients. I have never in my life had a plantain that was that delicious!

Yasniel was super friendly, and he made great recommendations, answering all of the questions of our large party.

Eating here was a wonderful experience from beginning to end.

author: Alberto Guzman
review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at a this  charming restaurant situated right in front of a marina, offering a mostly enjoyable experience, though there were some areas that could be improved. The first thing that captured my attention was the stunning view of the marina—a picturesque backdrop that made it an ideal spot for a relaxing dinner. However, the environment was a bit noisier than I prefer, with lively conversations and the sounds of nearby boats creating a bustling atmosphere that occasionally distracted from the meal. The food, on the other hand, was a true delight. The menu featured a variety of delicious options, and each dish we ordered was well-prepared, flavorful, and made with fresh ingredients that perfectly complemented the waterfront setting. I also appreciated the surprisingly quick meal prep time, which allowed us to enjoy the evening without long waits between courses.

The service was friendly and attentive, with our server ensuring our drinks were filled and checking in on us regularly. However, during peak times, it seemed they were stretched a bit thin, resulting in slight delays. Even so, I was impressed with their efficiency in delivering our meals promptly. Unfortunately, one downside to our visit was the occasional presence of individuals approaching our table to ask for money. While I understand this can occur in busy areas, it was disruptive and detracted from an otherwise pleasant experience. It would be helpful for the restaurant to implement measures to better manage such interruptions, enhancing the overall ambiance and comfort for diners.

author: Nur
review_text:
Kuba On the Bay is a vibrant gem that transported my wife and me straight to the heart of Havana! We savored every bite of the Ropa Vieja, a soul-warming dish with tender, shredded beef swimming in a rich, tangy tomato sauce that danced on our taste buds. The Vaca Frita was equally phenomenal—crispy, marinated beef with a perfect char, paired with caramelized onions that added a delightful sweetness. Each dish was a masterful blend of authentic Cuban flavors, served with a side of warm, island hospitality.

To top it off, we sipped on their virgin Piña Colada, a creamy, tropical dream that was so refreshing it felt like a mini-vacation in a glass—pineapple and coconut perfection without the buzz. The atmosphere was lively yet cozy, with colorful decor and a bayfront view that made the evening unforgettable. Kuba On the Bay is a must-visit for anyone craving bold flavors and a true taste of Cuba. We can’t wait to return!

author: Lumi Chuang
review_text:
My husband and I visited Miami for the first time to get away from the Northern cold wave.  It was only for a few days and wanted to try some Cuban food.  I have severe gluten and dairy allergies so I researched online and this place kept coming up.  We went a little after lunch, got seated inside, the music outside was soooo loud!!  It was a little quieter inside, but not much.  We ordered two appetizers and an entree to share.  It took a while to get served, even to get some water, hardly any customers inside or outside.  A lot of servers were just chatting and laughing around.  Waited a little longer and a young woman came and asked what we wanted.  I got a mocktail too and that came pretty fast, with whipped cream on top.  I asked if that was whipped cream and she said yes, I gently reminded her I had a severe dairy allergy.  She said no problem.  I saw her tell the bartender and also saw the bartender roll her eyes, but got me another drink.  Finally, food came, the plantains were tasty, everything else was just meh.  That evening I was violently ill all night throwing up and going to the bathroom.  My throat swelled up (the gluten part of my allergy), and the GI is my dairy allergy.  Let’s just say it was a long night and the next day I was nauseated the whole day, couldn’t eat much.  This is a note to the restaurant:  when a client says they have an allergy, please, please educate your staff to know what not to do or do in the kitchen.  Sure, you don’t need to serve us, just tell us, hey, there’s nothing for you here.  Friends and family always ask us where we should all meet up for lunch/dinner, because of our allergies.  We won’t pick your restaurant, just let us know.  No one owes us a cooked meal, I get it, we just need to be told so we don’t suffer while on vacation.  Thank you! I don’t usually write reviews, but I will now because people like me, with different allergies, need to be informed.
If you have allergies, give this spot a miss.  Even if you don’t, the food wasn’t all that great. I’ve had better Cuban food.

author: TELU VENDING LLC
review_text: Caroline was great! She took great care of me and my friends and was very attentive and brought out or food in a timely manner. She was also very pleasant and made sure to give us the best service!

author: Ali Safarov
review_text: Stopped here for an early lunch. Great food, great service, great location—and of course, a great view! It was enjoyable sitting outside watching the boats. I had the Beef Empanada, Sandwich Kubano, and a beer. I’ll definitely recommend this restaurant.

author: flightmedic333
review_text: It’s always a great experience here at Kuba in bayside, bartenders are very attentive especially Dalila, she’s always on point with the drinks, and she’s absolutely beautiful so that’s always a plus. chavely works very well with her as another bartender, she’s always working on something but somehow has time to ask if we need something. Also very pretty. This place is definitely a whole vibe. I recommend 100%

author: J C
review_text:
Worst service I've ever had. During a slower time of the day and with a great deal of front and back of house workers,  a child's pasta meal came out 45 minutes after the other orders.

Staff was completely unintentive and never checked in. I had to leave the table at 30 and 45 minutes after the pizza came to inquire about where was the pasta. When I went to cancel the pasta at 45 minutes post all other food, server  instantly pulled pasta from a different ticket and plopped it down. Nothing was even taken off the order or even a half-hearted apology for ruining the meal.

author: Roberto Santiago
review_text: Best churrasco, I ordered well done came out very juicy and tender. Be aware of automatic tip and credit card charges

author: Jordi ST
review_text: Food was  acceptable but nothing more. Place is noisy, specially when opening and closing one of the doors.

author: Stas Markovych
review_text: I ordered three things: iced tea, mussels and a Hawaiian pizza. The tea was fine, but I was really surprised that for five bucks there were no free refills. They told me each refill costs another five, which felt weird. The pizza honestly tasted like something from my school cafeteria… probably a $3 frozen one. The mussels were okay, nothing special. I’d give the pizza a 2 out of 5, and the mussels maybe a 3.5. The view, though, was beautiful.

author: Bri W
review_text:
Really enjoyed dinner here! Started off with an amazing bruschetta. I can’t say enough about how good this was.

I ordered the marinated chicken breast. It was good! Flavoured…roasted potatoes were delicious. Partner ordered the chicken parm. Also very good. Fresh mozza…you could tell it was homemade.

I saw some negative reviews here on the service. It’s true. The staff treat you as “set it and forget it”…But that’s the service I value. I’ll call you if there’s an issue or if I need your attention. I don’t need you checking in every five minutes.

Everyone was very friendly.

author: Michelle Luv
review_text: The food was delicious and the service was excellent. I don't remember the server's name but he was wonderful ( older gentlemen). It was chilly outside so we decided to eat indoors. It would be nice if there was a candle in the indoor tables as well for added ambiance.

author: sergiy Chumachenko
review_text:
There are promoters standing outside, which immediately makes it clear that nothing good should be expected. When ordering a burger, they don’t even ask how you want the meat cooked. The real value of a burger of this quality is максимум $10, not $20. The same goes for the salads.

When we tried to choose drinks, the waitress discouraged us from every option and kept pushing their “freshness” cocktails. The cocktail itself tasted like plain powder mixed with water and ice — worth maybe 25 cents, at most 50 cents by my taste. The price for three cocktails was $51.

You are seated right in a walkway with a huge line people passing by. The restaurant calls itself Italian, but I don’t think they have any idea what Italian food actually is.

A fake restaurant with beggar-like promoters and pushy waitstaff. Stay away. This is not a restaurant — it’s just trash.

author: Ben Tanner
review_text: We were in the area after riding on Thriller jet boat experience. We were walking around the boardwalk area and ran across this place. The view is fantastic and it’s great people watching if you sit outside. The food was good but not great. They were a little busy, but the service was terribly slow. As long as you are not in a rush, it should be OK.

author: Vidhi Dalwadi
review_text:
Our waiter dropped off the food and literally vanished. No check-ins, no refills, no care whatsoever. We tried flagging down other staff members and were met with blank stares, eye-rolls, and outright rude behavior. It was like we were invisible.

The food was average at best — bland, overpriced, and definitely not worth the attitude that comes served on the side.

author: Dominik Gorgol
review_text: The food was delicious. We had a NY steak and grilled chicken breast with vegetables and pasta. Staff was friendly and attentive. You can eat in and out

author: Cayman Haffner
review_text:
I came here with my spouse to celebrate our five-year wedding anniversary, and this place managed to ruin what should have been a special night. We were seated promptly  and then completely ignored for twenty minutes. Many glances by the staff but not a thought behind those eyes. The restaurant wasn’t busy, so there’s no excuse for the lack of attention or basic courtesy.

When a server finally decided to approach our table, we asked for water. She took five minutes to bring bottled water, while every other table around us had regular tap water in glasses. To make matters worse, we later discovered they had the nerve to charge $10 for that bottled water we never requested.

At that point, we decided to leave rather than waste another minute in such a miserable atmosphere. The service was disrespectful, the environment uninviting, and the overall experience dehumanizing.

This establishment clearly doesn’t value its customers or understand hospitality. Save your time, money, and dignity — go anywhere else. I truly mean ANYWHERE else!!!

author: Eric Johnson
review_text: Food is average at best . The chicken parmesan was pounded paper thin . The spaghetti was average flavor but I had better sauce from the grocery store.  Sitting on the deck and the staff help to make that happen is the reason for the second star. The kitchen made a mistake and my food was 30 minutes after the rest of my party got theirs . My waiter was good enough. But the manager did not offer a discount just to have our waiter say we did not have to leave a tip.  To the owner of this place a little more courtesy from the manager would have helped. The bill for 5 was 200 .

author: sigal agashi
review_text:
We came here for dinner with friends & my seven-year-old daughter and we love it!!!
every dish that we order was excellent! We had the cheese tortellini,  Alfredo, Caesar salad and the burger dish. Everything was very delicious. The service was excellent too!
I highly recommend that place( I’m very picky with my food 😜)
The portion was huge. I would recommend to share.!

author: davidyoung31
review_text:
Felix our server really is a shining star here.
After a bad experience across the road where we left.
Felix was outstanding & left us feeling welcomed & nothing was to difficult.
Next time we're in town, will definitely be popping in.

author: Pam Delfino
review_text: Fresh and delicious food at this place! We had the grilled chicken and chicken parmigiana, and both were served piping hot. Fantastic food, and our server was very attentive.

author: Chetanya Rai
review_text: Very, very poor service and even worse food. The focaccia was a complete joke – it wasn’t even proper bread, just a pizza base passed off as something it clearly wasn’t. The food arrived frozen in the middle, which is absolutely unacceptable. Pathetic experience from start to finish. Would not recommend.

author: Anastasia Finch
review_text:
We had high hopes for Lombardi’s in Miami, but overall the experience was disappointing. The food was pretty average at best. We ordered the mussels and the pasta with clams—both sounded great on the menu, but didn’t live up to expectations.

The pasta was bland and lacked flavor, and while the mussels were edible and okay, they definitely weren’t worth the high price. Speaking of which, the prices here are steep, and the quality of the food just doesn’t match.

As for drinks, the Margarita was tasty, but the Mai Tai wasn’t great.

What really brought the experience down was the state of the restroom—it was extremely dirty and smelled awful, which is just unacceptable for any restaurant.

Wouldn’t come back. There are much better places in Miami for both food and atmosphere.

author: Ashima Nazamodeen
review_text: The food is horrible. I had the Mahi Mahi and it came burnt and unseasoned. My husband had the seafood pasta and said it was average if he was being generous. We dined inside and it seemed no one took care of the guests seated inside. Everyone was focused on the guests outside. If we tried to get a servers attention they would just look at us and then just walk back outside but not to attend to any customer, just to stand at the doorway. The staff cleaning up the tables did a better job than anyone else. The bathroom is so extremely bad. Dirty and badly designed. I was so grossed out using it and there is no area to change a baby. Such a bad experience overall. Would never return there or advise anyone to waste their money there.

author: Rhonda Julio
review_text:
A Tourist Trap at Bayside, Miami.
I recently dined at Lombardi’s and was extremely disappointed with both the food and the lack of service. I ordered the shrimp scampi, which turned out to be a complete waste of money. The dish was overpriced and arrived cold — a bland pile of low-quality spaghetti with a few shrimp on the plate. It was completely lacking in flavor.
The lemon drop martini was equally disappointing. It tasted like it was made with store-bought lemon juice, and the glass itself was sticky. I’m not even sure there was any real vodka in it. Service was nonexistent. The servers were standing in front of the restaurant with menus in their hands luring customers than on attending to those already dining. I had to go inside the restaurant just to find someone to bring my check. When I asked an older server for assistance, he became irritated, said he didn’t know who my server was, and walked away.
The couple seated next to me were also experiencing issues with their food and service. The manager briefly appeared but disappeared without addressing their concerns.
Overall, this was a terrible dining experience. I will never return to this restaurant, and I strongly advise others to stay away from Lombardi’s at Bayside. By the way, they have the audacity to include gratuity in the checks. I know this is optional, but I chose to not have it remove because I just wanted to just get away from that place.

author: Cathy Porr
review_text: The only good thing about this place is the location.  Had  calamari - did not like it, was blend with almost no taste. It is certainly not a family owned restaurant more than a cheap fast food place. Never again.

author: Scumdog 1980
review_text: Food was really good. Taco Nachos were amazing. Fish and chips were a win for me and im not a seafood person. The chicken sandwich with Chipotle pineapple aioli was also amazing. The dragonfruit spritzer was great, the strawberry one not as good. Our waitress Shanda did an amazing job taking care of us. Never once felt rushed and over burdened.

author: J P
review_text: Oceanside restaurant along the boardwalk very scenic.  The food is good and you get plenty in your serving.  I wish they had a single burger item on the menu but all they have for adults is double burgers which are too huge to finish.  The kids menu has a single burger.  Very good drinks coke, lemonade etc.  Great location next to Margaritaville surfing machine.  Friendly staff.  Easy parking right next to the restaraunt in the parking garage.  Prices are fair for the size of the items.

author: Not A Lie
review_text: Ordered tacos and got burnt tacos with black char on the sides with the most basic ingredients in the tacos that they were flavorless. If the chef burns his food, just toss it and redo it!!! At least there were chips and salsa on the side to snack in. Sadly this was a togo order so I only noticed that it was bad when I was already at a beach and there was nothing I could do about it. At least the servers and hostess were nice and helpful in the restaurant.

author: aimiaiko roselinne
review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10/10 Experience at LandShark Bar & Grill!

From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was exactly what you’d want for a perfect getaway meal — fun, beachy, and full of good vibes. The view by the water was absolutely beautiful, especially at sunset.

The staff was super friendly and attentive, making sure everything came out just right. Our food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked — from the juicy burgers to the seafood dishes, everything tasted amazing. The drinks were also on point — refreshing, strong, and well-presented.

You can tell this place was designed for people to relax and enjoy themselves. Whether you’re stopping by for lunch, dinner, or just cocktails by the water, it’s the perfect spot to unwind.

I’d definitely recommend LandShark to anyone looking for great food, great views, and great service. Can’t wait to come back again soon! 🌴🍹

author: Doug Hall
review_text: We strolled the markets and decided to give this place a try. Three of us got the cheeseburger deal and we all thought the burgers were excellent. Best burger I have had in a long time. The draft Landshark was great also. Service was just meh - had to track down our check to pay and leave.

author: PA Muller
review_text: Really nice place! The service was good and the food was delicious! We sat by the window with a nice view of the water and yachts. I will say it was very expensive. We got two plates of food and two drinks for a total of almost $100. It was definitely an experience. Thank you, Land Shark!

author: Towanda “Princess”
review_text: Came with a huge party for a meet and greet. Service and food was good. I only got a drink and an appetizer. The peel and eat shrimp was enjoyable. I wanna come back and try a couple of things I saw on the menu. Great view if you eat outside.

author: Taylor Deni
review_text: There is probably a reason why they were so empty!  I had a light late lunch.  The seafood lettuce wraps were OK.  Something you could make at home.  Not worth the price.  The seafood salad was gritty.  I think they need to devein the shrimp.  No atmosphere.  Staff were pleasant.  Would not recommend.

author: Thanuj Pothula
review_text: We had a great time at LandShark Bar & Grill! The Cajun Shrimp was packed with flavor and had just the right amount of spice. The Uptown Top Shelf Margarita was smooth and refreshing, a perfect match with the food. Our waitress Ann was amazing—super friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. Definitely a place I’d come back to! 🌟🍤🍹

author: Eduardo
review_text: The staff was really rude. We sat outside and waited for about 10 minutes for someone to come take our order. Then a woman “ Alexandra” came over and told us we couldn’t sit there because we weren’t buying anything. But how are we supposed to buy something if no one even came to serve us? Are we supposed to serve ourselves now? Come on — that’s just ridiculous.

author: Ernest Baca
review_text: Ok so service was awesome food 3* if the key lime pie was pie not a custard would gain a star.  The drinks were 5* but food will stay at 3*.  But it is worth a stop inn. We can try again next week will update with new visit. Tony never let our drinks go dry. Thanks Tony!

author: Heather Dawson
review_text: From the drinks to the food to the wonderful service from Ann, everything was amazing. Will definitely be coming back here when in town again

author: Revelmonger
review_text: They were hosting a "Christmas Party" inside and the kitchen was apparently delayed. Anyways took over an hour to get our food and when it came out out of 5 people only 3 meals were ready. First time going to Hard Rock Cafe as my friends were telling me how great it was. Anyways it basically ruined the evening. If the kitchen can't handle a party and it's regular activities maybe they shouldn't be open to both at all. Wish we had just been told there was a delay instead of being seated and starving.

author: R. Fletcher
review_text: Great beachfront restaurant, the service was great, and the food was good and the atmosphere was electric. .. Beautiful views, near all the ships and shops. I highly recommend this place if you wants sights, sounds and a cool vibe.

author: LATASHA GALLEGOS
review_text: I really liked the spacious dining room, decor, and music. The restaurant and restroom was very clean. Our staff was friendly and attentive and I really enjoyed my fish & chips!

author: Lindsay Harris
review_text: We got an assortment from the menu and some drinks (fish tacos, burgers, and shrimp). Everyone loved their food, and I had the coconut castaway, which I could have drank 10 of since it was so delicious. Very big and fun restaurant, I like that they take photos and give you a free postcard with the option to buy a bigger one. Service was great, and we liked the music they played. Overall, the only complaint is that inside doesn't have air conditioning, but they do have ceiling fans. Lastly, I love the little fins they put in their burgers and the view of the water if you sit outside.🦈 ❤️

author: LN
review_text:
Our recent trip to LandShark Bar & Grill at Miami Bayside was everything we love about dining in Miami! Located right on the waterfront, this spot is a tropical paradise where great vibes and mouthwatering flavors come together in perfect harmony.

As soon as we walked in, we were greeted by the friendly staff and a laid-back, beachy atmosphere that made us feel like we were on vacation (even if it was just for a few hours!). The views of the marina, with boats gently bobbing in the water, set the perfect backdrop for our dining experience.

Now, let’s talk about the food—because wow, was it incredible! We kicked things off with their signature LandShark Lager (how could we not?), which was the ideal way to start our Miami adventure. Crisp, refreshing, and just the right amount of chill to match the ocean breeze.

For starters, we couldn’t resist the Peel & Eat Shrimp—juicy, succulent, and perfectly seasoned with Old Bay. It was like a taste of the sea on our plate!

Then came the main course, and let me tell you, choosing just one dish was a challenge! But we finally settled on the Fish Tacos and Jimmy’s Jammin’ Jambalaya. The fish tacos were bursting with flavor—fresh, flaky fish topped with zesty slaw and a drizzle of creamy lime sauce that tied everything together. The jambalaya? A spicy, savory delight that transported us straight to the heart of the South. Each bite was packed with shrimp, chicken, and sausage, all swimming in a rich, flavorful sauce that we couldn’t get enough of.

Of course, no visit to LandShark Bar & Grill would be complete without indulging in dessert. We went all out with the Chocolate Hurricane—a massive, chocolatey delight that was as decadent as it sounds. It was the perfect sweet ending to a fantastic meal.

But what truly made our time at LandShark special was the vibe—casual, fun, and quintessentially Miami. Whether you’re hanging out with friends, enjoying a family meal, or just looking for a great place to unwind, LandShark Bar & Grill is the spot to be. We left with full hearts, full stomachs, and memories of a day well spent in paradise.

If you’re ever in Miami, make sure to stop by and experience it for yourself—you won’t be disappointed!

author: Alpesh Patel
review_text:
Food was ok, service was attentive.
I expected more from basic nachos.  Not spicy at all even though we asked for Jalapeños (I get it, Jalapeños are a hot or miss), but the fish didn’t make up for it.

author: Leah J
review_text:
Reviews say service is slow, but Collin was all over and never left us sitting long. He was taking care of everyone and the bar and was going non stop.
We had the pleasure of, also, interacting with Raul and he added to our pleasant experience!
Too bad we are just visitors because this place would be a regular for me!

author: Melissa Sepulveda
review_text: I had a great experience at Landshark Bayside . From the hostess to the waitress. I loved my entire experience.The hostess Alexandra immediately welcomed us and sat us at the table we requested.The waitress Piper  was friendly and funny making sure our food came out on time. Piper approached our table several times making sure we had everything that we needed at our reach. The manager Raul was very attentive to our services making sure our experience was great and that our food was up to standards. Our view was great as we watched the boats come into dock.

author: Usir Wulf
review_text:
As one of the only places  truly  capable,. of not just tapping into the scenic dining  experiences the Bayside Inlet  is  known for providing,  but also  an accessible menu ; with the host being flavor,  into the wide range of  gustatory and olfactory delight the Caribbean and Canjun descendants of the Americans are  historically known for providing 😋,  i am delighted to bring  to your attention the amazing food, drinks and customer experience of Margaritaville Bayside.

Ok that's the most of my big brain anyone gets before  I start writing a food  review site.
So let's gets to it

From the very first steps up to the bar from the front porch, I felt like i was stepping onto one of the many yachts or cruise ships circling in the port just behind me. Even walking in at 11 30 on a Thanksgiving its a good amount of people  here. Gotta  be decent right? RIGHT! I hadn't even made it past  the bar before I was greeted  by 3 different employees, once by the bartender and once by a server and a host just walking in. Buddy I've eaten in luxury restaurants not sitting in a tourist venue on a Thanksgiving already busy 30 mins into the restaurant opening... so let's just say I was "above impressed " as my intro into the place. I was offered a bar or a booth, i slide into my bench and start my war with the menu. I say war, because  even though  I don't  really  suffer  from any dietary restrictions (other than , ewww that's nasty) I battle with indecisiveness when it comes to good food. The eastern border of taste was being represented by a pacific stir-fry bowl , with them broccoli I like!.. flash fried vegetables  lil teriyaki sauce and the chicken over the rice,  a hit! But end the it was the Caribbean that won. That summer taste beat my hunger into a willing retreat, and through combined efforts of Jimmy's jammin' jambalaya , set of his jerk Caribbean wings( extra sauce) and a tall bottle of Landshark to wash it down, the afternoon lunch/ dinner war of 2025 Thanksgiving  was won.

author: Greg Michaels
review_text: From out of town and I expected better service. My second time at a margaritaville. My first experience was great! This was horrible! Waiter was impatient. The chef had a say in the menu. We ordered the new chicken and biscuit. Was told no biscuit, no big deal. Asked if we could substitute the biscuit for something else. Waiter had to go ask the chef, was told no. Again, no big deal. I said I will just take the meal without the biscuit. Waiter said the chef blocked it on the computer, seriously? Blocked it because he didn't want alternatives lol. Treat your tourists better, they make your money! I am returning to Florida in a few months and I definitely won't be back here. Chillis is here, will try them.

author: Candy Y
review_text: Service wasn’t bad but they were running slow on 1/4/26. Food was delicious. I had to send my Long Island Iced Tea back and get another drink because it tasted like a glass of Cola instead of alcohol with soda as an ingredient. Our waiter was a very nice person and made every attempt to provide good service but the forces of nature were against him. Overall, it was a decent experience.

author: Seth Hazen
review_text:
So the wife and I were touring Bayside for the first time and we decided to have an appetizer and a few cocktails at Margaritaville.
We got ourselves a Memorial Cup for Jimmy as well as the Cajun Shrimp Dip and Coconut Shrimp.
Gellisa (Lisa) took care of us at the bar and she was so fun, on point and a great bartender.  If you see her, sit at her side of the bar and you are good to have a great time.

author: Padma Janki
review_text: Lovely place to eat and drink, the cocktails are amazing. Delicious jerk salmon, yum. Take a walk around here, there are lovely little restaurants and shops along the river.

author: Elihu Salas
review_text: The portion sizes here are generous. I had the Beach Club sandwich and the BBQ combo. I only made it through two of the three club sandwiches, and my son ate most of his meal, only leaving a few ribs. He mentioned they could’ve used more sauce. The atmosphere is great, and if you sit outside, you can enjoy some beautiful water views depending on your spot. One thing to note is that an 18% gratuity was included in the bill, which is good to be aware of. Overall, a solid place to enjoy a filling meal with a nice vibe.

author: Mary Curry
review_text: The food was average and the server took forever just to come and take our order and forever to bring our drinks. The view of the water and activities around the restaurant was good.

author: Keila suarez
review_text:
Special all day $16.99 delicious bacon cheese burger with fríes and soda/beer
Nice place at bayside right in front of the chicago view ,excelent service,tips already included in the bill.

author: Nicole Blondin Howell
review_text:
Despite the convenient location, I would NOT recommend this branch of Margaritaville.

The entire venue is dirty- grime, sticky. The air does not work well, so they have the doors to the bar open which let birds into the main dining area. Their walls are banged up and it’s clearly not well maintained.

Servers were understaffed and clearly not caring on a Saturday. Our server showed up twice, took us 15 minutes to get after, and over an hour for our food.

The worst was I ordered a chicken Caesar salad and the chicken was green/gray. The service attempted to gaslight me in telling me it was the seasoning, but it was only on one side of the chicken and into it. While they took the item off my bill (I did not receive that salad, I just asked for it to be replaced without chicken) it took TWENTY minutes to replace a plate of lettuce.

Also- why is there a 3% charge for credit cards? You bring my bill out on an AMEX receipt holder and then charge me 3% for using AMEX. This is bad business!

author: C Ware
review_text: The service was very slow and we had to keep asking for things (silverware, our food, napkins). The food was average, decent burger.

author: Orlando Martinez
review_text: Nice place next to the water. Very friendly nice bartender. Came in for lunch n sat by outside bar. Had fresh Landshark on draft n lunch special. Priced was reasonable for the area. 20% grad automatic on bill. Looking forward to going back

author: Selva Murugan
review_text: Came in for a quick bite and the place was buzzing with a lot of quests. The food was neat and came quick. Ask for their specials and ensure they charge right

author: Kylie Whitaker
review_text:
**Caution: Double-Check Your Receipt and Bank Statement!**

Our recent visit to Margaritaville was a mixed experience. While the food was decent and our server, Eric, provided excellent service, we did have some concerns. The nachos were enormous and easily fed both my husband and me, although we would have appreciated a bit more meat. The drinks were a bit pricey but tasted good!

However, upon reviewing our receipt and bank statement after returning home from vacation, we noticed a significant discrepancy. Our receipt indicated a gratuity of $23, bringing the total to $167, but our bank statement reflected a charge of $201. Even accounting for a potential 20% additional tip, the final amount still doesn’t align with what was stated on the receipt.

Whether it's a $5 or $25 difference, it raises questions about the accuracy of the final charge. We just wanted to share this experience to encourage others to verify their receipts and bank statements for peace of mind.

author: Lisa Ogston
review_text:
This restaurant was the worst I have been to in Florida in a long time. We have visited other Margaitaville restaurants and from the minute you walk in the door the atmosphere is electric. This one there was no atmosphere whatsoever!
We ordered our drinks and food. Our soft drinks came straight away but we sat and watched our beers sit on the bar for a good 10 mins before they were taken to us. Then came the food. We upgraded our fries to sweet potato waffle fries which were cold when they came. My daughter’s wings were cold and one was so cold I wondered if it had actually been cooked. We complained to the waiter and ate what we could. Once we asked for the bill out came new meals from the kitchen which were actually cooked, however we were on our way to the basketball so it was too late and the rest of our party had finished their meals long before this. We had also ordered another round of drinks in this time which again took a while to arrive. When the bill came and 18% service charge had been added, I asked if this would be removed however I was told this was compulsory. I always tip 18-20% but I didn’t feel that this meal deserved any tip. I now know why there was only us and 2 more tables in this restaurant! Avoid this restaurant!

author: Rahim Barnes
review_text: Great service! Went over and beyond to provide a pleasurable experience!!! It was my birthday and this happened without them even being aware!!! I feel so special and this stop has just been another memorable stop on a wonderful Miami Birthday trip!!!

author: Julia Jones
review_text: Had a great experience here today, after traveling to Miami from Virginia. We were sat and then greeted by our server Carolina, who was genuine, kind, and straight to the point which was great because we were very tired and very hungry. Her service maintained that same energy throughout our time there and it made all the difference. You can tell Carolina knows her shit, and doesn’t take any either! Thank you!

author: Patrick Burton
review_text: I always make it a point to visit a Margaritaville when I'm near one on vacation. This is located in a nice area with multiple shops and boats you can take trips on. Service was a little slow as there was only 1 bartender who was also waitressing tables. I recommend getting the Volcano Nachos. Retail store had some good offerings but be aware the price on the shirts is wrong and you'll be charged slightly more. I don't agree with that as they should charge how it's marked.

author: Minsub Song
review_text:
We went here last week and enjoyed the view, environment, and food.
But one problem. Idk if this is restaurant wide issue or our server.
When we got our check, everything looked normal. We asked to pay with Apple Pay, and our server brought the tab machine. When he was ready, I simply tap my iPhone. After that…he was just going to leave, saying have a good night. We were all confused. “What about the tip? What about the receipt?” I mean don’t people usually get the receipt, leave a tip, and sign?

When we asked about the receipt, he said their tap machine doesn’t print the receipt. So I said we needed the receipt cause this was business meal. He went inside the restaurant, saying he’s gonna ask his manager. He came back shortly with the receipts, but didn’t even give me a pen or anything. So I looked at the receipt and found that he had charged a credit card surcharge and 20% tip by himself. And that 20% tip was not only charged to the food, but also charged to the surcharge!! If the food was $10 and surcharge was $1, 20% to $11 was charged as a tip.

Why on the earth I’m paying the surcharge? No one explained to us. And why am I paying tip to the surcharge? Ridiculous.

author: Noah Farmer
review_text: I ordered the hot honey chicken sandwich and it tasted like one of the best chicken sandwiches I’ve had. Not only that but it was a pretty good size portion you get so it really felt like it was worth the price. My server was fantastic and the views of the bay were fantasticer. My only problem was actually getting to here, with traffic and parking. Some people claim that there’s a woman to blame, but I know this is everybody’s fault (doot doot doo do do🎵)

author: Lorie Brandenberger
review_text:
Eric was a most excellent server and our food was fantastic!  Food arrived as ordered and hot vs the room temp food we have been getting many places.
The chicken stir fry deserves special mention—rice was perfectly done, chicken crispy outside and tender and juicy inside, and the SAUCE!!!  I will order this again for certain.

author: Julie Killeen
review_text: I had read an article about this “local gem” and decided to try this morning.  It is a good no nonsense breakfast with fast & friendly service.  The staff were welcoming & friendly, there were a couple large parties but our server was still attentive.  All three meals were tasty.

author: Emilio Gonzalez
review_text: Amazing places good food and really nice services. The waitresses are super friendly definitely is a place you most come

author: VILLAS CHANNEL
review_text:
Absolutely delicious!

We had an incredible breakfast at Restaurant Farmers Market. The omelets were amazing—perfectly cooked, flavorful, and packed with fresh ingredients. The French toast was next level—crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy inside, with just the right amount of sweetness. Highly recommend going for the full breakfast experience—you won’t be disappointed. Great service and a cozy atmosphere made it even better. Definitely coming back!

author: Bob C
review_text:
Great attention to us making sure we were treated well and fed well too.  Loved the Chicken n dumplings.   Spaghetti and meatball were as good.  Service top of the line.

I always say, you don’t need white table cloths to be a five star restaurant.

Thank you for a great meal.

author: Santo Gore
review_text: The bacon cheese omelet with home fried potatoes and white toast with sweat tea was amazing. The servers are very friendly and do an awesome job. The atmosphere is very welcoming and friendly.  Give the Farmers Market Restaurant a try.  You won't be disappointed.👍✌️

author: MIKE EMMERSON
review_text: Found this place by accident but knew what to look for when I saw it as a friend who lives down there mentioned it. We love the local food atmosphere and experience, this one did not disappoint. Great service. Great food. Great time!

author: Roberts Lifestyle
review_text: Old school country kitchen. Great food at a decent price. We’ve been here a few times in the past for breakfast. The portions are always fulfilling. They offer a delicious southern breakfast that hits the spot. The grits were a great consistency and buttery. My eggs were scrambled well and the corned beef hash was excellent. The overall breakfast experience was satisfactory and the service was great.

author: Full time Fun
review_text: The Farmer's Market Restaurant offers a delightful farm-to-table dining experience with a focus on fresh, local ingredients. The menu is seasonal, with creative dishes that highlight the best of what’s available. Service is friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant. Whether you're enjoying brunch or dinner, it’s a perfect spot for those seeking quality, sustainable food in a welcoming setting. Highly recommended!

author: M Morraz
review_text: First off, the name is quite misleading. We went looking for fresh food and were met with plastic looking eggs and potatoes. The waitress was nice, but then didn’t circle back to check on us.

author: Janet
review_text:
Delicious. mozzarella sticks taste so cheesy and good. Loved the lemon pepper chicken, it was juicy and loved every bite. The staff is friendly and the place is super clean.
Definitely coming back and will try the roasted turkey with cornbread stuffing. Oh! 😍❤
Oh the chicken country fried sandwich is absolutely amazing!  🤤

Today had the country breakfast. Yum

Another update went for breakfast with Fam and once again delicious 😋

Back again. Got the grilled chicken sandwich with fries and coleslaw. So good.

Tried the meatball sub and it was so delicious. Fam order liver and onion and steak sub. Great food and service!

Omelette 🥚🙌🫶🤍🔥🔥

author: Sup_Lick
review_text:
After a long day/ night of drinking in key west,when awaking the next morning I started to head back up to Philly. Along the way I was getting that craving u get after a night of drinking, for me it’s bacon, or something salty in that range. Threw up maps and looked for a place close, I read farmers market I think good food. Walked in the waitress was nice sat down, she said the specials are behind on the screen, a full list of stuff there was.
I grabbed a ham steak, salt cured. Eggs bacon home fries and toast.
Eggs and bacon great, the ham steak was huge was salty, which well it’s in the name, the toast had so much butter had to get napkins to take it off.
The service was great, the waitress soft spoken,
Attractive with freckles and grey eyes.
When I head back to Florida, would stop again,
No ham tho.

author: Rudy&Michelle Still
review_text: Great food, very friendly atmosphere - breakfast was excellent

author: Brittany
review_text: Staff was very friendly. I would not recommend ordering the alligator bites. Almost 20 bucks for about 10 popcorn chicken sized pieces. Food was good, not wow. Not worth the expensive price tag in my opinion.

author: SeaWhy Adventures
review_text:
Absolutely delicious and tons of selection. We picked this place since we were in the area and the reviews were good.
My husband had the grilled grouper sandwich and I got grouper fish fingers, both were cooked and seasoned to perfection.
We will absolutely eat here again.
Great service and great food!

author: Jud Sa
review_text: Here the menu , because when I search and see the prices online was not correct I a little expensive. The food was good but not excellent for the price that we paid.

author: Sam Root
review_text:
Good country breakfast with a massive portion.. If you looking for a quick bite to eat in the morning it is a great option right off the main road.

Service was good with a nice ambiance. Place was clean and the staff was very friendly.

author: maurice solner
review_text: Great local spot, right down the street from our hotel. The food was excellent and so was our waitress. I love the fact they are BYOB as well. I highly recomend getting the country fried steak dinnner.

author: Grzegorz Litwin
review_text:
The best breakfast since my stay in Florida. I ordered Fresh Vegetable Omlette and it turned out to be a great choice. At the beginning I was greeted by friendly staff, but the tasty and fresh dish and the large portion made a great impression. Phenomenal place, you will forget about fast food once you try this restaurant. I would highly recommend this place.
Greetings from Greg

author: Antonio Perez Coss
review_text:
We loved our brunch at the Farmers Market Restaurant! 😍
The food (we had a breakfast for the entire family) was delicious 😋
Home made food, super tasty and in a nice and cozy environment (it really looks like granny house)
We recommended 100% let’s support our local businesses 💪

author: Danielle Riehl
review_text: We were greeted by Carlene, whom I believe is one of the owners or at least the manager. She was so kind and funny! You feel like family right away! It’s old diner feel, which was a nice nostalgic vibe. We ordered the gator bites and a chefs salad. Food was served promptly and the seasoning in the gator breading was chefs kiss! Mom and pop style dining, comfort food, clean and would definitely stop by here again!

author: YouMakeIt I'LL REVIEW IT
review_text:
AVOID THIS LOCATION.
Service is slow if you order inside. Drive thru is normal speed but beware you will be missing items or you will be given bad quality food. I was given a "whole chicken" unfortunately this chicken was missing both chicken breast and a thigh. And too make matters worse, they serve you plantains that are burned pass the point of no return. I recommend asking for your receipt, they tend to purposefully not give it to you at the window.  I guess you can't complain if you don't have proof of purchase. Do yourself a favor and avoid this location.

author: BRYY
review_text: Everything from customer service to food quality was great. The portioning of the family meal is definitely a great deal, i plan on getting it again soon. The chicken was not overcooked nor undercooked. It was juicy & hot. Made fresh, tasteful. Rice tasted fresh as well. Rolls were nice & soft. The only thing I did not understand was the employee standing outside in the scorching heat when there was no cars around at all. My wife & I felt for her. Should be inside if no customers are around. Other than that. Everything was great. Appreciate this location.

author: Patrick S
review_text: The food was great and fast, I'm not sure for why the scores at this location are low, might be hard to keep up during busy times but everything was great for us.

author: Rod
review_text:
Went in to Pollo Tropical to get takeout for dinner as we were staying nearby.
We were pleasantly surprised by the quality and the size of the meals we received.
Will definitely keep this place on the list to visit again.

author: Janet
review_text:
Yum chicken cesar salad. The staff worked quickly and friendly and they were busy. Definitely coming back.
🤠😁 🥗🍴

Update
Had a tropi chop so good!

Oh the ropa vieja is so 🤤 delicious 🔥🫶

The fried chicken cilantro tropi chop with avocado is delicious 🤤

author: Eli
review_text: So I arrived here because I was staying in the hotel next door and I just finished a 12-hour Drive to get here. The service is brutally slow and English is not really well spoken in here so it was a little complicated to order. Thankfully I just wanted soup and plantains so that helps keep it simple.
