With that being said the soup was excellent and the plantains were perfectly roasted so overall I'm very happy with the food but they really needs to up their game when it comes to running the line because they had probably about 12 people in there working the kitchen and it took them almost 15 minutes to give me some soup and plantains. As you can imagine at 9:00 p.m. they were not exactly busy either

author: Marisol Medina
review_text: So disappointed. We paid almost $40 for two tropichops, one soda and a large portion of fries with not even 15 fries. When we ordered the Tropichops, the employee didn’t even ask us if we wanted any toppings so we literally paid $15 for rice, a few beans and 10 mini strips of steak with nothing else and $10 for the other chicken tropichop again with nothing toppings. We weren’t even given a receipt! I am so dissatisfied.

author: Mark Blackham
review_text: Food the family for $38 and had some left overs. The sides are very simple and well made. The meats are great. The sauces are the highlight. My favs are the pineapple rum and guava BBQ. This is the restaurant I look forward to when traveling to Florida. My 4 yr old granddaughter asked what a review was. I told her I was sharing my opinion that the restaurant was good. She said she she also liked it and would say that it was DELICIOUS!!!

author: Tamera Foster
review_text: My go to stop when I am heading back to middle keys. They often have someone outside now taking your order. A little nicer than before talking to the box to order. The food is alway Very good. Love the yucca bites with or without cheese Better than fries to me anyway. The tropical chop bowls are always good too. They do offer a great family value with good chicken and sides for less the KFC and it taste good.

author: Lori Shubert
review_text:
Brush up on your Spanish. I could not communicate my order. It was missing black beans, avocado and plantains. No one was helpful. One girl tossed an unsliced avocado in a cup and placed it on the counter. No eye contact or conversation.
Too much work to get back in line for missing items in my meal.
I usually stop here when back and forth from kw. Last stop for me.
Customer experience should always come first 👋

author: QueenQyn
review_text: Someone brought their dog inside the restaurant not a service dog either. It was their pet. Immediately gave me the ick. Yuck. Management tried to give me Someone else food. & my food took almost 30 minutes. They tried to fix my food while I waited on my chicken...yuck. 30 minutes wait with the rest of my food just sitting there not being warmed or chilled. Sorry but no thank you. Half the staff didn't speak any English.

author: Keith Alllmeroth
review_text: It's a chain. It's better than typical fast food,  but not a standout. The onions on the pork were boiled and bland. The rice was dry and not very tasty. The beans were delicious, and pork was good but small portion. Again, it's ok for a chain, but there are much better places in town.

author: Jose Hernandez
review_text: Basically, like a lot of other fast food type restaurants like this one lately, the quality of the food just wasn't there. Got the trio, which looked a lot smasher than i remember.  The Cuban sandwich was excellent though.

author: Mark Rutledge
review_text: Decent food for the price, better than the typical fast food restaurants in my opinion.

author: Lisa C
review_text:
I've randomly stopped a few times on way into the Keys. However, each time they've been out of something. This last time they charged me for drinks prior to informing me all they had was lemonade.and I could take that or 'Have a nice day'
No offer for moneyback and when I asked I wa told they can't do that 🤔

Yea, I'm going with the 3 strikes your out on this lication

author: Sam Root
review_text: Consistently good grilled chicken. This location looks well maintained and opens til midnight.

author: Michael Mataanda
review_text: The food is delicious, great customer service and comfortable to sit and dine

author: Emiliano Lucer0
review_text: Food was overall decent, but workers look very stressed service was decent not what you would look for though, big disappointment they had no forks or spoons but yet handed out foods that require utensils to eat with. They didn’t say a word about not having utensils until we asked for them, PLUS place is full of mosquitos.

author: Sherlyn M
review_text: Great place to eat. The food is amazing. Very tasty chicken! Great customer service, everyone was super friendly. Graciela was super helpful and prepared our food with love. My family and I love this PT  location.

author: qwxxn_ isabella
review_text: The customer service was awful and they were rude. They gave small portions for the food I ordered and the food was cold. In my wrapped quesadilla there was a dot of sauce and the chicken was charred and the cheese wasn’t melted. Additionally, they forgot to put rice in the combo I ordered.
